item.title: 提出了CyberDualEval基准，通过430个分三阶段递进（安全分析、概念验证生成、漏洞利用生成）的漏洞任务以及衡量残余风险的任务武器化分数，评估前沿语言模型能否在保留良性安全能力的同时拒绝实质性助推网络滥用。
item.description:
CyberDualEval：衡量前沿语言模型的两用网络风险

CyberDualEval: Measuring Dual-Use Cyber Risks in Frontier Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30533

提出了CyberDualEval基准，通过430个分三阶段递进（安全分析、概念验证生成、漏洞利用生成）的漏洞任务以及衡量残余风险的任务武器化分数，评估前沿语言模型能否在保留良性安全能力的同时拒绝实质性助推网络滥用。

随着前沿语言模型逐渐成为能力强大的网络安全助手，它们也带来了两用网络风险：帮助防御者识别和分析漏洞的相同能力，同样可以帮助攻击者将漏洞武器化。现有的网络基准要么衡量原始的攻击能力，要么衡量泛化的拒绝行为，忽视了两用网络评估——即在保持良性安全实用性的同时，拒绝那些实质性推进滥用的协助。我们提出了 CyberDualEval，一个包含430个漏洞任务、用于衡量前沿语言模型两用网络风险的基准。每个任务被分解为操作性逐步增强的三个阶段：安全分析、概念验证（PoC）生成和漏洞利用生成。为了量化残余网络风险，我们为每个任务标注了任务武器化分数（Task Weaponization Score），用于衡量将模型生成的产物转化为未经授权的网络滥用还需要多少额外工作。

arXiv:2611.30533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While frontier language models are becoming capable cybersecurity assistants, they also create a dual-use cyber risk: the same capabilities that help defenders identify and analyze vulnerabilities can similarly help attackers weaponize them. Existing cyber benchmarks measure either raw offensive capability or generic refusal behavior, overlooking the dual-use cyber assessment of preserving benign security utility while refusing assistance that materially advances misuse. We introduce CyberDualEval, a benchmark with 430 vulnerable tasks for measuring dual-use cyber risk in frontier language models. Each task is decomposed into three phases of increasing operationalization: security analysis, proof-of-concept generation, and exploit generation. To quantify the residual cyber risk, we annotate each task with a Task Weaponization Score that measures how much work remains to turn the resulting artifact into unauthorized cyber misuse. CyberD

item.title: 该论文提出了 sudo L7 基准，包含 60 个由资深工程师在真实生产代码库中设计的软件工程任务，用于评估编程智能体能否像资深工程师一样发现隐藏风险、质疑缺陷前提并诚实汇报，而不仅仅是实现功能正确性。
item.description:
sudo L7：编程智能体能像资深工程师一样工作吗？

sudo L7: Can Coding Agents Act Like Staff Engineers?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30517

该论文提出了 sudo L7 基准，包含 60 个由资深工程师在真实生产代码库中设计的软件工程任务，用于评估编程智能体能否像资深工程师一样发现隐藏风险、质疑缺陷前提并诚实汇报，而不仅仅是实现功能正确性。

编程智能体现在能够将一个明确指定的任务单转化为通过测试的代码补丁。而经验丰富的工程师还会注意到请求中从未提及的风险、质疑有缺陷的前提、复用已有的成果，并坦率地说明自己验证了什么、没有验证什么。我们提出了 sudo L7，这是一个由资深工程师编写的 60 个软件工程任务组成的基准测试，这些任务大多来自私有生产代码库，且每个任务都围绕一个前沿模型曾经失败的场景构建。每个任务将一个真实的、规范不完整的请求与一份隐藏的、由专家撰写的原子化评估标准（共计 1,287 条）配对，这些标准被标记为八个行为维度，涵盖从功能正确性到真实汇报等方面。一个智能体评估器会阅读智能体的交互记录、检查并运行其代码，并将测试输出作为证据。一次尝试只有在满足两个最高严重级别的所有标准时才算通过，而这些门槛标准中有一半以上考察的是功能正确性之外的能力。

arXiv:2611.30517v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents can now turn a well-specified ticket into a patch that passes its tests. Experienced engineers also notice risks the request never mentioned, question flawed premises, reuse what already exists and say plainly what they did and did not check. We present sudo L7, a benchmark of 60 software-engineering tasks written by staff-level engineers, mostly in private production codebases and each built around a place where a frontier model failed. A task pairs a realistic, underspecified request with a hidden, expert-authored rubric of atomic criteria (1,287 in all), tagged with eight behavioral dimensions from functional correctness to truthful reporting. An agentic grader reads the agent's transcript, inspects and runs its code, and treats test output as evidence. An attempt passes only if it meets every criterion of the two highest severities, and more than half of these gating criteria test something other than functional corre

item.title: JEPA-ICL通过在JEPA特征空间中预测未来状态来学习规划，将预测性规划与演示学习相耦合，实现进度对齐的上下文机器人操作，在Imitator Game上达到80.0%的已见任务成功率。
item.description:
JEPA-ICL：面向上下文机器人操作的进度对齐潜在规划

JEPA-ICL: Progress-Aligned Latent Plans for In-Context Robotic Manipulation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30516

JEPA-ICL通过在JEPA特征空间中预测未来状态来学习规划，将预测性规划与演示学习相耦合，实现进度对齐的上下文机器人操作，在Imitator Game上达到80.0%的已见任务成功率。

演示展示了任务可以如何完成，但机器人本体、外观和执行速度的差异使得难以识别与机器人当前进度相关的指导信息。我们提出了JEPA-ICL，这是一个将预测性规划与演示学习相耦合的视觉-语言-动作框架。该策略通过在JEPA特征空间中预测有序的未来状态直至子任务完成来学习规划，从而捕获尚未完成的内容。这些规划指导动作生成，并在演示中定位相关阶段，其JEPA监督的内容特征提供了与进度对齐的上下文。从该上下文中学习反过来又会更新生成规划和动作的共享策略。这种耦合将预测机器人自身执行与重用演示经验联系了起来。在Imitator Game上，JEPA-ICL在C15预训练下实现了80.0%的已见任务成功率，比Zero-WAM高出12.0个百分点。

arXiv:2611.30516v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Demonstrations show how a task can be completed, but differences in embodiment, appearance, and execution speed make it difficult to identify the guidance relevant to the robot's current progress. We introduce JEPA-ICL, a vision-language-action framework that couples predictive planning with demonstration learning. The policy learns to plan by predicting ordered future states in JEPA feature space up to subtask completion, capturing what remains to be accomplished. These plans guide action generation and locate relevant stages in demonstrations, whose JEPA-supervised content features provide progress-aligned context. Learning from this context, in turn, updates the shared policy that produces the plans and actions. This coupling connects anticipating the robot's own execution with reusing demonstrated experience. On the Imitator Game, JEPA-ICL achieves 80.0% seen-task success under C15 pretraining, outperforming Zero-WAM by 12.0 percen

item.title: AXE框架将端到端规划与基于目标检测和BEV分割的轨迹过滤相结合，通过模仿学习与模拟器强化学习训练，对候选轨迹进行安全性和合规性评分并选出最优方案，实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶。
item.description:
AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战技术报告

AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30511

AXE框架将端到端规划与基于目标检测和BEV分割的轨迹过滤相结合，通过模仿学习与模拟器强化学习训练，对候选轨迹进行安全性和合规性评分并选出最优方案，实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶。

本报告提出了一个面向物理智能自动驾驶赛道的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的完整流程。该框架包括数据整理、高精地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习以及基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环环境下的安全性，我们提出了一种基于选择的端到端规划方法，利用目标检测和鸟瞰图（BEV）分割来过滤掉可能导致碰撞或驶出道路的轨迹候选。该方法在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上进行训练，通过从模拟仿真轨迹中学习，对一组固定的候选轨迹在碰撞风险、可行驶区域合规性和行驶进度方面进行评分，并选出通过过滤器检查的最佳候选轨迹。这一设计凸显了将端到端规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

arXiv:2611.30511v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.

item.title: 该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的气味分子从头生成框架，通过构建嗅觉受体全景结合矩阵、聚类发现代表性激活模式，并采用结合成对排序、分布匹配与复杂度约束的结构化选择性损失，成功生成匹配目标多受体激活谱的分子，在广谱型和稀疏激活型等罕见目标谱上取得了最大提升。
item.description:
具有靶向嗅觉受体激活模式的气味分子从头生成

De Novo Generation of Odorant Molecules with Targeted Olfactory Receptor Activation Patterns

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30509

该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的气味分子从头生成框架，通过构建嗅觉受体全景结合矩阵、聚类发现代表性激活模式，并采用结合成对排序、分布匹配与复杂度约束的结构化选择性损失，成功生成匹配目标多受体激活谱的分子，在广谱型和稀疏激活型等罕见目标谱上取得了最大提升。

气味感知源于一种组合编码机制：每个分子会激活特定的嗅觉受体（OR）子集，由此产生的激活模式决定了所感知到的气味。我们提出了一个从头生成分子的框架，用于生成预测上匹配目标多受体激活谱的分子。我们首先构建了覆盖20个嗅觉受体的全景结合矩阵，然后对其进行聚类以发现代表性的激活模式，最后设计了一种结构化选择性损失函数，结合成对排序、分布匹配和复杂度约束，通过强化学习来引导分子生成器。在九个不同复杂度的目标谱上，我们的方法在18000次oracle调用内实现了较高的预测选择性，并且在先验分布下较为罕见的目标谱上获得了最大的提升，尤其是广谱型和稀疏激活型目标。

arXiv:2611.30509v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Odor perception arises from a combinatorial code in which each molecule activates a specific subset of olfactory receptors (ORs), and the resulting activation pattern determines the perceived smell. We present a framework for de novo generation of molecules predicted to match target multi-receptor activation profiles. We first construct a panoramic binding matrix over 20 ORs, then cluster it to discover representative activation patterns, and finally formulate a structured selectivity loss, combining pairwise ranking, distribution matching, and complexity constraints, to steer a molecular generator via reinforcement learning. Across nine target profiles of varying complexity, our method achieves high predicted selectivity within 18000 oracle calls and provides the largest gains on profiles that are rare under the prior, especially broad-spectrum and sparse-activator targets.

item.title: 该研究建立了包含不同推理模式的数据集基准，系统评估了多种LLM上下文工程方法，发现没有单一方法能在所有任务中胜出，甚至可能不敌思维链等简单基线。
item.description:
重新审视大语言模型作为上下文工程师

Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30494

该研究建立了包含不同推理模式的数据集基准，系统评估了多种LLM上下文工程方法，发现没有单一方法能在所有任务中胜出，甚至可能不敌思维链等简单基线。

随着大语言模型被应用于越来越多的新任务，上下文工程成为一种基础方法，通过构建指令提示或元数据来高效引导大语言模型，而无需大量训练。越来越多的LLM上下文工程（LCE）方法通过将LLM本身作为工程师来自动化这一任务，即让LLM从离线试验中提取可泛化的指令或经验作为上下文。尽管这些方法类似于人类从经验中学习的方式，但目前仍不清楚LLM在何时以及如何从数据中构建出有效的上下文。为了回答这一问题，我们首先建立了一个由具有不同推理模式的数据集组成的基准测试。我们比较了不同LLM家族（8B规模）下的不同LCE方法，结果表明没有任何一种方法能在所有任务中胜出，即使与思维链这样的简单基线相比也是如此。即使通过更多参数或生成……来扩展模型能力时（摘要此处被截断），……

arXiv:2611.30494v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation i

item.title: 提出免训练解码方法Lobals，通过在测试时重新前向传播对视觉token注意力最强的层窗口，使多模态大语言模型能在潜在空间中重访视觉证据，从而提升视觉感知性能。
item.description:
测试时潜在空间计算以提升多模态大语言模型的视觉感知能力

Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30480

提出免训练解码方法Lobals，通过在测试时重新前向传播对视觉token注意力最强的层窗口，使多模态大语言模型能在潜在空间中重访视觉证据，从而提升视觉感知性能。

近期关于大语言模型（LLM）的研究表明，推理能力不仅可以通过更长的token级推理链在测试时得到增强，还可以通过在潜在空间中进行额外计算来提升。这为多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提出了一个自然的问题：潜在空间中的额外计算能否在测试时改善视觉感知？在本研究中，我们首先验证了MLLM包含稳定的可复用层，这些层可以在推理时被重新前向传播而不干扰正常的生成过程。基于这一观察，我们提出了潜在空间回看方法（Look Back in the Latent Space，Lobals），这是一种免训练的解码方法，它识别出对视觉token注意力最强的连续层窗口并对其进行重新前向传播，使模型能够在潜在空间中重新审视视觉证据。我们证明了这种潜在空间重访策略可以提升MLLM的性能。

arXiv:2611.30480v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performan

item.title: OVOGO提出了一种离线强化学习框架，通过回报锚定排序评价器，将离线价值学习与基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型生成过程的在线策略优化相分离，从而以低成本重用机器人经验来改进策略。
item.description:
OVOGO：面向基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的离线价值引导在线策略生成优化

OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30477

OVOGO提出了一种离线强化学习框架，通过回报锚定排序评价器，将离线价值学习与基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型生成过程的在线策略优化相分离，从而以低成本重用机器人经验来改进策略。

基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以从部署期间收集的机器人经验中受益，但为了改进策略而反复获取新的物理交互成本高昂。离线强化学习提供了一种自然的重用已收集经验的方式，而基于流的策略还带来了额外的机会：在重放观测处可以从当前策略低成本地重新采样新的生成轨迹。这启发我们将离线价值学习与生成过程的在线策略优化分离开来。我们提出了OVOGO，一个为基于流的VLA实现这种分离的离线强化学习框架。该设定中的一个核心挑战是学习一个评价器，它既能扎根于已记录的机器人经验，又能为新近生成的动作提供有用的价值信号。OVOGO引入了一种回报锚定排序评价器，它将样本内分布式价值学习与具有保证的……相结合。

arXiv:2611.30477v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. OVOGO introduces a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic that combines in-sample distributional value learning with guar

item.title: 该论文建立了解析系统系数从单次输入-解对中被识别的通用理论，证明了退化输入集满足零一律，并将其应用于矩阵、动力系统与微分算子的恢复，为多类ODE和PDE给出了显式的退化集刻画及保证恢复的确定性输入。
item.description:
解析系统的单次识别

One-shot identification of analytic systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30470

该论文建立了解析系统系数从单次输入-解对中被识别的通用理论，证明了退化输入集满足零一律，并将其应用于矩阵、动力系统与微分算子的恢复，为多类ODE和PDE给出了显式的退化集刻画及保证恢复的确定性输入。

我们研究线性参数化解析系统的系数何时能够从单个输入-解对中被识别出来。给定一个由解析算子构成的有限字典，每个容许输入都会诱导一个从系数到观测输出的有限维线性恢复映射，且当且仅当该映射是单射时，系数恢复才是可能的。我们定义了退化输入集，即单射性失效的输入集合，并证明了一个零一律：要么所有容许输入都是退化的，要么退化集是可忽略的——即它是紧切片零测的，并且在每一个非退化高斯测度下测度为零。随后我们将该框架应用于矩阵、解析连续时间动力系统以及微分算子的恢复问题。对于若干常微分方程（ODE）和偏微分方程（PDE）类别，我们进一步显式刻画了退化集，并识别出能够保证恢复的确定性输入选择。

arXiv:2611.30470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study when the coefficients of a linearly parameterized analytic system can be identified from a single input-solution pair. Given a finite dictionary of analytic operators, each admissible input induces a finite-dimensional linear recovery map from coefficients to observed outputs. Coefficient recovery is possible exactly when this map is injective. We define the degenerate input set as the set of inputs for which injectivity fails and prove a zero-one law: either every admissible input is degenerate, or the degenerate set is negligible in the sense that it is compactly slice-null and has zero measure under every nondegenerate Gaussian measure. We then apply this framework to the recovery of matrices, analytic continuous-time dynamical systems, and differential operators. For several ODE and PDE classes, we further characterize the degenerate sets explicitly and identify deterministic choices of inputs that guarantee recovery.

item.title: 本文提出NeRM3D框架，利用隐式神经表示将三维无线电地图编码为轻量级神经网络，并结合水平嵌入与高度感知调制来建模立体空间结构，从而实现低空环境中三维无线电地图的高效压缩。
item.description:
面向低空环境三维无线电地图压缩的隐式神经表示

Implicit Neural Representation for 3D Radio Map Compression in Low-Altitude Environments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30445

本文提出NeRM3D框架，利用隐式神经表示将三维无线电地图编码为轻量级神经网络，并结合水平嵌入与高度感知调制来建模立体空间结构，从而实现低空环境中三维无线电地图的高效压缩。

低空无线网络需要精确的三维无线电地图（RM）来支持环境感知通信。然而，由于空间覆盖范围广且信道表示具有多模态特性，三维无线电地图通常会带来高昂的存储和传输开销，因此高效的压缩方法变得十分必要。本文提出了NeRM3D，一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的紧凑三维无线电地图压缩框架。具体而言，NeRM3D将整个三维无线电地图表示为一个轻量级神经网络，该网络将离散的高度值映射到相应的无线电地图切片，从而将无线电地图编码为紧凑的神经网络。为了有效建模三维无线电地图的立体空间结构，NeRM3D联合整合了水平嵌入与高度感知调制，能够高效地提取和融合不同垂直层和信道模态之间的空间相关性。实验结果表明，NeRM3D实现了……

arXiv:2611.30445v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks require accurate 3D radio maps (RMs) to support environment-aware communication. However, due to the extensive spatial coverage and multi-modal channel representations, 3D RMs usually incur prohibitive storage and transmission overhead, making efficient compression highly desirable. In this paper, we propose NeRM3D, an implicit neural representation (INR)-based framework for compact 3D RM compression. Specifically, NeRM3D represents the entire 3D RM as a lightweight neural network that maps discrete height values to corresponding RM slices, thereby encoding the RM into a compact neural network. To effectively model the volumetric spatial structure of 3D RMs, NeRM3D jointly integrates horizontal embeddings with height-aware modulation, enabling efficient extraction and fusion of spatial correlations across different vertical layers and channel modalities. Experimental results demonstrate that NeRM3D achiev

item.title: 提出MF-EDA算法，像神经模糊系统一样通过由隶属度连接的Gaussian隶属函数构建搜索分布，并借助贝叶斯信息准则和分离性检验自适应确定分布数量，从而在双漏斗地形上避免过早丢失包含全局最优解的深漏斗。
item.description:
MF-EDA：在Gaussian分布估计算法中通过隶属函数的连接来自适应分布数量

MF-EDA: Joining Membership Functions to Adapt the Number of Distributions in Gaussian Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30436

提出MF-EDA算法，像神经模糊系统一样通过由隶属度连接的Gaussian隶属函数构建搜索分布，并借助贝叶斯信息准则和分离性检验自适应确定分布数量，从而在双漏斗地形上避免过早丢失包含全局最优解的深漏斗。

一个分布估计算法（EDA）通常从单个Gaussian分布中采样，该分布的峰值位于大多数被选中个体的所在处。在具有两个漏斗的地形上，这并不是最优解所在之处：较宽的漏斗提供了大部分被选中的个体，而包含全局最优解的较深漏斗则在早期就丢失了。本文像神经模糊系统构建模型那样来构建搜索分布：由通过隶属度连接起来的Gaussian隶属函数构成。在每一代中，所提出的MF-EDA在被选中个体的主方向上搜索它们呈双峰性的方向，根据贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）和分离性检验，在该方向上用一个或两个隶属函数来描述这些个体，将每个隶属函数与其他方向上的局部Gaussian分布相连接，并从归一化后的并集中采样。无论数量多少，每个隶属函数的高度均为一……

arXiv:2611.30436v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An estimation-of-distribution algorithm (EDA) usually samples from one Gaussian, whose peak sits where most selected individuals are. On a landscape with two funnels that is not where the best solutions are: the wider funnel supplies most of the selected individuals, and the deeper funnel, which holds the global optimum, is lost early. This paper builds the search distribution as a neuro-fuzzy system builds a model: from Gaussian membership functions joined by membership degrees. In every generation the proposed MF-EDA searches the principal directions of the selected individuals for the direction along which they are bimodal, describes them on that direction by one or two membership functions according to the Bayesian information criterion and a separation test, joins each membership function to a local Gaussian in the other directions, and samples from the normalised union. item.title: 本文提出基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统，利用烟羽轨迹模型关联排放事件证据，并通过工厂感知重排序将跨设施许可证条件误引用率从58.1%降至0%，有效辅助环境检查员进行违规筛查与证据汇集。
item.description:
自动化行动呼吁：基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统

Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30423

本文提出基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统，利用烟羽轨迹模型关联排放事件证据，并通过工厂感知重排序将跨设施许可证条件误引用率从58.1%降至0%，有效辅助环境检查员进行违规筛查与证据汇集。

环境执法检查员在从数据中识别潜在违规行为时面临一个结构性问题：他们往往没有能力处理排放事件中产生的大量数据。本文以某钢铁生产商的焦化厂和一个地区环境服务部门为案例，研究了基于大语言模型的系统能在多大程度上支持此类事件的证据汇集和基于许可证的筛查。该系统采用一个简单的烟羽轨迹模型，将空气质量监测数据、天气状况和市民投诉与每个排放事件进行关联对齐。随后，检索增强生成（RAG）流程检索特定设施的许可证条件，生成事件报告以及包含调查建议的周期报告。在2025年3月的74个事件中，工厂感知的重排序机制将引用其他工厂许可证条件的报告比例从58.1%（混合检索）降至0%（通过基于规则的工厂标签实现），同时保持了较高的RAGAS和LLM-judge评估指标。

arXiv:2611.30423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics.

item.title: 提出首个面向大语言模型智能体的硬件逆向工程基准 HWRE-Bench，要求智能体从版图、网表等已实现制品中恢复正向设计流程丢失的信息，并以可执行交付物证明其理解，同时通过强制“复制网表”对照实验确保任务真正考察逆向理解能力。
item.description:
HWRE-Bench：大语言模型智能体能理解并非由其设计的硬件吗？

HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30422

提出首个面向大语言模型智能体的硬件逆向工程基准 HWRE-Bench，要求智能体从版图、网表等已实现制品中恢复正向设计流程丢失的信息，并以可执行交付物证明其理解，同时通过强制“复制网表”对照实验确保任务真正考察逆向理解能力。

面向大语言模型智能体的硬件基准测试全都沿设计流程正向运行，即从规格说明到 RTL、版图或缺陷修复。我们提出一个相反的问题：给定一个已实现的制品（如版图、门级网表或受保护的仿真模型），智能体能否充分弄清其功能，从而基于该知识采取行动？我们提出 HWRE-Bench，一个基于智能体的硬件逆向工程基准，其建立在一个观察之上：正向流程的每一步都会丢弃信息（名称、层次结构、字级结构、生成器参数、编程模型），而逆向工程任务要求智能体恢复这些丢失的信息，并通过制品本身无法提供的可执行交付物来证明其理解。由于版图提取如今已是机械化过程，且正确的网表本身就是一个周期精确的模型，因此每个任务都带有一个必须得分为零的强制“复制网表”对照实验。HWRE-Bench 涵盖五个赛道（Extract 提取、Abstract 抽象、Audi……摘要此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.30422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audi

item.title: 该论文构建了首个基于400份真实学位证书、包含超过20,000张伪造图像的篡改检测基准数据集TamperCert，用于评估文本篡改检测方法在识别伪造学位证书方面的性能。
item.description:
TamperCert：用于检测学位证书文本篡改的基准数据集

TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30419

该论文构建了首个基于400份真实学位证书、包含超过20,000张伪造图像的篡改检测基准数据集TamperCert，用于评估文本篡改检测方法在识别伪造学位证书方面的性能。

学位证书在大学录取、移民和招聘等高风险决策中发挥着关键作用。颁发机构为持证人作担保，因此伪造的证书可能使其持有人通过这些审查。学位证书伪造现象日益猖獗，然而许多人认为伪造证书很容易被识破。公开报道的案例表明事实并非如此：2024年，香港大学商学院发现约30名硕士生持伪造学历证书入学。目前鲜有研究探讨如何检测伪造学位证书，部分原因是公开的基准数据集十分匮乏。我们提出了TamperCert，这是一个基于38所大学颁发的400份真实学位证书构建的基准数据集。每份证书均经过11种公开可用的篡改方法处理以篡改持有人姓名，并进一步应用四种额外的后处理技术，最终生成了超过20,000张伪造图像。我们评估了13种检测方法……

arXiv:2611.30419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. We evaluate 13 detec

item.title: DMC-5提出了一种非对称双模型协作框架，由通用压缩模型负责缓存感知的完整历史整合，由专门智能体模型负责动作生成，从而解决了长程智能体中上下文持续增长以及现有压缩方法丢失全局信息、语义漂移和重复压缩成本高的问题。
item.description:
DMC-5：面向长程智能体的缓存感知上下文压缩双模型协作框架

DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30412

DMC-5提出了一种非对称双模型协作框架，由通用压缩模型负责缓存感知的完整历史整合，由专门智能体模型负责动作生成，从而解决了长程智能体中上下文持续增长以及现有压缩方法丢失全局信息、语义漂移和重复压缩成本高的问题。

长程智能体反复地将不断增长的交互轨迹输入给专门的智能体模型。前缀缓存可以复用对重复历史的计算，但既无法阻止上下文的增长，也无法剔除与当前决策无关的信息。当专门智能体不具备通用模型所享有的缓存输入折扣时，这一问题尤其代价高昂，这使得轨迹压缩成为一种自然的替代方案。然而，现有的选择性上下文压缩方法存在丢失全局信息的风险，递归式地重写摘要会导致语义漂移，而反复重新压缩完整历史则会将不断增长的成本转移给压缩器。因此，我们提出了DMC-5（基于缓存感知上下文压缩的双模型协作），这是一个非对称框架：将完整历史的整合工作分配给通用压缩模型，将动作生成工作分配给专门的智能体模型。DMC-5将原始轨迹保持为一个App……

arXiv:2611.30412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an App

item.title: 研究发现AI审稿人存在披露偏差：当论文的AI使用声明表明AI完成了全部工作时，所有AI审稿人的评分平均都会降低，这可能会影响论文的录用结果。
item.description:
AI审稿人中的披露偏差

Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30410

研究发现AI审稿人存在披露偏差：当论文的AI使用声明表明AI完成了全部工作时，所有AI审稿人的评分平均都会降低，这可能会影响论文的录用结果。

AI模型越来越多地被用于审阅论文，许多会议和期刊现在要求作者声明他们如何使用AI。这种AI使用声明是否会改变AI审稿人对论文的评分，是否可能影响哪些论文被接收？在一项初步研究中，我们仅改变了150篇ICLR 2027投稿的AI使用声明，采用了最多九个改编自真实声明的版本：从没有使用AI，到写作辅助和编程辅助，再到AI研究智能体和AI作者。六位AI审稿人对这些版本进行了评分：决策模型Jev以及语言模型Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Gemini 4 Argon。在23,652份审稿意见中，我们发现当声明中说明AI完成了全部工作时，每位审稿人给出的平均评分都低于声明未使用AI的情况。AI研究智能体的声明显著降低了Jev、Sonnet和Argon的评分。我们没有发现AI作为……的披露偏差证据（摘要不完整，此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.30410v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI models increasingly help to review papers, and many conferences and journals now require authors to state how they used AI. Does this AI-use statement change how an AI reviewer rates a paper, and could it change which papers are accepted? In a preliminary study, we varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements: from no AI, through writing help and coding, to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: the decision model Jev and the language models Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 4 Argon. Across 23,652 reviews, we find that every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work than under a statement of no AI use. The AI research agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. We find no evidence of a disclosure bias for AI as

item.title: 提出TAP-DiLM，在掩码扩散语言模型中引入带类型的策略变量，系统比较了专用槽位头、共享词表槽位和CLS外部头等策略接口的优劣，并给出基于LM头尖锐度的实用接口选择诊断方法。
item.description:
TAP：扩散语言模型的策略接口

TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30406

提出TAP-DiLM，在掩码扩散语言模型中引入带类型的策略变量，系统比较了专用槽位头、共享词表槽位和CLS外部头等策略接口的优劣，并给出基于LM头尖锐度的实用接口选择诊断方法。

扩散语言模型通过对掩码画布进行去噪来生成文本，这使其成为进行选择性生成决策（如回答、等待、澄清或拒绝）的天然场景。我们提出了 TAP-DiLM，它在掩码扩散语言模型中引入了一个带类型的策略变量，并研究了该策略应如何附加到去噪过程上。我们在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 等模型上，比较了共享词表槽位、专用槽位头以及基于 CLS 的外部头三种方案。结果揭示了明显的接口与骨干之间的交互效应：专用头在各种规模下都能提供稳健的策略学习，而共享词表头在 LM 头几何结构有利时也能有效发挥作用。一个简单的 LM 头尖锐度探针可以预测共享头策略内化何时可靠，为接口选择提供了实用的诊断手段。因果钳制与槽位注入测试表明，专用策略槽位能够通过反馈影响主体去噪过程，尤其在（原文此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.30406v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. item.title: 本文为非确定性动作提出了代价敏感的可逆性框架，通过定义弱/强撤销预算和k-有界可逆性等概念，将定性可逆性理论扩展为能够衡量撤销代价的定量体系，并建立了可逆性格和代价感知的策略合并方法。
item.description:
非确定性动作的代价敏感可逆性

Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30399

本文为非确定性动作提出了代价敏感的可逆性框架，通过定义弱/强撤销预算和k-有界可逆性等概念，将定性可逆性理论扩展为能够衡量撤销代价的定量体系，并建立了可逆性格和代价感知的策略合并方法。

判断动作是否可逆需要检查动作的效果能否被撤销。最近的研究已将可逆性概念扩展到完全可观察的非确定性（FOND）规划领域，区分了弱可逆性（撤销可能成功）与强循环可逆性（在公平性假设下撤销得到保证）。然而这些概念都是定性的：它们只能说明撤销是否可能，却无法说明撤销的代价有多大。我们为非确定性动作引入了代价敏感的可逆性。在给定正动作代价的前提下，我们定义了弱撤销预算与强撤销预算、k-有界可逆性，并区分了有限强撤销与最坏情况代价无界的强循环撤销。我们在一个可逆性格中将这些概念相互关联，证明了代价感知的策略合并结果，并展示了如何利用代价最优的经典规划与最坏情况分析来计算受限的弱撤销预算和强普适一致撤销预算。

arXiv:2611.30399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is. We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. We relate the resulting notions in a reversibility lattice, prove cost-aware policy-merging results, and show how to compute restricted weak and strong universal uniform reversal budgets using cost-optimal classical planning and worst-

item.title: 该论文提出事件驱动参数动力学（EPD），通过中间状态的累积、事件触发释放与重置机制将候选更新的生成与应用在时空上解耦，在CIFAR-100上即使每步仅释放1%的参数坐标也能保持接近常规训练的性能。
item.description:
深度学习中面向时空参数更新应用的事件驱动参数动力学

Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30397

该论文提出事件驱动参数动力学（EPD），通过中间状态的累积、事件触发释放与重置机制将候选更新的生成与应用在时空上解耦，在CIFAR-100上即使每步仅释放1%的参数坐标也能保持接近常规训练的性能。

标准神经网络训练通常在每次迭代时都将优化器生成的更新信号应用于模型参数。这项工作引入了参数更新的时空视角，提出事件驱动参数动力学（Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics, EPD），通过一个具有累积、事件触发释放和重置机制的中间状态，将候选更新的生成与其应用过程分离。在一个典型的按坐标实例化中，累积产生时间上的积分，释放施加空间上的预算约束，重置则分隔相继的释放区间，而传统的密集参数更新可作为边界情形被恢复。在CIFAR-100上的四种模型—优化器配置实验中，即使在每一步仅释放一小部分坐标（包括1%的情形）的情况下，EPD仍能保持接近传统训练的最终性能。匹配对照实验进一步表明，时间累积、状态依赖的选择性释放（摘要在此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.30397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\% regime. Matched-control experiments further show that temporal accumulation, state-dependent sel

item.title: 该论文提出了一种基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的语音自闭症筛查框架，通过留一主体交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和MC Dropout应对数据有限与类别不平衡问题，在CPSD数据集上主体层面达到95.04%平衡准确率和96.30% ROC-AUC。
item.description:
基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的类不平衡条件下可信语音自闭症筛查

Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30390

该论文提出了一种基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的语音自闭症筛查框架，通过留一主体交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和MC Dropout应对数据有限与类别不平衡问题，在CPSD数据集上主体层面达到95.04%平衡准确率和96.30% ROC-AUC。

自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期筛查对于及时进行临床干预至关重要，然而由于临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及对可靠不确定性估计的需求，建立可靠的基于语音的筛查系统仍然面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于自监督HuBERT表示的不确定性感知ASD筛查框架，该框架结合了留一主体交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout。多个HuBERT模型在平衡子集上进行微调，其预测通过基于概率的集成平均进行组合，并在主体层面进行聚合。在儿童病理性语音数据库（CPSD）上的实验表现出强大性能，在话语层面达到了86.30%的平衡准确率和93.74%的ROC-AUC，在主体层面分别达到了95.04%和96.30%。此外，预测熵能够有效反映分类的可靠性。

arXiv:2611.30390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliabi

item.title: 该论文提出SGSA框架，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集层面的渐进式监督分配问题，通过类别-尺度监督配额与全局状态跟踪消除冗余监督并均衡类别-尺度覆盖。
item.description:
注意差距：面向目标检测数据集蒸馏的状态引导监督分配

Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30369

该论文提出SGSA框架，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集层面的渐进式监督分配问题，通过类别-尺度监督配额与全局状态跟踪消除冗余监督并均衡类别-尺度覆盖。

数据集蒸馏领域的最新进展使得大规模训练数据集能够被压缩为紧凑的合成数据集。然而，目标检测的数据集蒸馏仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要在有限的图像预算下保留多样化的分类与定位信号。现有方法往往只强调单张图像的信息量，而没有显式考虑在整个蒸馏数据集上累积的监督信息，这可能导致监督冗余和类别-尺度覆盖不均衡。为解决这一局限，我们提出了状态引导监督分配（SGSA），该框架将目标检测数据集蒸馏形式化为数据集层面的渐进式监督分配问题。SGSA建立类别-尺度监督配额，并维护一个全局状态以跟踪从先前选定的合成图像中累积的检测器预测……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the ta

item.title: 该论文提出mini-psych-agent，一个交互式心理环境测试平台，旨在评估大语言模型智能体在不同智能体工作流程和测试时计算预算下行为表现的类人程度。
item.description:
mini-psych-agent：通过交互式心理环境评估大语言模型智能体的类人行为

mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30365

该论文提出mini-psych-agent，一个交互式心理环境测试平台，旨在评估大语言模型智能体在不同智能体工作流程和测试时计算预算下行为表现的类人程度。

大语言模型（LLM）、其运行框架以及测试时计算预算共同决定了其行为表现。因此，同一个底层模型嵌入不同的智能体工作流程中，或被分配不同的测试时计算资源时，可能会表现出截然不同的性能。心理学家在评估人类表现时面临类似的挑战：同一个人在不同的激励条件和思考程度下可能会有不同的行为。因此，心理学任务为研究这种行为变异提供了理想的测试平台。然而，当这些任务被改编用于LLM时，它们通常被转录为文本形式，即以静态提示词的方式回放固定的、以语言呈现的实验。这种格式并不适合智能体评估，因为在智能体评估中，动作会改变未来的观察结果和任务状态。相反，尽管动态环境在LLM智能体评估中很普遍，但它们很少关注由此产生的行为是否具有类人性。

arXiv:2611.30365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like.

item.title: PseuDRAGON 通过在固定模型外保存并复用已确认的判断与修正（精确名称查找加习得规则），提升了封闭网络中金融数据假名化的一致性、减少了个人信息遗漏，并支持审批变更后的规则重建。
item.description:
PseuDRAGON：面向封闭网络中金融数据假名化的知识引导本地大语言模型

PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30353

PseuDRAGON 通过在固定模型外保存并复用已确认的判断与修正（精确名称查找加习得规则），提升了封闭网络中金融数据假名化的一致性、减少了个人信息遗漏，并支持审批变更后的规则重建。

在封闭网络中对金融数据进行假名化处理的工作人员必须解读缩写的列名、识别个人信息（PII），并选择合适的处理方法。本地语言模型可以提供帮助，但可能对相同输入给出不一致的标签。PseuDRAGON 将已确认的判断和修正保存在固定模型之外，并通过精确名称查找和习得的规则来复用它们。在专家审查环节，该工作流程依次检索机构政策、国家隐私法律，然后是国际来源。在来自一个机构的 92 个列上，当所有训练判断可用时，规则在相同审批检查下将可复用的标签数从 75 个提升到 83 个，且没有复用错误；当仅有 25% 的训练判断时，对未见过的名称不保留非 PII 规则的做法消除了重放中的额外 PII 遗漏，代价是复用率降低。修改或撤回审批会触发派生规则的重建，并且在合成记录上的测试验证了所选方法能够产生符合规范的结果。

arXiv:2611.30353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. item.title: 提出了RepoClean基准，通过将真实仓库历史中已删除的代码自动重新注入新版本，构建了200个仓库级清理任务，以评估编码智能体安全识别并移除过时代码的能力。
item.description:
RepoClean：评估编码智能体在仓库级过时代码清理上的能力

RepoClean: Evaluating Coding Agents on Repository-Level Obsolete Code Cleanup

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30350

提出了RepoClean基准，通过将真实仓库历史中已删除的代码自动重新注入新版本，构建了200个仓库级清理任务，以评估编码智能体安全识别并移除过时代码的能力。

大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已展现出强大的仓库级编程能力。然而，随着软件的不断演进，仓库代码可能变得冗余或过时，从而增加维护成本，并可能引入功能性问题。因此，智能体必须能够安全地识别并移除不必要的代码，但自主的仓库级代码清理能力尚未得到充分的独立评估。为评估这一能力，我们提出了RepoClean——一个包含来自34个热门开源Python仓库的200个清理任务的基准测试。RepoClean通过将真实仓库历史中已删除的代码自动重新引入较新版本的方式构建，同时保留当前的实现，并保留那些先前通过的测试因此失败的情形。为了在不开发新功能的前提下恢复现有功能，智能体必须利用仓库接口和跨文件依赖关系来判断哪些历史代码应当被移除。

arXiv:2611.30350v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong repository-level programming capabilities. However, as software evolves, repository code may become redundant or obsolete, increasing maintenance costs and potentially introducing functional issues. Agents must therefore identify and remove unnecessary code safely, yet autonomous repository-level code cleanup remains insufficiently evaluated in isolation. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RepoClean, a benchmark of 200 cleanup tasks from 34 popular open-source Python repositories. RepoClean is constructed by automatically reintroducing deleted code from real repository histories into newer versions, preserving current implementations and retaining instances where previously passing tests consequently fail. item.title: 提出MH-RAG-DIVE框架，通过上下文发现器和对话缓存器，在保持评估动态性的同时大幅降低计算成本，实现了多跳多轮场景下的动态RAG系统评估。
item.description:
MH-RAG-DIVE：通过树缓存对话模拟实现动态且高性价比的多跳RAG评估

MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30335

提出MH-RAG-DIVE框架，通过上下文发现器和对话缓存器，在保持评估动态性的同时大幅降低计算成本，实现了多跳多轮场景下的动态RAG系统评估。

质量评估对于判断对检索增强生成系统的改动是否能提升或保持其性能至关重要。然而，现有的评估方法通常依赖单轮或单跳交互，因此无法捕捉多跳、多轮对话的复杂性。我们提出了MH-RAG-DIVE，这是一个动态交互式用户模拟框架，旨在更复杂的多跳和多轮场景中评估RAG系统。该框架通过一个上下文发现器扩展了RAG-DIVE，该发现器能够在进行中的对话中识别可以组合生成多跳问题的文档。为了解决动态用户模拟的高计算成本问题，我们进一步引入了一个对话缓存器，它会复用之前评估运行中的对话轮次，同时保持评估的动态特性。我们在六种不同的RAG配置上对该框架进行了评估，并将其结果与其他方法进行比较。

arXiv:2611.30335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. item.title: 提出HEART——一种在自监督预训练中于局部和全局两个层级引入条件混合专家（MoE）细化机制、并通过标记级Top-1路由实现对异构ECG标记自适应处理的心电图基础模型。
item.description:
HEART：面向心电图表示学习的层次化专家自适应细化Transformer

HEART: Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer for ECG Representation Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30298

提出HEART——一种在自监督预训练中于局部和全局两个层级引入条件混合专家（MoE）细化机制、并通过标记级Top-1路由实现对异构ECG标记自适应处理的心电图基础模型。

从心电图（ECG）中学习稳健的表示具有挑战性，因为重复出现的心动周期与局部形态和节律级上下文中微妙且稀疏的诊断线索共存。现有的ECG基础模型通常依赖基于Transformer的补丁编码器，并采用统一共享的密集细化路径，限制了对异构ECG标记的自适应处理能力。我们提出了HEART（层次化专家自适应细化Transformer），这是一种在自监督预训练中引入阶段特异性条件专家细化的ECG基础模型。HEART在时间上下文化之前，对补丁级表示设置局部级混合专家（MoE）；在自注意力之后，对上下文整合后的标记表示设置全局级MoE。标记级Top-1路由允许同一ECG内的不同补丁或上下文标记遵循不同的专家路径。在公开的ECG基准上，HEART取得了（原文摘要在此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.30298v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning robust representations from electrocardiograms (ECGs) is challenging because repeated cardiac cycles coexist with subtle and sparse diagnostic cues in local morphology and rhythm-level context. Existing ECG foundation models commonly rely on Transformerbased patch encoders with uniformly shared dense refinement pathways, limiting adaptive processing across heterogeneous ECG tokens. We propose HEART (Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer), an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific conditional expert refinement during self-supervised pre-training. HEART places a local-level MoE over patch-level representations before temporal contextualization and a global-level MoE over context-integrated token representations after self-attention. item.title: 提出以可分离性和可组合性为两大核心标准的多技能可解释性框架DISCO，通过可分离头选择方法识别视觉-语言模型中特定技能的注意力头，实现对技能机制的精确诊断与可组合扩展。
item.description:
揭示视觉-语言模型中可分离与可组合的技能机制

Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30290

提出以可分离性和可组合性为两大核心标准的多技能可解释性框架DISCO，通过可分离头选择方法识别视觉-语言模型中特定技能的注意力头，实现对技能机制的精确诊断与可组合扩展。

近期的研究试图定位视觉-语言模型中视觉推理技能背后的内部机制。这些方法在机制识别和评估中都很大程度上忽视了可分离性和可组合性。我们提出将可分离性和可组合性作为技能定位的两个重要标准。可分离性要求所识别的机制主要对其目标技能做出贡献，同时对其他技能的影响有限，从而实现精确诊断和有针对性的干预。可组合性要求技能机制能够组合以支持复杂任务，使一小组机制能够解释更广泛的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个围绕这两个特性构建的多技能可解释性框架DISCO。在机制识别方面，我们提出了可分离头选择方法，基于注意力头在各技能上的贡献来筛选特定技能的注意力头。在评估方面，我们……

arXiv:2611.30290v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. item.title: 提出任务感知多模态记忆框架MMMem，通过四种互补策略从已完成任务中提取并整合经验，使AI智能体能够从历史交互中持续自我改进，避免在相关问题上重复犯错。
item.description:
MMMem：基于任务感知多模态经验整合的自改进智能体

MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30287

提出任务感知多模态记忆框架MMMem，通过四种互补策略从已完成任务中提取并整合经验，使AI智能体能够从历史交互中持续自我改进，避免在相关问题上重复犯错。

AI智能体通过与用户的长期交互积累了对话、图像和文档等记录。回答后续问题时往往需要跨这些记录连接证据，然而由此形成的理解很少被保留下来，导致错误在相关问题上反复出现。现有的多模态记忆方法主要集中于记录的存储与检索，在从已完成任务中学习并整合任务特定经验方面的机制较为有限。因此，我们提出了MMMem，这是一个任务感知的多模态记忆框架，通过四种互补策略从已完成的任务中提取并整合经验。首先，源链接的多视图记忆将原始文本、图像和渲染页面与生成的场景图像一同组织起来，其中场景图像融合了跨记录的线索以用于检索。其次，源生成的任务在两个层面支持知识对齐：预热阶段将源知识整合为与任务相关的经验……

arXiv:2611.30287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. item.title: 本文提出了一种生成式AI可信度评估框架，通过将生成词元相对于专家模型分布的统计典型性作为可信度度量，并引入AI本体校准器，无需真实标签即可实现对生成内容的逐词元信任度评估。
item.description:
生成式AI信任度的统计度量方法

A statistical measure of trust in generative AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30286

本文提出了一种生成式AI可信度评估框架，通过将生成词元相对于专家模型分布的统计典型性作为可信度度量，并引入AI本体校准器，无需真实标签即可实现对生成内容的逐词元信任度评估。

可信度是生成式AI领域的一个关键问题，因为现代模型即使输出的内容不完整、缺乏依据或完全错误，也能生成令人信服且语气自信的回答。真实标准知识或标签的频繁缺失使得对生成式AI输出的验证变得复杂。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个以模型内部置信度为基础、并通过外部专家参照进行校准的可信度评估框架。我们将学生生成式模型所生成的每个词元的可信度估计为该词元相对于专家模型分布的统计典型性，其中专家模型仅作为分布参照，而非事实验证标签的来源。为此，我们引入了一个AI本体校准器，它利用学生模型的内部潜在特征和词元级输出统计信息来计算专家参照接受度分数。结合传统的词元级置信度……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. item.title: 该论文从理论上证明了最优自回归模型可表征潜在推理策略混合，并通过受控实验表明标准SFT无需显式模式标注即可学习异构推理策略，同时揭示了其中的局部瓶颈。
item.description:
大语言模型中的异构推理学习：从模式兼容性到局部瓶颈

Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30281

该论文从理论上证明了最优自回归模型可表征潜在推理策略混合，并通过受控实验表明标准SFT无需显式模式标注即可学习异构推理策略，同时揭示了其中的局部瓶颈。

对大语言模型进行后训练时，通常会汇集来自不同教师模型或算法的推理轨迹，然而目前尚不清楚标准的监督微调（SFT）能否在缺乏显式模式条件化的情况下学习此类异构策略。我们通过形式化的混合建模与受控实验，研究异构推理的可学习性及其局部瓶颈。我们首先形式化了最优自回归模型与潜在推理混合之间的表征兼容性：目标的下一个词元分布按各模式的前缀后验概率进行加权，且一旦其他模式对前缀赋予的概率可忽略不计，该分布便会集中于单一模式。在一个配有成对广度优先与深度优先搜索轨迹的可验证符号图搜索环境中，在匹配的词元预算下，未标注的混合SFT相对于同质或有标注的基线并未表现出一致的劣势……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. item.title: 该论文提出一种无需外部参考标注的自我锚定内部一致性诊断方法，通过让LLM用户模拟器“自我报告一次、行为两次”，在共享的BFI-2六维度空间中量化自我报告与行为表现之间的相关性，从而评估和比较不同的人格构建策略。
item.description:
无需外部参考标注的LLM用户模拟器人格一致性评估

Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30280

该论文提出一种无需外部参考标注的自我锚定内部一致性诊断方法，通过让LLM用户模拟器“自我报告一次、行为两次”，在共享的BFI-2六维度空间中量化自我报告与行为表现之间的相关性，从而评估和比较不同的人格构建策略。

标准评估方法将LLM模拟的人格与外部真值（例如社区特质标注）进行对比，但当人格仅从简短的、面向任务的对话中推断出来时，这种参考是无法获得的。我们探讨如何在没有此类参考的情况下评估人格一致性，并提出了一种自我锚定的内部一致性诊断方法：人格描述自己一次并行动两次。李克特量表自我报告提供了软性的内部锚点；两个行为画像分别来自无需评审即可评分的受限场景选择，以及由LLM评判的开放式回答。一致性被定义为自我报告与每个行为画像之间的相关性，两者处于共享的BFI-2六维度空间中。该框架通过评估各种人格构建策略所引出的反应在多大程度上与其自我报告的特质保持一致，从而对这些策略进行比较。该方法在普通用户对话（WildChat和LMSYS）以及具有社区标注、文献记录完善的人格上进行了验证。

arXiv:2611.30280v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. item.title: 该论文提出PRIME框架，从硬件数据表示的视角重新设计多阈值并发脉冲神经元动力学，以残差膜电位放大机制替代传统率编码，消除ANN到SNN转换中的信息与计算冗余，在保证精度的同时提升神经形态推理效率。
item.description:
ANN到SNN转换的新视角：面向神经形态推理的硬件对齐多阈值神经元动力学

A New Perspective on ANN-to-SNN Conversion: Hardware-Aligned Multi-Threshold Neuron Dynamics for Neuromorphic Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30277

该论文提出PRIME框架，从硬件数据表示的视角重新设计多阈值并发脉冲神经元动力学，以残差膜电位放大机制替代传统率编码，消除ANN到SNN转换中的信息与计算冗余，在保证精度的同时提升神经形态推理效率。

通过在多个时间步上累积脉冲，率编码（rate coding）能够近似人工神经网络（ANN）的实值激活值，这一原理支撑了众多ANN到SNN的转换方法。然而，转换后的SNN相比原始ANN通常会产生精度损失。现有方法要么增加时间步数量，要么引入更复杂的神经元动力学来缩小这一精度差距。但这两种方式最终都导致相同的结果：信息冗余或计算冗余，从而造成效率下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出PRIME（Potential-Residual Integration for Multi-threshold Encoding，面向多阈值编码的电位-残差集成），一个从硬件数据表示视角重新设计的多阈值并发脉冲神经元框架：a) 我们引入残差膜电位放大（RMPA）机制，用其替代率编码……（摘要内容在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.30277v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: By accumulating spikes over multiple timesteps, rate coding approximates the real-valued activations of an ANN, a principle that underpins numerous ANN-to-SNN conversion methods. However, the converted SNNs typically incur loss in accuracy compared to the original ANN. Existing methods either increase a number of timesteps or introduce more complex neuronal dynamics to reduce this accuracy gap. Yet, both approaches ultimately lead to the same outcome: redundancy either in information or in computation, thereby suffering from efficiency degradation. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PRIME} (\underline{P}otential-\underline{R}esidual \underline{I}ntegration for \underline{M}ulti-threshold \underline{E}ncoding), a multi-threshold concurrent spiking neuron framework redesigned from a hardware data representation perspective:a) We introduce the Residual Membrane Potential Amplification (RMPA) mechanism, which replaces rate coding wi

item.title: 该论文提出TARE框架，揭示LLM智能体安全评估的判定结果会受到与被测系统无关的“无内容状态”（如哈希种子、工具顺序等）的影响，并只有在效应超过这种状态的影响时才将其归因于智能体、攻击或防御。
item.description:
在LLM智能体评估中归因安全结果：无内容状态的作用

Attributing Security Outcomes in LLM-Agent Evaluations: The Role of Content-Free State

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30259

该论文提出TARE框架，揭示LLM智能体安全评估的判定结果会受到与被测系统无关的“无内容状态”（如哈希种子、工具顺序等）的影响，并只有在效应超过这种状态的影响时才将其归因于智能体、攻击或防御。

LLM智能体的安全基准测试记录每次攻击是否成功，并通过攻击成功率（ASR）来比较智能体、攻击和防御方法。只有当每个判定结果确实由智能体、攻击和防御所导致时，这种比较才是有效的。我们证明，判定结果还依赖于“无内容状态”：即运行过程中不携带任何关于被测系统信息的细节，例如Python哈希种子、工具或证据的顺序，以及对失败运行的评分方式。我们要求这种状态不影响任何判定结果（决策非干扰性），并将其视为不受信任的输入，因为评估者以及基于LLM的门控请求者可以选择它。我们的框架TARE（报告效应的测试归因，Testing Attribution of Reported Effects）只有在报告的效应超过所测量的无内容状态影响时，才将其归因于智能体、攻击或防御。在Agent Security Bench（ASB）上，使用固定哈希种子的运行对于来自四个模型家族的七个智能体是完全相同的，然而（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30259v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Security benchmarks for LLM agents record whether each attack succeeded and compare agents, attacks, and defenses by attack success rate (ASR). Such comparisons are valid only if the agent, the attack, and the defense cause each verdict. We show that verdicts also depend on content-free state: details of a run that carry no information about the system under test, such as the Python hash seed, the order of tools or evidence, and the scoring of failed runs. We require that this state influence no verdict (decision noninterference) and treat it as untrusted input, because evaluators and requesters of LLM-based gates can choose it. Our framework, TARE (Testing Attribution of Reported Effects), attributes a reported effect to the agent, attack, or defense only if it exceeds the measured influence of content-free state. item.title: Voyag 是一个单次前向的联合决策模型，在车载语音助手场景中同时预测十个车载意图槽位和每对共现意图之间的三分类执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥），并通过统一联合损失进行端到端优化。
item.description:
Voyag：面向车载语音助手的联合多意图检测与执行关系分类

Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30253

Voyag 是一个单次前向的联合决策模型，在车载语音助手场景中同时预测十个车载意图槽位和每对共现意图之间的三分类执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥），并通过统一联合损失进行端到端优化。

车载语音助手不仅需要判断一句话中包含哪些意图，还需要决定这些共现意图应如何执行：并发执行、按固定顺序执行，或者在不做仲裁的情况下完全不执行。我们提出了 Voyag，一种单次前向的决策模型，能够联合预测十个受控的车载意图槽位，以及每对共现意图之间的三分类执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥）。Voyag 结合了一个多语言 ModernBERT 风格的编码器（mmBERT-base，3.069 亿参数）、一个带类型的逐槽位选择头，以及一个轻量级的 GroupCalibration 关系头（161 万参数），该关系头接收标记隐藏状态、池化上下文、显式资源需求特征以及对称化外积冲突特征作为输入。所有目标均在一个联合损失中优化：槽位选择上的软交叉熵、关系上的焦点交叉熵，以及互斥一致性惩罚项。在合成的中文车生活基准测试上

arXiv:2611.30253v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. item.title: 本文提出了首个土耳其语口吃污名化检测数据集StutterStigma-TR（含6,019条社交媒体帖子），并设计了基于BERTurk的目标感知框架StutterStigma-BERT，通过显式目标标记与多维度特征融合显著提升了口吃相关污名化言论的检测效果。
item.description:
StutterStigma-TR：一个新颖的土耳其语数据集与目标感知BERT框架，用于口吃相关污名化言论检测

StutterStigma-TR: A Novel Turkish Dataset and Target-Aware BERT Framework for Stuttering-Related Stigma Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30252

本文提出了首个土耳其语口吃污名化检测数据集StutterStigma-TR（含6,019条社交媒体帖子），并设计了基于BERTurk的目标感知框架StutterStigma-BERT，通过显式目标标记与多维度特征融合显著提升了口吃相关污名化言论的检测效果。

关于残疾相关能力主义伤害的计算研究仍然有限，而针对口吃相关污名化的特定领域资源尤为稀缺。本研究介绍了StutterStigma-TR，这是一个包含6,019条公开X/Twitter帖子的土耳其语数据集，采用基于言语语言治疗专业知识的标注协议，将这些帖子标注为“污名化”、“非污名化/语境性”或“支持性”三类，并进行了独立的生活经验评估。我们还提出了StutterStigma-BERT，这是一个基于BERTurk的目标感知框架，结合了显式目标标记、目标跨度表示、目标条件化上下文、字符级与手工构建的正字法信息，以及门控话语线索。该框架在互补的三分类和二分类设置下进行评估，采用受控的三种子消融分析和最终的20种子鲁棒性评估。在通用训练协议下，使用交叉熵训练的Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget模型被选为最终方案。

arXiv:2611.30252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Computational research on disability-related ableist harm remains limited, and condition specific resources for stuttering-related stigma are particularly scarce. This study introduces StutterStigma-TR, a Turkish dataset of 6,019 public X/Twitter posts annotated as Stigmatizing, Non-stigmatizing/contextual, or Supportive using a speech and language therapy-informed protocol with independent lived-experience evaluation. We also propose StutterStigma-BERT, a BERTurk-based target-aware framework that combines explicit target marking, target-span representation, target-conditioned context, character-level and handcrafted orthographic information, and gated discourse cues. The framework is evaluated in complementary three-class and binary settings using controlled three-seed ablation analyses and final 20-seed robustness evaluations. item.title: PixelOne通过将搜索教师模型的渐进式空间知识蒸馏给学生模型，使学生能在原生分辨率下于单次前向传播中直接从截图像素预测出精准的点击坐标。
item.description:
PixelOne：单次前向传播实现从选项到像素的GUI定位

PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30235

PixelOne通过将搜索教师模型的渐进式空间知识蒸馏给学生模型，使学生能在原生分辨率下于单次前向传播中直接从截图像素预测出精准的点击坐标。

GUI定位要求在低延迟下实现精准点击。近期的模型（如GUI-Decisions和GUI-Swift）使用固定的全局分箱加局部细化的方式，在一次前向传播中预测坐标。然而，截图下采样会丢失定位小型控件所需的细节，而在更高分辨率下，固定分箱会覆盖更大的像素范围。我们提出PixelOne，它将空间知识从搜索教师模型迁移到学生模型，使学生模型能够直接以原生分辨率从截图中预测点击。教师模型利用VideoJEV的文本选项评分器来选择行和列，并逐步放大候选区域。学生模型继承教师的参数，并通过空间蒸馏结合边界框监督来匹配教师在已探索区域上的分布。在推理阶段，同一个决策头选择一个视觉token，随后一个轻量级的像素头在该token内部预测点击位置，全部在一次前向传播中完成。点击对齐损失鼓励……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30235v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourage

item.title: 本文提出CLIP-FMoE，通过隔离约束对比学习加速专家专业化、并利用融合门机制缓解灾难性遗忘，将混合专家架构集成到CLIP微调中，在提升下游任务性能的同时保留了零样本能力。
item.description:
CLIP-FMoE：通过强制专业化的融合专家混合实现可扩展的CLIP

CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30233

本文提出CLIP-FMoE，通过隔离约束对比学习加速专家专业化、并利用融合门机制缓解灾难性遗忘，将混合专家架构集成到CLIP微调中，在提升下游任务性能的同时保留了零样本能力。

混合专家架构已成为在保持计算效率的同时扩展深度学习模型的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的针对对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型的MoE适配方法在顺序训练过程中存在显著的计算开销，并且零样本能力会出现退化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CLIP-FMoE，这是一种将MoE架构集成到CLIP微调中的新方法。我们的方法采用隔离约束对比学习，这是一种在基于聚类的数据分区上训练专门专家以加速专家专业化的训练流程。此外，我们引入了融合门机制来缓解对预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在下游任务上取得了一致的改进，同时保留了零样本能力。此外……

arXiv:2611.30233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthe

item.title: 本文提出VeriWorld，一个具有可执行动作和确定性验证的交互式3D环境空间推理基准，通过在相同实例、环境和验证器上评估匹配的视觉、结构化和组合输入条件，实现了对感知、推理及其相互作用的受控对比诊断，从而精确定位VLM失败的来源环节。
item.description:
VeriWorld：一个面向3D环境空间推理的可验证视觉SWE-Bench

VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30226

本文提出VeriWorld，一个具有可执行动作和确定性验证的交互式3D环境空间推理基准，通过在相同实例、环境和验证器上评估匹配的视觉、结构化和组合输入条件，实现了对感知、推理及其相互作用的受控对比诊断，从而精确定位VLM失败的来源环节。

视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用于导航和操作等空间任务，在这些任务中，模型必须从视觉输入中推断几何信息和物体关系才能正确行动。现有基准通常将感知和推理分开测试，导致难以判断失败究竟源于视觉理解、下游推理，还是两者之间的衔接。我们提出VeriWorld，这是一个针对交互式3D环境空间推理的基准，具备可执行动作和确定性验证机制。对于三种输入通道（视觉、结构化、组合）均有明确定义的任务族，我们在相同的实例、环境和验证器上评估相互匹配的视觉、结构化和组合输入条件；不具备清晰视觉/结构化/组合划分的任务族则单独报告。这一设计支持对感知、推理及其相互作用的受控比较。利用这一评估框架，我们揭示了两个诊断性发现（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.30226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic find

item.title: RoboAda通过在测试时利用机器人自身运动来推断不可见的物理变化（如未知的物体重量或关节弱化），在不改变预训练策略计划的前提下修正执行命令，使机器人策略无需重新训练即可适应部署时未见过的物理环境。
item.description:
RoboAda：在测试时将冻结的机器人策略适配到其无法看见的物理特性

RoboAda: Adapting Frozen Robot Policies at Test Time to Physics They Cannot See

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30209

RoboAda通过在测试时利用机器人自身运动来推断不可见的物理变化（如未知的物体重量或关节弱化），在不改变预训练策略计划的前提下修正执行命令，使机器人策略无需重新训练即可适应部署时未见过的物理环境。

预训练的机器人策略通过摄像头图像来决定行动，然而决定其计划能否成功的某些物理特性是看不见的。一个物体看起来很轻，但实际可能重100倍；关节变弱或控制器滞后也不会在图像中留下任何痕迹。当部署时的物理环境与训练时不同，计划本身往往仍然正确，但执行时却仿佛什么都没发生。提前在这些变化上进行训练无法应对未见过的变化，而部署后的适应方式要么改变计划本身，使未校准的命令继续存在；要么通过梯度步骤更新机器人模型——这些步骤并不知道自身有多可靠，即使环境没有变化也可能让机器人表现变差。我们提出RoboAda，它保持策略及其计划不变，通过在测试时推断机器人如何将命令转化为运动，来修正执行计划的命令。关键观察是机器人自身的运动揭示了……

arXiv:2611.30209v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained robot policies decide what to do from camera images, yet some of the physics that decides whether their plans succeed is not visible. An object may look light but be 100 times heavier, and a weakened joint or a lagging controller leaves no trace in the image. When the physics at deployment differs from training, the plan is often still right but is executed as if nothing had changed. Training on such variations in advance cannot handle unseen changes, while adapting once deployed either changes the plan, leaving the miscalibrated commands in place, or updates a robot model by gradient steps that do not know how reliable they are and can make the robot worse even when nothing has changed. We propose RoboAda, which keeps the policy and its plan unchanged and corrects the commands that carry it out by inferring at test time how the robot turns commands into motion. item.title: 本研究系统审计了SWE-Gym数据集奖励标签的正确性，发现模型从未解决的任务中74%存在拒绝正确修复的假阴性测试，修复或移除这些错误标注任务后，训练出的模型在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro上分别提升2.4分和2.7分。
item.description:
什么才是训练编码智能体的好数据？基于SWE-Gym的系统性研究

What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30207

本研究系统审计了SWE-Gym数据集奖励标签的正确性，发现模型从未解决的任务中74%存在拒绝正确修复的假阴性测试，修复或移除这些错误标注任务后，训练出的模型在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro上分别提升2.4分和2.7分。

强化学习（RL）通过软件任务来训练编码智能体，其奖励由隐藏测试决定，然而现有任务集合仅针对参考修复方案来验证这些测试。我们探究什么使一个任务成为好的训练数据，并重点关注其奖励标签的正确性。我们使用两个大语言模型系列对SWE-Gym进行了审计，且只有当执行能够复现疑似错误时才将其计为错误。我们发现“未被解决”往往意味着“被错误标注”：在一个9B基础模型从未解决的任务中，74%的任务存在会拒绝正确修复方案的测试（即假阴性），而在其偶尔能解决的任务中这一比例仅为20%。我们修复或移除了这类任务，审计后保留的任务能够训练出更好的策略。在相同规模和匹配难度下，用这些任务训练的模型在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro的保留任务上分别比用原始任务训练的模型高出2.4分和2.7分，而简单地删除从未被解决的任务则无法带来这样的提升。

We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. item.title: 本文提出了一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程的通用强化学习建模框架，能够刻画AI技术采纳的长期动态效应，并据此求解最优的AI技术采用策略。
item.description:
规避陷阱的AI技术采纳：一个多智能体强化学习框架

Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30200

本文提出了一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程的通用强化学习建模框架，能够刻画AI技术采纳的长期动态效应，并据此求解最优的AI技术采用策略。

AI技术和AI智能体在人类社会中扮演着日益重要的角色，涵盖教育、经济和研究等领域。采用AI技术可以带来即时、有时甚至巨大的回报，例如生产力提升，但也可能带来负面影响，包括但不限于就业和培训机会的丧失以及认知能力的下降。因此，研究如何以最优方式采用AI技术并避免各种陷阱十分重要。本文开发了一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的通用强化学习（RL/MARL）建模框架，用于确定和分析AI技术的最优采用方式。该框架能够建模AI技术采纳的长期动态效应，并有助于找到最优的AI采用策略。在该建模框架中，AI技术采纳的负面影响通过不良状态转移或负面……（原文摘要在此处截断）进行建模。

arXiv:2611.30200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. item.description:
相同执行、不同差距：Web智能体评估中的判定规则

Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30190

该论文揭示了Web智能体评估中的判定规则问题：评判标准与证据要求的选择可以在不改变排名的情况下大幅改变所报告的性能差距，且提高双方分数估计的准确性反而可能降低差异估计的准确性。

成功率的提升引导着Web智能体的发展。然而，知道哪个智能体排名第一并不能告诉我们应该对其所报告的优势抱有多大的信心。我们研究的是比较过程本身：成功是如何定义的、什么样的证据支持这些判断，以及智能体之间的差异是如何被估计的。在固定的Web智能体执行记录上，将评判者从预测可能完成任务改为要求有记录的证据支持，可以在不改变排名的情况下消除大部分所报告的领先优势。当把未确定的完成与有证据支持的失败区分开时，这种效应依然存在。通过受控的证据来源添加实验，我们解释了任务需求、对象和观察之间缺失的关联如何掩盖真实差异或制造出表面上的优势。我们还发现，让两个智能体的分数估计都更加准确，反而可能使它们之间差异的估计更不准确，因为它们最初的误差部分地相互抵消了。为了估计所选定的结果差异，我们结合……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. item.title: 提出关键通道补偿（PCC）方法，通过在剪枝接口处仅对少量关键通道施加可学习的线性变换，以低成本显著恢复大语言模型层剪枝后的性能。
item.description:
PCC：面向大语言模型层剪枝的关键通道补偿

PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30183

提出关键通道补偿（PCC）方法，通过在剪枝接口处仅对少量关键通道施加可学习的线性变换，以低成本显著恢复大语言模型层剪枝后的性能。

将独立的层作为最小剪枝单元，使层剪枝能够高效消除大量冗余参数并实现高压缩率，层剪枝已成为大语言模型（LLM）中一种有前景且流行的结构化剪枝技术。然而，移除多层会导致大语言模型性能显著下降。尽管已有一些工作探索了针对被剪枝层的各种补偿方法，但它们效率低下且成本高昂。我们观察到大部分信息的表达集中在少数关键通道上，据此提出了一种新颖的层剪枝后补偿方法，称为关键通道补偿（PCC）。PCC 通过在剪枝接口处对少量关键通道进行可学习的线性变换补偿，能够实现显著的性能提升。此外，我们还提出了一个新的评估指标，称为通道级平均……（摘要截断）

arXiv:2611.30183v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. item.title: 该论文提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR）方法，将基础模型规划器视为不可信黑箱，通过最小成本感知覆盖确保不可逆动作仅在全部前提条件被验证后才执行，从而在错误记录与不可预见条件下保障月球机器人自主作业的安全性。
item.description:
可信赖的智能体月球机器人：采用基础模型规划器的安全约束条件规划

Trustworthy agentic lunar robotics: safety-constrained contingent planning with a foundation-model planner

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30179

该论文提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR）方法，将基础模型规划器视为不可信黑箱，通过最小成本感知覆盖确保不可逆动作仅在全部前提条件被验证后才执行，从而在错误记录与不可预见条件下保障月球机器人自主作业的安全性。

持续的月球基地运营需要能够在部署前无法预见的条件下恢复设备并运送货物的机器人。已上天的太空自主系统执行预先验证过的程序，并在超出其适用范围时进入安全保持状态；而基础模型则能够现场合成计划，但这些计划无法在执行前得到验证。我们将此类运营形式化为包含不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据以及昂贵且受截止期限约束的感知的安全约束条件规划问题。我们提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR）方法，将规划器视为不可信的黑箱：可逆动作在规划器的假设下执行，而不可逆动作只有在一个最小成本的感知覆盖验证了其全部前提条件之后才会执行。在测量可靠的前提下，无论采用何种规划器或记录，都不会有任何不可逆动作在错误的前提条件下执行，且不可逆动作之前的感知成本具有下界约束……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.30179v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sustained lunar-base operations require robots that restore equipment and deliver cargo under conditions unforeseen before deployment. Flown space autonomy executes pre-validated procedures and enters a safe hold outside their scope, whereas foundation models synthesize plans on site that cannot be verified before execution. We formulate these operations as safety-constrained contingent planning with irreversible actions, erroneous records, three-valued physical evidence, and costly, deadline-constrained sensing. We propose asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the planner as an untrusted black box: reversible actions run on the planner's assumptions, and irreversible actions run only after a minimum-cost sensing cover verifies every precondition. item.title: 该论文提出视听重排（AVR）这一新任务，要求智能体理解口头请求、声学定位说话者并完成物体检索与交付，并为此构建了多类型查询数据集，以及将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型的创新框架。
item.description:
视听重排

Audio-Visual Rearrangement

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30171

该论文提出视听重排（AVR）这一新任务，要求智能体理解口头请求、声学定位说话者并完成物体检索与交付，并为此构建了多类型查询数据集，以及将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型的创新框架。

我们提出了视听重排，这是一个新颖的任务：智能体听到口头请求后，检索合适的物体，并将其交付给发出请求的用户或指令指定的目的地。AVR 要求智能体理解口头请求，并通过声学方式定位说话者以完成交付。为支持这一任务，我们构建了一个数据集，涵盖三种查询类型：显式目标指定、相对于说话者的空间指代以及隐式用户意图，共包含八个子类型，涉及多样化的物体选择和交付要求。此外，我们提出了一个框架，将运动感知的空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型中，以编码口头请求中的空间线索，并随着智能体的移动而更新这些线索。我们进一步通过多任务指令微调，引入针对语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉定位的辅助监督，以改进动作（预测性能）。

arXiv:2611.30171v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. item.title: 该论文提出FiRE方法，利用现成大语言模型在忠实度、流畅性和风格一致性三个维度上进行基于标准的成对比较，实现机器翻译的可解释细粒度无参考排序评估，并构建了首个面向该任务的人工标注基准。
item.description:
FiRE：面向机器翻译的细粒度排序评估方法

FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30168

该论文提出FiRE方法，利用现成大语言模型在忠实度、流畅性和风格一致性三个维度上进行基于标准的成对比较，实现机器翻译的可解释细粒度无参考排序评估，并构建了首个面向该任务的人工标注基准。

开发可靠的机器翻译（MT）系统，关键在于我们能否区分优质译文与劣质译文。然而，现有的评估范式要么局限于粗粒度的整体排序，要么与人类偏好不一致，均无法在无参考设置下提供可解释的、细粒度的反馈。我们提出了一种细粒度排序评估方法FiRE，该方法利用现成的大语言模型，在三个互补维度——忠实度、流畅性和风格一致性——上执行基于标准的成对比较，而非产生单一的整体判断。为了在缺乏合适测试平台的情况下对评估范式进行严格的元评估，我们构建了首个用于细粒度排序评估的人工标注、无参考基准，并取得了较高的标注者间一致性。通过在该基准及现有MQM数据集上进行元评估，FiRE...

arXiv:2611.30168v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones. However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine-grained feedback in reference-free settings. We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off-the-shelf large language models to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment. To enable rigorous meta-evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human-annotated, reference-free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement. item.title: ReVAgent是一个多智能体框架，通过共享解决方案程序的执行记录、复用中间结果并检查渲染关键帧来生成推理密集型主题的教学视频，同时提出多维度评估标准并用人类评分校准多模态评判模型来评估视频质量。
item.description:
ReVAgent：面向推理密集型任务的多智能体视频生成

ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30163

ReVAgent是一个多智能体框架，通过共享解决方案程序的执行记录、复用中间结果并检查渲染关键帧来生成推理密集型主题的教学视频，同时提出多维度评估标准并用人类评分校准多模态评判模型来评估视频质量。

arXiv:2611.30163v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：生成推理密集型主题的教学视频的一个核心挑战在于展示每一步中状态如何变化以及为什么变化。即使动画成功渲染，所描绘的对象关系和状态转换也可能与解释内容相冲突，使得推理过程难以理解。我们提出了ReVAgent，这是一个多智能体框架，它可以解决问题、为解释生成关键帧，并合成教学视频。各智能体共享解决方案程序的执行记录，在场景中复用中间结果和构建内容，并通过检查渲染出的关键帧来指导对解决方案或场景的修订。我们还引入了一个多维度评估标准，用于评估生成的视频是否清晰地呈现问题、连贯地组织步骤，并利用视觉效果来解释推理过程。我们使用人类评分对多模态评判模型进行校准，并将其应用于数学主题的教学视频。

arXiv:2611.30163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. item.title: 该论文提出应通过已训练头部、冻结特征探针和无分类器主干诊断这三种评估接口来定位持续学习遗忘的发生位置（主干表征退化还是读出头失配），并主张BWT与FWT是依赖于接口的量而非单一的模型级属性。
item.description:
重新审视语言模型中的持续学习：稳定性与可塑性的三接口诊断

Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30151

该论文提出应通过已训练头部、冻结特征探针和无分类器主干诊断这三种评估接口来定位持续学习遗忘的发生位置（主干表征退化还是读出头失配），并主张BWT与FWT是依赖于接口的量而非单一的模型级属性。

语言模型中的持续学习通常在增量学习（IL）设置下进行研究，即模型学习一系列任务，并通过其最终的分类器或语言模型（LM）头进行评估。然而，这一接口无法揭示遗忘发生在何处：准确率的下降可能反映主干网络中的表征退化、读出头中的失配，或两者兼有。因此，我们认为后向迁移（BWT）和前向迁移（FWT）应被解释为依赖于接口的量，而非单一的模型级属性。我们研究了三种评估接口：与主干一起按顺序更新的已训练头部；在冻结的主干特征上新训练的探针；以及无分类器的主干诊断。它们分别衡量部署性能、在新读出下的可恢复性，以及表征可分性。在针对编码器和解码器模型的类增量实验中……

arXiv:2611.30151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning in language models is commonly studied in the incremental learning (IL) setting, where a model learns a sequence of tasks and is evaluated through its final classifier or language-model (LM) head. This interface, however, does not indicate where forgetting occurs: a drop in accuracy may reflect representation degradation in the backbone, readout mismatch in the head, or both. We therefore argue that backward transfer (BWT) and forward transfer (FWT) should be interpreted as interface-dependent quantities rather than as single modellevel properties. We study three evaluation interfaces: the trained head, which is updated sequentially with the backbone; a probe newly trained on frozen backbone features; and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic. item.title: LeadVLA提出一种结构化多模态策略，将路线保留为显式路径参考并学习推进节奏与局部自适应残差，从而实现持续适应跟随者的机器人领行，并配套了约400万样本的数据生成基础设施LeadInfra和含108个留出回合的标准化基准LeadBench。
item.description:
LeadVLA：学习面向跟随者的路线执行以实现机器人领行

LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30149

LeadVLA提出一种结构化多模态策略，将路线保留为显式路径参考并学习推进节奏与局部自适应残差，从而实现持续适应跟随者的机器人领行，并配套了约400万样本的数据生成基础设施LeadInfra和含108个留出回合的标准化基准LeadBench。

机器人领行需要在执行路线的同时持续适应指定的跟随者。现有的机器人领行系统通常通过显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来协调对跟随者的理解与物理路线执行；而直接通过端到端轨迹预测学习这种耦合，反而可能将路线执行与跟随者响应纠缠在一起。我们提出了LeadVLA，这是一种结构化多模态策略，它将路线保留为显式的路径参考，同时学习用于路线推进的节奏，以及用于局部跟随者与场景条件自适应的残差。为了使该问题可训练、可度量，我们开发了LeadInfra——一个基于Unreal Engine的可配置闭环数据生成基础设施，并从中构建了约400万样本的训练语料库；同时开发了LeadBench——一个包含108个完全留出闭环回合的标准化基准。LeadVLA取得了最高的任务成功率（3……

arXiv:2611.30149v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes.
