item.title: 该研究提出将动作分配与图像匹配分离的评估方法，发现视觉token路由器的收益主要来自任务级的动作频率（如高分辨率使用频率）而非逐图像的精细匹配，且带有任务标签的简单任务表在准确率和速度上均优于离散路由器。
item.description:
视觉Token路由中动作分配与图像匹配的分离

Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29477

该研究提出将动作分配与图像匹配分离的评估方法，发现视觉token路由器的收益主要来自任务级的动作频率（如高分辨率使用频率）而非逐图像的精细匹配，且带有任务标签的简单任务表在准确率和速度上均优于离散路由器。

自适应视觉token路由器旨在节省计算量的同时保留回答每个问题所需的图像细节。更高的平均分数可能反映了对单张图像的更优选择，也可能是在需要高分辨率的任务上更频繁地使用高分辨率。我们通过在每个任务内保持动作数量固定，并将路由器的分配与相同动作和图像的随机配对进行比较，来区分这两种效应。在等权重的ChartQA和TextVQA上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B和-7B都从匹配中获益，但相对于任务表而言，它们从动作频率中损失更多，在7B上分别有1.71分的增益和3.95分的损失。交换外部选择器CARES所选的连续分辨率也会降低7B的质量。当请求带有任务标签到达时，任务表的得分比离散路由器高1.92分，并且每个完整的7B请求平均节省31.76毫秒。

arXiv:2611.29477v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

item.title: 本文首次将电路分析方法引入大型音乐生成模型YuE2，通过构建同歌词配对多风格的数据集和三步分析框架，揭示了音乐风格主要在乐谱规划阶段形成且是跨词元的动态表示，从而实现对音乐风格的追踪与控制。
item.description:
音乐电路：追踪并控制大型音乐生成模型中的风格动态

Music Circuit: Trace and Control Style Dynamics in Large Music Generation Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29475

本文首次将电路分析方法引入大型音乐生成模型YuE2，通过构建同歌词配对多风格的数据集和三步分析框架，揭示了音乐风格主要在乐谱规划阶段形成且是跨词元的动态表示，从而实现对音乐风格的追踪与控制。

音乐风格是一种贯穿整首乐曲的全局属性，是用户在现代大型音乐生成模型中广泛使用的控制手段。然而，风格在这些模型内部如何表示，以及由哪些组件驱动，在很大程度上仍未被探索。在语言模型中，电路分析可以将某种表示追溯到由少数关键组件（即注意力头和MLP神经元）组成的稀疏子网络，并已被成功用于解释和控制情绪等全局属性。在本工作中，我们使用电路分析来研究音乐风格背后的机制。基于YuE2，我们构建了一个将相同歌词与五种风格进行配对的数据集，并设计了一个三步框架。首先，阶段定位表明风格主要在乐谱规划阶段形成。其次，对该阶段各位置的静态观察进一步揭示，风格并非一个固定向量，而是一种跨词元的动态表示。第三，我们……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29475v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Musical style, a global attribute that functions throughout a whole piece, is a lever widely used by users in modern large music generation models. Yet how style is represented inside these models, and which components drive it, remains largely unexplored. In language models, circuit analysis traces a representation to a sparse sub-network of a few key components, namely attention heads and MLP neurons, and has been used successfully to explain and control global attributes such as emotion. In this work, we use circuit analysis to study the mechanisms behind musical style. Based on YuE2, we build a dataset that pairs the same lyrics with five styles and design a three-step framework. First, stage localization shows that the style forms mainly in the score-planning stage. item.title: 该论文提出基于二十面体群理论的RSWP水印框架，通过将SO(3)球面旋转分解为局部平面旋转和面片置换，实现了对任意视角旋转鲁棒的全景图像水印嵌入与解码。
item.description:
RSWP：面向全景图像的鲁棒SO(3)等变水印技术

RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29468

该论文提出基于二十面体群理论的RSWP水印框架，通过将SO(3)球面旋转分解为局部平面旋转和面片置换，实现了对任意视角旋转鲁棒的全景图像水印嵌入与解码。

全景图像的鲁棒水印技术一直受到球面信号与平面表示之间拓扑不匹配的阻碍。传统方法在SO(3)视角旋转下会因非线性几何形变而失效，并且在视口提取方面存在困难，这通常需要计算代价高昂的逆重映射操作。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RSWP，一个基于二十面体群理论的水印框架。利用二十面体群（I₆₀）作为SO(3)最大离散子群的性质，我们将球面旋转分解为易于处理的局部平面旋转和组合的面片置换。据此，我们引入了一种解耦架构，将水印嵌入到离散的面片中，并提出了一个具有理论保证的“等变到不变”（Equivariance-to-Invariance）解码范式。通过采用等变特征提取器，后接置换不变的排序模……

arXiv:2611.29468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. item.title: 该论文提出了一个超越最终准确率的诊断性基准与评估框架，通过评估智能体的探索行为模式并将其推理过程分解为信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计和干预下预测推理四个可解释步骤，来深入诊断LLM智能体在假设驱动实验规划中的能力。
item.description:
超越准确率：面向大语言模型智能体假设驱动实验规划的诊断性基准

Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29467

该论文提出了一个超越最终准确率的诊断性基准与评估框架，通过评估智能体的探索行为模式并将其推理过程分解为信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计和干预下预测推理四个可解释步骤，来深入诊断LLM智能体在假设驱动实验规划中的能力。

在科学任务上评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常被简化为最终任务准确率，这掩盖了推理在何处成功或失效。我们提出了一个针对封闭世界系统辨识中假设驱动自适应实验规划的基准与诊断评估框架，并以动力学机理辨识作为具体实例。该框架在两个方面超越了最终准确率的评估方式。首先，我们通过量化智能体在实验设计空间中表现出空间填充或角落聚集模式的程度来评估其探索行为。其次，我们将推理过程分解为四个可解释的步骤：信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计以及干预下的预测推理，并在推理轨迹上对每个步骤分别评分。在十个LLM智能体的实验中，我们发现更强的智能体在相关指标上优于自适应（贝叶斯优化）和非自适应（拉丁……）方法。

arXiv:2611.29467v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. item.title: 该论文提出MoR4Rec，一种基于递归混合范式的序列推荐框架，通过为不同复杂度的物品自适应分配计算深度，解决了传统Transformer对所有交互物品采用固定计算深度所导致的模型容量浪费与计算开销过高的问题。
item.description:
MoR4Rec：面向序列推荐的递归混合模型

MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29462

该论文提出MoR4Rec，一种基于递归混合范式的序列推荐框架，通过为不同复杂度的物品自适应分配计算深度，解决了传统Transformer对所有交互物品采用固定计算深度所导致的模型容量浪费与计算开销过高的问题。

arXiv:2611.29462v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：序列推荐系统旨在通过建模用户历史行为序列中的时序依赖关系来预测用户的下一次交互。为了捕捉这种依赖关系，近期的相关方法越来越依赖于基于注意力的架构，尤其是Transformer。尽管这类模型在建模长程序列模式方面十分有效，但它们对所有交互物品都施加固定的计算深度，将其视为同等复杂。然而，用户行为本质上是异构的：许多交互遵循简单、重复的模式，而另一些交互则需要建模高阶依赖关系。这种不匹配导致了模型容量的低效利用和不必要的计算开销，尤其是在基于深度Transformer的架构中。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MoR4Rec，一种基于递归混合范式的序列推荐框架，它通过共享的Transformer……（摘要截断于此）

arXiv:2611.29462v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sequential recommender systems aim to predict a user's next interaction by modeling temporal dependencies in historical behavior sequences. To capture such dependencies, recent approaches increasingly rely on attention-based architectures, particularly transformers. While effective at modeling long-range sequential patterns, these models apply a fixed computation depth to all interaction items, treating them as equally complex. However, user behavior is inherently heterogeneous, with many interactions following simple repetitive patterns, whereas others require modeling higher-order dependencies. This mismatch leads to inefficient utilization of model capacity and unnecessary computational overhead, particularly in deep transformer-based architectures. item.title: 本文提出MobileNeTTT，一种仅195万参数的轻量级神经网络，通过估计仿生知觉线索“穿越时间”（TTT）实现单目移动机器人的实时视觉导航，其模型规模比大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级。
item.description:
MobileNeTTT：一种用于视觉导航的基于轻量级深度神经网络的穿越时间估计器

MobileNeTTT: a Lightweight DNN-based Time-To-Transit Estimator for Visual Navigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29454

本文提出MobileNeTTT，一种仅195万参数的轻量级神经网络，通过估计仿生知觉线索“穿越时间”（TTT）实现单目移动机器人的实时视觉导航，其模型规模比大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级。

穿越时间是一种知觉线索，是深度的代理指标，可以在视觉皮层中计算得出，使动物能够估计越过环境中特征所需的剩余时间。我们展示了如何估计TTT并将其用于配备单目摄像头的移动机器人的仿生导航。该论文描述了一种轻量级神经网络估计方法，名为MobileNeTTT，它（1）利用整个视野并提供丰富的视觉特征TTT估计；（2）对相机旋转相对不敏感；（3）能够自动适应路径的几何形状和障碍物的存在。由于TTT是一种粗略的视觉线索，与当前大型视觉深度基础模型相比，它用于机器人导航要简单得多。我们的导航模型使用了一个仅有195万参数的网络，比知名的大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级，使其能够实时运行。

arXiv:2611.29454v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time-to-Transit (TTT) is a perceptual cue, proxy for depth, that can be computed in the visual cortex, allowing animals to estimate the time remaining to move past features in the environment. We show how TTT can be estimated and used for bio-inspired navigation of a mobile robot equipped with a monocular camera. The paper describes a lightweight neural network estimation method, named MobileNeTTT, that (1) uses the full field of view and provides a rich array of visual feature TTT estimates; (2) is relatively insensitive to camera rotation; and (3) automatically adjusts to the geometry of the path and the presence of obstacles. Because TTT is a coarse visual cue, it is far simpler to use for robot navigation than current large visual depth foundation models. Our navigation model uses a 1.95M-parameter network that is two to three orders of magnitude smaller than well-known large vision foundation models, making it able to run in real

item.title: 该论文提出一个由大语言模型演化符号策略结构、数值引擎负责参数拟合与评估的智能体库存策略发现系统，能在15,600个测试实例上自动发现优于传统简单运营公式（SOF）基准的简单库存策略模板。
item.description:
智能体驱动的简单符号化库存策略发现

Agentic Discovery of Simple Symbolic Inventory Policies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29440

该论文提出一个由大语言模型演化符号策略结构、数值引擎负责参数拟合与评估的智能体库存策略发现系统，能在15,600个测试实例上自动发现优于传统简单运营公式（SOF）基准的简单库存策略模板。

随着运营特征和系统配置的不断扩展，设计简单的库存策略变得日益困难。我们开发了一个基于明确定义的简单运营公式（SOF）策略和模板类别的智能体库存策略发现系统。大语言模型（LLM）负责修改符号结构，而数值引擎为每个实例单独拟合参数并评估由此产生的策略。多准则父代选择、状态特定的运营诊断以及可复用的符号模体共同引导结构演化。三阶段的演进过程在具有不同状态维度的实例和配置之间发展出共享模板。在覆盖50种需求分布的15,600个实例上开展的实验，涵盖了提前期、易腐性、两者的组合以及顾客耐心有限的提前期等场景。所发现的模板在总体实证表现上优于被评估的SOF基准，并且……

arXiv:2611.29440v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing simple inventory policies becomes increasingly difficult as operational features and system configurations expand. We develop an Agentic Inventory-Policy Discovery System based on explicitly defined simple operational formula (SOF) policy and template classes. Large language models (LLMs) revise symbolic structures, while a numerical engine fits parameters separately for each instance and evaluates the induced policies. Multicriteria parent selection, state-specific operational diagnostics, and reusable symbolic motifs guide structural evolution. A three-stage progression develops shared templates across instances and configurations with varying state dimensions. Experiments on 15,600 instances spanning 50 demand distributions cover lead times, perishability, their combination, and lead times with limited customer patience. The discovered templates improve aggregate empirical performance over evaluated SOF benchmarks and are

item.title: 提出HGDNA，一种采用重叠k-mer分词与混合线性注意力机制的因果基因组语言模型，仅用30M参数和19B预训练token即在序列分类和嵌入评估任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
item.description:
HGDNA：面向高效自回归基因组语言模型的重叠k-mer分词方法

HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29400

提出HGDNA，一种采用重叠k-mer分词与混合线性注意力机制的因果基因组语言模型，仅用30M参数和19B预训练token即在序列分类和嵌入评估任务上取得有竞争力的性能。

基因组语言模型领域发展迅速，在多种基因组语料库上预训练的模型展现了卓越的能力。虽然简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已被充分研究，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中仍然探索不足，尽管其蕴含丰富的邻域信息。本文全面重新审视了重叠分词，提出了HGDNA——一种采用因果语言建模预训练的混合线性注意力基因组语言模型，并配备了共享的token预测接口用于下游适配，同时使用物种分类辅助任务和共享类token。HGDNA在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中取得了有竞争力的表现，仅用30M参数和19B预训练token即可支持短程和长程任务。

arXiv:2611.29400v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

item.title: 提出了基于上下文感知多头二进制球面量化的分词器BQVAE及自回归基因组语言模型BQDNA，以极少的训练数据和计算量实现了最先进的基因组建模性能和出色的跨物种泛化能力。
item.description:
BQDNA：用于基因组序列建模的多头二进制球面量化方法

BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29395

提出了基于上下文感知多头二进制球面量化的分词器BQVAE及自回归基因组语言模型BQDNA，以极少的训练数据和计算量实现了最先进的基因组建模性能和出色的跨物种泛化能力。

从冗长且重复的DNA序列中解码生物信息仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。基因组语言模型（gLMs）通常遵循传统的语言模型预训练-适应范式。然而，由于DNA缺乏固有的语义分割和先验规则，k-mer和BPE等手工设计的分词器并非最优选择。我们提出了具有上下文感知能力的BQVAE用于DNA的标量量化，以及BQDNA——一个支持多头码本的自回归基因组语言模型。全面的实验揭示：（1）DNA空间中向量量化存在独特的训练动态，包括训练语料与下游数据对齐的重要性；（2）BQVAE的性能优于手工设计的分词器和原始VQVAE；（3）BQDNA具有显著的跨物种泛化能力，仅需0.1B参数的多物种训练用于BQVAE、以及在hg38上仅1个epoch的训练用于BQDNA，即可达到最先进的性能，超越现有基因组语言模型。

arXiv:2611.29395v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs

item.title: 该论文证明了在圈秩至少为二的图上，周期雅可比算子的格林函数在两个Perron值处均可延拓为反束缚极点，从而证明了Christiansen-Simon-Zinchenko猜想，并刻画了高斯置信传播不动点的存在条件与游走可和性阈值。
item.description:
树上的高斯置信传播与周期雅可比矩阵：谱曲线、反束缚极点与不动点

Gaussian Belief Propagation and Periodic Jacobi Matrices on Trees: Spectral Curve, Antibound Poles, and Fixed Points

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29381

该论文证明了在圈秩至少为二的图上，周期雅可比算子的格林函数在两个Perron值处均可延拓为反束缚极点，从而证明了Christiansen-Simon-Zinchenko猜想，并刻画了高斯置信传播不动点的存在条件与游走可和性阈值。

万有覆盖树上周期雅可比算子的对角格林函数满足有限连通无环基础多重图上的标量高斯置信传播协方差方程。当圈秩至少为二时，对于任意实势和非零实权重，格林函数在两个Perron值处均可延拓为简单的反束缚极点。这证明了Christiansen、Simon和Zinchenko的猜想。对于正权重，极点结果也适用于含自环的图。在无环图上，下极点即为游走可和性阈值。严格介于该阈值与谱底之间的每个能量至少存在两个具有正定局部信念的不动点。在连通简单图上，存在某些系数使得正解具有紧致分量，当且仅当该图包含两个顶点不交且圈秩至少为二的连通子图。协方差曲线在一般情况下是不可约的，每条边对应一个叶面……

arXiv:2611.29381v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diagonal Green functions of a periodic Jacobi operator on a universal covering tree satisfy the scalar Gaussian belief propagation covariance equations on the finite connected loopless base multigraph. At cycle rank at least two, the Green functions continue to simple antibound poles at both Perron values for arbitrary real potentials and nonzero real weights. This proves the conjecture of Christiansen, Simon and Zinchenko. For positive weights the pole result includes self-loops. On loopless graphs the lower pole is the walk-summability threshold. Each energy strictly between it and the spectral bottom has at least two fixed points with positive definite local beliefs. On a connected simple graph, some coefficients yield a compact component of positive solutions exactly when the graph contains two vertex-disjoint connected subgraphs of cycle rank at least two. item.title: 该论文提出MusicListenBench基准，通过FLIP/STAY成对聆听测试评估音频大模型辨别旋律、和声、音色与节奏的能力，发现绝大多数模型表现接近随机水平，表明现有音频大模型尚不能真正“听出”音乐差异。
item.description:
MusicListenBench：音频大语言模型能听出差异了吗？

MusicListenBench: Can Audio LLMs Hear the Difference Yet?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29375

该论文提出MusicListenBench基准，通过FLIP/STAY成对聆听测试评估音频大模型辨别旋律、和声、音色与节奏的能力，发现绝大多数模型表现接近随机水平，表明现有音频大模型尚不能真正“听出”音乐差异。

音频大语言模型（LLM）通常在歌曲流派、情绪和乐器配器等任务上进行评估。而一项更基础的能力是判断两个短音频片段是否演奏相同的旋律、和弦或乐器。我们提出了MusicListenBench，这是一个针对旋律、和声、音色和节奏的成对聆听测试基准。每个测试项包含两个变体：FLIP变体会改变音乐内容，因此正确答案必须改变；STAY变体仅改变声音属性（如房间回声或嘶嘶噪声），因此正确答案必须保持不变。由于两个变体具有相反的答案，任何忽略音频内容的模型无论偏好哪个选项，得分都只能达到50%。该基准包含一个训练集和两个测试集：一个由符号音乐渲染生成并带有精确标签，另一个由真实录音构建。在渲染测试集上，八个开源音频大模型中有七个的得分仅比随机水平高出4分以内。在四个商业模型中，两个GPT-Audio模型均处于随机水平，表现最好的Gemini 2.5 Pro……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29375v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Audio large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on song genre, mood, and instrumentation. A more basic skill is telling whether two short clips play the same melody, chord or instrument. We introduce MusicListenBench, a benchmark of paired listening tests for melody, harmony, timbre, and tempo. Each test item comes with two variants. A FLIP variant changes the music, so the answer must change. A STAY variant changes only the sound, such as room echo or hiss, so the answer must stay the same. The two variants have opposite answers, so a model that ignores the audio scores 50%, whatever letter it prefers. The benchmark has a training split and two test sets, one rendered from symbolic music with exact labels and one built from real recordings. On the rendered test, seven of eight open audio LLMs score within 4 points of this floor. Of four commercial models, both GPT-Audio models are at chance, and the best, Gemini 2.5 Pro, re

item.title: 提出了ChatNPC，一个能根据玩家情绪变化实时个性化回复、结合记忆提取与游戏上下文推理的游戏NPC伴侣系统，有效增强玩家沉浸感。
item.description:
面向个性化电子游戏交互的情感感知与情境锚定对话智能体

Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29372

提出了ChatNPC，一个能根据玩家情绪变化实时个性化回复、结合记忆提取与游戏上下文推理的游戏NPC伴侣系统，有效增强玩家沉浸感。

我们提出了ChatNPC，这是一个游戏伴侣系统，能够根据玩家的情绪变化实时动态地个性化其回复，以增强用户沉浸感。该模型整合了序列数据，利用数据流的动态特性，从玩家信息、语音台词和游戏内上下文中获益。我们利用大语言模型（LLM）工具调用能力的最新进展，从记忆中提取关键信息并识别潜在约束以实现准确推理，从而应对NPC对话场景的复杂性。该任务被分解为游戏哨兵引导的智能体、记忆能力以及用于推理实例化的聊天规划工具。该方法使用轻量级游戏模板作为信息框架，其中包含相关细节和完整的推理布局。我们在一个新构建的游戏内上下文NPC对话数据集上进行了大量实验，并证明ChatNPC能够依次捕获……

arXiv:2611.29372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially capture

item.title: 提出SAE-Audit方法，将开源模型上稀疏自编码器检测到的临床概念证据用于推理时优化黑盒大语言模型，从而提升临床试验结局预测的准确性和可解释性。
item.description:
SAE-Audit：通过稀疏自编码器证据审计的推理时黑盒大语言模型优化进行临床试验预测

SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29368

提出SAE-Audit方法，将开源模型上稀疏自编码器检测到的临床概念证据用于推理时优化黑盒大语言模型，从而提升临床试验结局预测的准确性和可解释性。

临床试验成本高昂且往往需要数年才能完成，因此早期结局预测对试验规划具有重要价值。大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于预测临床试验结局，但其预测仍然不可靠，且其给出的理由可能无法忠实反映其答案背后所依据的证据。在预测一项注册临床试验将顺利完成还是提前终止等任务上，前沿LLM在我们实验中的表现仅略高于随机水平。我们提出SAE-Audit方法，该方法在推理时利用从可部署的开源模型中获得的证据来优化黑盒LLM。具体而言，将Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的冻结稀疏自编码器（SAE）转换为临床概念词表，并在历史试验数据上拟合稀疏探针，以确定哪些概念与试验结局相关。对于新的试验方案，探针检测到的概念将被写成证据，每条证据都带有方向和强度（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.29368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and streng

item.title: DeciForm通过将答案空间的结构差异（分类的无序性与数值评分的有序性）融入计算与监督机制，使单一决策模型在候选选择、布尔判断和数值评分三项指标上均获得提升。
item.description:
DeciForm：将任务结构融入决策模型

DeciForm: Incorporating Task Structure into Decision Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29340

DeciForm通过将答案空间的结构差异（分类的无序性与数值评分的有序性）融入计算与监督机制，使单一决策模型在候选选择、布尔判断和数值评分三项指标上均获得提升。

决策模型在单一模型中统一了候选选择、布尔判断和数值评分三类任务。然而，它们的答案空间具有不同的结构：分类候选构成一个无序集合，而数值评分则具有内在的顺序和距离。我们提出DeciForm，将这些结构差异融入模型的计算与监督之中。无候选查询与相互隔离的候选分支支持在候选重排序下保持一致的分类结果。对数-球面目标函数用于训练候选概率，而十进制前缀读出机制则将单值监督与区间加权累积监督相结合，用于数值评分任务。共享适配器、任务私有残差以及输出通道增益支持多任务的联合适配。在一个包含15,000个请求的共享测试集上，DeciForm在Qwen和ModernBERT上提升了全部三项决策指标；经来源归一化的误差分析支持了Score任务在各类数据混合下的改进效果。

arXiv:2611.29340v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decision models unify candidate selection, Boolean judgment, and numerical scoring within a single model. Their answer spaces nevertheless carry different structures: classification candidates form an unordered set, while numerical scores have an intrinsic order and distance. We introduce Deciform, which incorporates these distinctions into computation and supervision. Candidate-free queries and isolated candidate branches support consistent classification under reordering. A log--spherical objective trains candidate probabilities, while a decimal-prefix readout combines individual-value and interval-weighted cumulative supervision for numerical scoring. Shared adapters, task-private residuals, and output-channel gains support joint adaptation. On a shared 15,000-request test set, Deciform improves all three decision metrics on Qwen and ModernBERT; source-normalized errors support the Score gains across the data mixture. Canonicalized

item.title: 本文提出“运动导向潜在推理”，将VLA模型的视觉潜在表示从刻画未来帧的静态外观转向刻画场景朝目标演化的运动过程（即动作必须引发的交互），从而显著提升机器人操作策略在场景变化下的泛化能力。
item.description:
不止于描绘未来：面向可泛化机器人操作的运动导向潜在推理

More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29339

本文提出“运动导向潜在推理”，将VLA模型的视觉潜在表示从刻画未来帧的静态外观转向刻画场景朝目标演化的运动过程（即动作必须引发的交互），从而显著提升机器人操作策略在场景变化下的泛化能力。

潜在推理使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够以显式思维链一小部分的成本进行深思熟虑，并且越来越多地通过视觉前瞻来实现——我们证明这种视觉前瞻对于预测动作是不可或缺的。然而，这一范式继承自视觉-语言模型，在其中它服务于理解而非动作：每个潜在表示与一个孤立的未来帧对齐，并常常辅以该帧的其他模态。我们发现，这会将策略绑定到训练场景的外观上，一旦场景发生变化，策略性能就会急剧下降。我们认为，用于动作的视觉潜在表示不应捕捉未来帧“看起来像什么”，而应捕捉场景“如何朝目标演化”。为此，我们提出运动导向潜在推理，将视觉潜在表示的关注点从整个帧重定向到动作必须引发的交互上。语义潜在表示遵循具身思维链的各个阶段，首先建立……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.29339v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. item.description:
EMIP：具身多方交互平台

EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29333

该论文提出了一个基于Minecraft构建的具身多方交互平台EMIP，通过客户端-服务器架构支持多个人类与多个AI智能体在同一虚拟环境中进行全双工语音交流和同步物理交互，为研究人类与具身AI智能体之间的协作提供了实验平台。

能够让多个参与者在共享环境中同时进行口语对话并执行物理动作的实验平台，对于研究人类与具身AI智能体之间的协作非常重要。在本文中，我们提出了EMIP（具身多方交互平台），一个基于Minecraft构建的虚拟环境平台。通过基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构，EMIP将多个人类和多个AI智能体连接到同一虚拟环境中，并支持全双工语音通信和同步物理交互。它提供基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的接口，用于环境观察、物理动作执行以及音频输入和输出，使研究人员能够使用大语言模型（LLM）开发自己的智能体控制方法。其他功能还包括通过单个EMIP智能体客户端对智能体群组进行集中控制、协作对象操作等。

arXiv:2611.29333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). item.title: 该论文提出FP-Prune，一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，以帧势作为互信息的理论替代来度量信息增益，通过迭代移除低信息增益令牌，在有限预算下最大化保留互补视觉信息。
item.description:
FP-Prune：从信息增益视角重新思考视觉令牌剪枝

FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29327

该论文提出FP-Prune，一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，以帧势作为互信息的理论替代来度量信息增益，通过迭代移除低信息增益令牌，在有限预算下最大化保留互补视觉信息。

视觉令牌剪枝能够降低视觉语言模型的推理成本，但其有效性取决于在有限的令牌预算下保留互补的视觉信息。一个核心挑战在于量化候选令牌在已保留集合之外所贡献的额外信息，而基于注意力或相似度的传统评分方法难以直接刻画这种贡献。在本工作中，我们从信息增益的视角重新审视视觉令牌剪枝，利用互信息来表征候选令牌的增量价值。我们进一步从理论上证明，帧势可以作为互信息的有效替代指标。基于这一观察，我们提出了FP-Prune——一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，它通过迭代移除信息增益较低的令牌，尽可能保留更多的互补视觉信息。在三个广泛使用的视觉语言模型上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29327v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. SWIFT: A Handcrafted, Arithmetic-Minimal FPGA Engine for Real-Time Audio Deepfake Detection

SWIFT是一种运算精简的手工设计FPGA引擎，在高频噪声域中利用九个定点描述子家族融合检测音频深度伪造，在八个基准测试中达到最高99.86%的准确率和低至0.03%的等错误率。

生成式语音克隆技术对基于语音的身份认证构成威胁，然而当前的深度伪造检测器依赖于高功耗、高精度模型，不适合边缘硬件。我们提出了SWIFT（流式白化整数取证信任引擎），这是一种在合成伪影集中的高频噪声域工作的手工设计检测器。一阶整数高通残差驱动九个定点描述子家族，其中包括整数提升小波倒谱分位数、马氏异常距离、庞加莱相空间几何和相位抖动，通过校准的梯度提升树和稀疏L1正则化元学习器进行融合。在泄漏控制的嵌套交叉验证下，对真实和伪造音频使用共享的预处理链，该参考模型在八个基准测试中达到高达99.86%的准确率和低至0.03%的等错误率（EER）。其整数前端和定点线性分类器运行……

arXiv:2611.29315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative voice cloning threatens voice-based authentication, yet current deepfake detectors rely on power-hungry, high-precision models unsuited to edge hardware. We present SWIFT (Streaming Whiten-Integer Forensic Trust-Engine), a handcrafted detector that works in the high-frequency noise domain where synthesis artifacts concentrate. item.title: 提出PrimiTok，一种组合式视觉分词器，通过多样化码本基元的自适应分配与加权组合来表示每个视觉标记，从而在统一视觉理解与生成时兼顾语义信息和细粒度图像细节。
item.description:
PrimiTok：学习多样化和分配基元以实现视觉分词

PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29311

提出PrimiTok，一种组合式视觉分词器，通过多样化码本基元的自适应分配与加权组合来表示每个视觉标记，从而在统一视觉理解与生成时兼顾语义信息和细粒度图像细节。

统一视觉理解与生成需要能够同时保留语义信息和细粒度图像细节的表示。主要针对语义对齐训练的连续分词器可能会遗漏细粒度的重建细节，而离散分词器则面临码本量化带来的信息损失。传统的多码本设计为每个标记分配相同数量的码字，而不管局部内容如何。我们转而将码字视为可复用的视觉基元，其分配与组合能够根据每个标记自适应调整。我们提出了PrimiTok，这是一种组合式视觉分词器，通过对学习到的码本基元进行自适应分配和加权组合来表示每个视觉标记。PrimiTok集成了两个互补的组件：多样化量化基元（DQP），它鼓励子码本中心之间的多样性以减少冗余；以及动态基元分配器（DPA），它负责选择……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.29311v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. item.title: DoppelVet 提出了一种对比式安全验证框架：在不依赖安全标签的情况下，构造一个与候选更新向验证器提供的所有信号完全匹配的替代更新，通过从同一状态在两种顺序下回放并直接比较两者行为，来识别仅凭证据本身无法区分的有害更新。
item.description:
DoppelVet：面向自我进化智能体的对比式安全验证

DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29306

DoppelVet 提出了一种对比式安全验证框架：在不依赖安全标签的情况下，构造一个与候选更新向验证器提供的所有信号完全匹配的替代更新，通过从同一状态在两种顺序下回放并直接比较两者行为，来识别仅凭证据本身无法区分的有害更新。

自我进化智能体通过将反馈保存为可复用的记忆或技能来不断改进，但每一次错误的批准都可能影响其未来许多行为。两个更新可能向验证器提供完全相同的证据，却产生截然相反的安全结果，因此验证器仅凭这些证据无法区分它们。我们提出了 DoppelVet，这是一个在提议更新进入智能体持久状态之前对其进行审查的验证框架。在无法获取安全标签的情况下，DoppelVet 会构造一个与现有验证器所使用的所有信号完全匹配的替代更新。它从同一状态回放这两个更新，并在两种呈现顺序下直接比较它们的行为，然后再决定是否保留候选更新。我们在 DoppelVet-Grid 和 DoppelVet-Tool 两个基准上评估了 DoppelVet，涵盖可执行程序和自然语言记忆两类场景。在九个开源权重及专有验证器上，DoppelVet 将平均有害更新检测 AUC 从 0……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. item.title: 本综述按时间线评估了1997-2026年间22篇最具影响力的大语言模型论文，梳理了从RNN、LSTM、Word2Vec到Transformer的关键技术演进脉络。
item.description:
从梯度消失到递归自我改进：评估大语言模型演进中最具影响力的论文（1997-2026）

From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29303

本综述按时间线评估了1997-2026年间22篇最具影响力的大语言模型论文，梳理了从RNN、LSTM、Word2Vec到Transformer的关键技术演进脉络。

大语言模型（LLM）研究的迅速激增，使得区分渐进式改进与真正的范式转变变得越来越困难。本综述评估了近三十年间（1997-2026）最具影响力的22篇出版物，并采用一种以作者出生年份（1999年）为中心的、基于因果关系的按时间顺序锚定的分类体系进行组织。从“1999年之前”开始，探讨循环神经网络（RNN）如何遗忘较早的上下文（就像读者读到第9章时早已忘记第1章的内容），我们追溯了长短期记忆网络（LSTM）如何引入一种由遗忘门、输入门和输出门构成的“门卫”机制来选择性地保留长期记忆。随后，我们考察了Word2Vec如何将语言转化为向量数学（king - male + female ≈ queen），为什么串行处理的RNN遇到了并行化的瓶颈，以及Transformer的全对全注意力权重机制如何开启了现代LLM时代，并同时带来了二次方复杂度的……

This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). item.title: 该研究发现，大型语言模型在孟加拉语和英语上的关键信息遗漏率几乎相同，但孟加拉语的关键信息完成度和完整任务成功率显著更低，表明多语言可信度评估不应只关注信息遗漏，还应衡量信息的完成质量。
item.description:
超越遗漏：测量大型语言模型在孟加拉语和英语中的关键信息完成度

Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29299

该研究发现，大型语言模型在孟加拉语和英语上的关键信息遗漏率几乎相同，但孟加拉语的关键信息完成度和完整任务成功率显著更低，表明多语言可信度评估不应只关注信息遗漏，还应衡量信息的完成质量。

对多语言可信度的评估通常只关注模型是否会遗漏用户所需的信息，我们检验了这一问题是否足够。我们使用157个匹配任务，分别以英语（EN）、自然孟加拉语（BN）以及以孟加拉语为基底、夹杂孟加拉语-英语语码转换（BN-CS）的形式编写，并对照在任何模型运行之前就已确定的必需信息单元（RIU），对来自三个模型（GPT-6.1 Sol、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 12B）的1,413个回答进行了评分。该评分方法将完全遗漏与“内容存在但不正确、不充分或仅部分满足”的情况区分开来。预先设定的主要估计量——关键遗漏率的领域等权配对差异（BN - EN）——未显示出可检测的差异（+0.003，95%置信区间为-0.014至+0.015），且所有条件下的遗漏率均接近于零。孟加拉语的差距反而体现在完成度上：孟加拉语的关键覆盖率低0.050（95%置信区间为0.022至0.079），严格的完整任务成功率低0.093。

item.title: 提出GALILEO方法，通过利用估计速度和时间偏移将每个key的3D位置以伽利略传输方式搬运到查询时刻，使几何感知旋转位置编码适配动态场景，从而在多时相输入视角下对运动物体进行准确定位与渲染。
item.description:
GALILEO：面向动态场景、基于伽利略关键点传输的几何旋转位置编码

GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29293

提出GALILEO方法，通过利用估计速度和时间偏移将每个key的3D位置以伽利略传输方式搬运到查询时刻，使几何感知旋转位置编码适配动态场景，从而在多时相输入视角下对运动物体进行准确定位与渲染。

几何感知旋转位置编码（如RayRoPE）能够帮助注意力机制理解token与查询相机之间的3D空间关系。然而，这类方法隐式假设场景是静态的，无论key是在何时被捕获的，都只在其被观测到的位置进行编码。对于具有时间上相互分离的输入视图的动态场景而言，这种不匹配会导致同一运动物体在每个输入帧中处于不同的位置，从而可能在不准确的位置被渲染出来。虽然时间编码能告知注意力机制某个token是何时被观测的，但它们无法解决该内容在查询时刻应该处于什么位置的问题。我们提出了一种简单而通用的方法，通过伽利略传输使位置编码与动态场景几何对齐。在进行位置编码之前，利用每个key的估计速度和时间偏移，将其3D位置传输到查询时刻。由于该方法仅修改key的位置，因此可以直接集成到现有的……

arXiv:2611.29293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29290

该论文通过覆盖九大基准、四个模型与近90万条轨迹的匹配因子实验，系统揭示了智能体干预（技能、框架、推理预算）之间存在交互而非简单叠加效应，并证明应根据系统遗留的失败类型（知识缺失对应更强模型、执行错误对应更丰富框架）来选择修复手段。

一项能改善某个智能体的干预措施可能会破坏另一个智能体，而在此基础上叠加更强的框架也未必能修复损害。技能、框架和额外推理预算等智能体干预措施，通常只被归功于在单一设置下测得的一个平均增益。我们转而追问：每种干预何时有效，以及它究竟修复了哪种失败。一项匹配的因子分析研究涵盖九个基准、四个模型、四种技能条件、四个框架层级和三种预算，共近90万条轨迹，每次只改变一个维度。结果显示：没有哪种配置在所有情况下都是最优的；干预措施之间是相互作用而非简单叠加；框架可能吸收技能的增益、挽救技能导致的失败，或使增益保持不变。当前系统遗留的失败类型指向了对应的修复手段：知识缺失应换用更强的模型，执行错误应采用更丰富的框架。然而反馈并不等于恢复：匹配的恢复机制主要修复的是那些留下可见……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29290v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. Yet feedback is not recovery: a matched recovery repairs mainly failures that leave a visib

item.title: 研究通过对比实验发现，基于RAG检索增强的领域接地方法在提升大语言模型生成狗狗护理建议的准确性方面显著优于LoRA参数高效微调。
item.description:
基于大语言模型的狗狗护理指导助手

LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29286

研究通过对比实验发现，基于RAG检索增强的领域接地方法在提升大语言模型生成狗狗护理建议的准确性方面显著优于LoRA参数高效微调。

本研究探讨了通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行领域接地以及使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效微调，能否提升大语言模型（LLM）生成的宠物护理建议的准确性和可靠性。我们精心构建了一个包含特定品种狗狗护理信息的数据集，并基于该数据集开发了两个系统：一个基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG管道，以及一个使用LoRA适配的微调LLaMA-3.2-1B模型。两个系统在15个狗狗护理问题上进行了评估。RAG模型获得了2.0的满分平均分，优于微调模型（平均分=1.47）。统计分析结果，包括Welch's t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验（均p < 0.05），证实了该性能差距的统计显著性。我们的研究结果表明，在专业领域（宠物护理）中，基于检索的领域接地比单独进行微调能够产生更准确、更一致且更值得信赖的回答。

arXiv:2611.29286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in speciali

item.title: QASparse提出了一种查询自适应的稀疏注意力机制，在保留跨头共享重要性估计效率的同时，根据查询需求动态定制计算预算与令牌选择，并借助专用内核高效执行，从而加速大模型长序列预填充推理。
item.description:
QASparse：具有定制预算与令牌的查询自适应稀疏注意力

QASparse: Query-Adaptive Sparse Attention with Tailored Budgets and Tokens

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29280

QASparse提出了一种查询自适应的稀疏注意力机制，在保留跨头共享重要性估计效率的同时，根据查询需求动态定制计算预算与令牌选择，并借助专用内核高效执行，从而加速大模型长序列预填充推理。

大型语言模型中的长序列推理受到预填充阶段高成本的制约，其中密集注意力的计算量随上下文长度呈二次方增长。利用注意力头之间的相似性提供了一种减少冗余计算的途径。此前这一方向的方法依赖于局部的查询观测来确定头级别的计算复用或预算分配。然而，头间相似性并不意味着各查询区域具有统一的需求，因此如何适应不同查询区域变化的预算需求和令牌选择偏好成为一个关键挑战。我们提出了QASparse，一种具备硬件高效执行能力的查询自适应稀疏注意力机制。QASparse在保留共享跨头重要性估计效率的同时，使计算预算和令牌选择适应查询需求，并通过专用内核执行这些动态稀疏决策。其查询自适应性源于两个（内容在此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.29280v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-sequence inference in large language models is constrained by the high cost of prefilling, where dense attention scales quadratically with context length. Exploiting similarity across attention heads offers a way to reduce redundant computation. Prior approaches in this direction have relied on localized query observations to determine head-level computation reuse or budget allocation. However, inter-head similarity does not imply uniform query requirements, leaving adaptation to varying budget needs and selection preferences across query regions a key challenge. We introduce QASparse, a Query-Adaptive Sparse attention mechanism with hardware-efficient execution. QASparse preserves the efficiency of shared cross-head importance estimation while adapting computational budgets and token selections to query requirements, and it executes these dynamic sparse decisions through dedicated kernels. item.title: 提出了预先注册的基准DriveOddsBench，通过汇总真实结果在模型采样样本中的排名，检验驾驶视频世界模型采样分布是否与现实世界概率对齐。
item.description:
DriveOddsBench：驾驶视频世界模型是否与现实世界概率对齐？

DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29275

提出了预先注册的基准DriveOddsBench，通过汇总真实结果在模型采样样本中的排名，检验驾驶视频世界模型采样分布是否与现实世界概率对齐。

视频世界模型预测场景将如何演变，其采样出的未来正被越来越多地用作真实未来的替代品，应用范围涵盖从规划到仿真。这些应用假设采样结果与现实世界的概率分布对齐，即每个未来在采样中出现的频率应与它在现实中跟随相同历史时出现的频率一致，然而目前的评估只对每个样本看起来有多真实进行打分。在真实驾驶数据上检验这一假设面临三个困难：每段记录的历史只有一个真实的未来，因此真实概率未知；物理量必须从视频中读取，读取误差可能被误认为模型误差；此外，多种可能的分析方式容易导致选择性报告。我们提出了DriveOddsBench，一个预先注册的基准，同时解决上述三个问题。首先，如果样本符合真实分布，那么真实结果在样本中的排名在每个历史下都应均匀分布，因此将排名汇总即可在无需概率标签的情况下检验模型（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29275v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video world models predict how a scene will evolve, and their sampled futures are increasingly used in place of the real one, from planning to simulation. These uses assume that the samples are aligned with real-world odds, with each future appearing among them as often as it would follow the same history in reality, yet current evaluations only score how real each sample looks. Testing this assumption on real driving data is hard for three reasons. Each recorded history has only one real future, so the true probabilities are unknown. Physical quantities must be read from video, where reading errors can look like model errors. Finally, the many possible analyses invite selective reporting. We introduce DriveOddsBench, a pre-registered benchmark that addresses all three. item.title: MetaSkill提出一个双层框架，通过选择并实例化可复用的问题解决方法来引导LLM智能体自适应地编排技能，在SkillsBench和ToolHop基准上相比最强基线准确率提升3.51%-13.48%。
item.description:
MetaSkill：面向LLM智能体自适应技能编排的可复用问题解决方法

MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29274

MetaSkill提出一个双层框架，通过选择并实例化可复用的问题解决方法来引导LLM智能体自适应地编排技能，在SkillsBench和ToolHop基准上相比最强基线准确率提升3.51%-13.48%。

可复用技能提供了专门化的操作流程，但大语言模型（LLM）智能体仍需自行决定如何组织和调整这些技能的使用。我们提出了MetaSkill，一个跨任务、跨领域复用问题解决方法的双层框架。方法层从26个精选方法中进行选择，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象上。执行层利用实例化的方法来识别中间目标、协调原生技能，并引导修复或方法重选。在89个SkillsBench任务和995个ToolHop示例上，MetaSkill在全部六种配置中均优于所评估的基线方法，相比最强基线准确率提升3.51%-13.48%。消融实验表明，显式的方法引导编排优于直接方法注入，且方法重选能带来进一步提升。

arXiv:2611.29274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

item.title: 提出DUET算法，将持续学习中的训练后参数调整形式化为双重约束优化问题，通过同时施加新旧任务的雅可比零空间约束进行双向投影，更好地兼顾新任务学习与旧任务记忆。
item.description:
持续学习中的双重约束参数投影

Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29269

提出DUET算法，将持续学习中的训练后参数调整形式化为双重约束优化问题，通过同时施加新旧任务的雅可比零空间约束进行双向投影，更好地兼顾新任务学习与旧任务记忆。

持续学习要求模型在顺序学习多个新任务的同时，保持对先前任务的性能。在新任务上进行无约束训练后，将模型参数投影到先前任务的雅可比零空间上，已成为一种有效的范式。然而，单向投影仅仅最小化参数与新任务最优解之间的距离，而忽略了新任务的损失景观。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了DUET，一种双向投影算法，它在训练后投影过程中同时施加来自先前任务和新任务的雅可比零空间约束。具体而言，DUET将训练后调整表述为一个双重约束优化问题：它最小化新任务训练前后参数之间的距离，同时满足对两个任务的损失保持约束。为了求解该优化问题，我们开发了一种交替双向投影算法……

arXiv:2611.29269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algo

item.title: 该论文通过提取模型内部潜在置信度的线性方向，实现了对推理模型在答案提案处是回溯还是接受答案的预测，揭示了内部不确定性表征与冗长回溯式思维链之间的联系。
item.description:
论推理模型中回溯行为与潜在置信度方向之间的相互作用

On the Interplay between Backtracking and Latent Confidence Directions in Reasoning Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29265

该论文通过提取模型内部潜在置信度的线性方向，实现了对推理模型在答案提案处是回溯还是接受答案的预测，揭示了内部不确定性表征与冗长回溯式思维链之间的联系。

推理模型会对多个答案提案进行反复推敲，这常常因回溯行为而导致推理轨迹过长，即使模型其实已经得到了正确答案（在三个32B模型中，约87%的生成轨迹仅包含1个独特答案，但平均仍会做出约8个答案提案）。鉴于这种可能属于“装饰性”的思维链（CoT）推理，我们能否通过观察模型内部状态来判断模型接下来是会回溯还是会接受某个答案提案？基于模型对其不确定性保有内部表征这一假设，我们尝试提取该表征，并刻画其与答案提案处回溯行为之间的关系。通过在整个响应轨迹中查询模型在给出答案提案后口头表达的置信度，我们提取出了一个潜在置信度的线性方向，该方向能够有效区分高置信度与低置信度的口头表达。这一方向可以调控口头表达的置信度……

arXiv:2611.29265v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reasoning models deliberate over multiple answer proposals, often resulting in excessively long traces due to backtracking, even when the correct answer has already been reached (Across three 32B models, ~87% of rollouts contain 1 unique answer yet still make ~8 answer proposals on average). Given this potentially "decorative" chain of thought (CoT) reasoning, can we look to the model internals to determine if the model will backtrack or commit to an answer proposal? Operating under the hypothesis that models maintain an internal representation of their uncertainty, we seek to extract this representation and characterize its relationship with backtracking behavior at answer proposals. By querying the model's verbalized confidence following answer proposals throughout a response trace, we extract a linear direction for latent confidence that separates high and low verbalized confidence. This direction can steer verbalized confidence as

item.title: 该论文提出神经智能体编译器（NAC），一种学习型调度器，通过预测三种执行模式对任务质量和资源的后果，在调度边界选择效用最高的合法执行模式，从而首次将智能体执行中的软依赖调度作为重要问题加以解决。
item.description:
神经智能体编译器：学习调度软依赖

Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29262

该论文提出神经智能体编译器（NAC），一种学习型调度器，通过预测三种执行模式对任务质量和资源的后果，在调度边界选择效用最高的合法执行模式，从而首次将智能体执行中的软依赖调度作为重要问题加以解决。

大型语言模型智能体通过协调多个推理步骤和工具操作来完成复杂任务，这些步骤和操作之间形成了依赖关系。现有的编排方法主要考虑硬依赖（即决定操作何时可以合法开始的关系），但忽略了软依赖，即那些并非执行所必需、但可能改进已可执行操作的信息。我们将软依赖调度确定为智能体执行中的一个重要问题。为此，我们提出了神经智能体编译器（NAC），这是一个学习型调度器，它能够预测三种执行模式对任务质量和资源的影响，并在调度边界处选择效用最高的合法模式。NAC 在共享内存中表示可执行的后续操作、待处理的信息事件和资源状态，并使用效用函数使后果预测适应不同的资源偏好。在 AppWorld

arXiv:2611.29262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model agents accomplish complex tasks by coordinating multiple reasoning steps and tool operations, which form dependencies among their operations. Existing orchestration methods primarily consider hard dependencies that determine when an operation can legally begin, but overlook soft dependencies, i.e., information that is not required for execution but may improve an already executable operation. We identify soft-dependency scheduling as an important problem in agent execution. To this end, we introduce Neural Agent Compiler (NAC), a learned scheduler that predicts the task-quality and resource consequences of three execution modes and selects the highest-utility legal mode at a scheduling boundary. NAC represents the executable continuation, pending information event, and resource state in a shared memory, and uses a utility function to adapt the consequence predictions to different resource preferences. Across AppWorld

item.title: 本文提出基于反事实世界模型的策略梯度估计器REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），通过将观测轨迹变换为替代动作的结果、并以反事实回报作为基线来区分动作效应与环境运气、降低梯度估计方差，从而提升复杂随机环境中的强化学习效果。
item.description:
回顾：基于反事实世界模型的强化学习

Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29259

本文提出基于反事实世界模型的策略梯度估计器REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），通过将观测轨迹变换为替代动作的结果、并以反事实回报作为基线来区分动作效应与环境运气、降低梯度估计方差，从而提升复杂随机环境中的强化学习效果。

复杂随机环境中的智能体必须应对可能超出其世界模型预测能力的环境动力学，以及掩盖其动作真实后果的随机性。我们假设，与在这种复杂环境中凭空想象全新轨迹相比，用替代动作对已观测到的轨迹进行变换可能更容易。反事实世界模型以观测为条件，在相同的环境随机性下预测替代动作的结果，利用已有经验作为参考来预测动作相关的变化。我们提出了一种策略梯度估计器——REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），它使用反事实回报作为基线，以区分动作效应与环境运气，并证明了其无偏性和方差缩减的条件。在环境演化比动作引起的变化更难预测的场景中，我们表明反事实世界模型更容易学习（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.29259v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions. We hypothesize that, compared to imagining entirely new trajectories in such complex environments, it can be easier to transform observed trajectories with alternative actions. Counterfactual world models condition on observations to predict alternative outcomes under the same underlying environmental randomness, using experience as a reference for predicting action-dependent changes. We present a policy gradient estimator, REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), that uses counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck, and prove conditions for unbiasedness and variance reduction. In settings where environmental evolution is harder to predict than action-induced changes, we show that counterfactual world models are easie

item.title: 本研究通过固定癫痫检测流程、仅更换预处理阶段的审计实验，发现涵盖解析、跨通道和有监督深度学习的五种主流EEG去噪方法均无法改善甚至恶化下游任务性能，并指出以“干净参考波形”为保真度目标的去噪评价体系本身是无法验证的无效目标。
item.description:
去噪却未获改善：EEG去噪对下游任务的影响

Denoised but Not Improved: What EEG Denoising Does to a Downstream Task

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29256

本研究通过固定癫痫检测流程、仅更换预处理阶段的审计实验，发现涵盖解析、跨通道和有监督深度学习的五种主流EEG去噪方法均无法改善甚至恶化下游任务性能，并指出以“干净参考波形”为保真度目标的去噪评价体系本身是无法验证的无效目标。

头皮脑电图（EEG）在进入下游模型之前通常都会进行去噪处理，而去噪文献以方法输出与干净参考波形的接近程度来评价方法优劣。然而，对于真实的头皮记录而言，这种参考波形并不存在：它是通过将伪迹模板添加到仅被假定为干净的信号上合成而来的，而且即使能够实现完全精确的分离，得到的也只会是被容积传导效应模糊化的皮层活动，而非活动本身。因此，对这种参考波形的保真度是一个无法验证的目标，而它是否能带来任何下游收益在很大程度上未被检验过。我们报告了一项对此进行审查的审计研究。在保持癫痫检测流程不变、仅改变预处理阶段的情况下，我们发现五种标准去噪方法——涵盖解析类、跨通道类和有监督深度学习类方法——均未能优于未经处理的信号，且大多数方法反而使其性能下降。为了阐明这样的预处理阶段应当做什么，我们形式化了……

item.title: NoeVera是一个智能体式“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准与实验结果整合为保留来源、持久化的三层知识库，通过决策感知检索、角色化智能体推理与模拟器调用，构建“知识指导实验、实验反哺知识”的闭环，以优化LLM服务系统的科研决策。
item.description:
NoeVera：知识能否指导实验，实验又能否反哺知识？

NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29255

NoeVera是一个智能体式“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准与实验结果整合为保留来源、持久化的三层知识库，通过决策感知检索、角色化智能体推理与模拟器调用，构建“知识指导实验、实验反哺知识”的闭环，以优化LLM服务系统的科研决策。

随着对大语言模型（LLM）服务需求的日益增长，优化LLM服务系统正变得愈发复杂，瓶颈已不再是预测给定配置的性能表现。更困难的问题在于决定要研究什么：对于某个工作负载，哪些机制至关重要、哪些配置值得测试、以及一项决策还需要什么证据。在本工作中，我们提出了NoeVera，一个超越单次检索的智能体式“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果转化为一个持久化且保留来源可追溯性的知识库，该知识库包含三个层面：源证据、可复用的综合知识以及智能体记忆。决策感知检索会组装紧凑的证据包，各角色的专属智能体对这些证据进行推理，并在需要定量支持时调用模拟器（Vidur或GAUSS），而每项发现都会作为带有作用域的证据记录写回知识库，从而使知识能够指导实验。

arXiv:2611.29255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments

item.title: 本文将制图学中的蒂索指标创新性地应用于位置编码器，仅通过编码器输出（无需访问模型内部）拟合椭圆张量，从而量化和刻画学习型地理嵌入中的局部各向异性畸变。
item.description:
用于位置编码器的蒂索指标：表征学习型地理嵌入中的局部畸变

Tissot indicatrix for location encoders: Characterizing local distortion in learned geographic embeddings

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29249

本文将制图学中的蒂索指标创新性地应用于位置编码器，仅通过编码器输出（无需访问模型内部）拟合椭圆张量，从而量化和刻画学习型地理嵌入中的局部各向异性畸变。

随着地理人工智能的日益普及，位置编码器被广泛用于将地理坐标映射为学习到的嵌入向量，以支持地球观测和地理空间建模等任务。与地图投影类似，位置编码器可能会使地理空间发生畸变，即不同方向上等距离的位移会导致不相等的嵌入变化。然而，这种畸变在很大程度上尚未被研究，并且可能会传播到下游应用中。我们改造了蒂索指标——一种用于刻画地图投影畸变的制图学工具——来表征这种畸变。在每个位置上，我们比较编码器在32个方向上等距离处的输出，并拟合一个张量（用一个椭圆表示），其拉伸程度（各向异性）和方向描述了局部畸变。该拟合仅需要编码器的输出，无需访问模型内部结构，并通过与具有已知几何特性的参考进行对比得到了验证。

arXiv:2611.29249v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: With the increasing adoption of geographic artificial intelligence, location encoders are widely used to map geographic coordinates to learned embeddings for tasks in Earth observation and geospatial modeling. Similar to map projections, location encoders can distort geographic space, that is, equal-distance displacements in different directions can result in unequal embedding changes. However, such distortion remains largely unexamined, and it can propagate into downstream applications. We adapt Tissot's indicatrix, a cartographic tool for map projection distortion, to characterize this distortion. At each location, we compare encoder outputs at equal distances in 32 directions and fit a tensor, represented by an ellipse, whose elongation (anisotropy) and orientation describe the local distortion. The fit requires only encoder outputs without access to model internals and is validated against references with known geometry. By applyin

看见不等于行动：WARD 诊断纵向临床智能体中“证据-状态-行动”的差距

Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents

WARD 是一个纵向临床智能体评测基准，通过 4,560 个临床任务和纵向、交互两条赛道，系统诊断了模型在“证据识别→患者状态判断→及时安全行动”链条中的能力差距。

用于纵向临床护理的大语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累而不断修正其评估和行动。然而，以孤立响应或最终任务结果为中心的基准测试，对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择等中间环节的失败所提供的洞察十分有限。我们提出了 WARD，一个用于评估临床智能体如何将不断积累的证据转化为患者状态判断以及及时、安全行动的基准。WARD 包含覆盖七个临床输出领域的 4,560 个临床任务，这些任务被组织成来自 40 条纵向临床轨迹（跨越 95 次住院）的 240 个检查点。其纵向赛道在受控的累积证据条件下评估这些任务；其交互式赛道则评估端到端的、由工具介导的临床管理，涵盖 271 个可验证的证据项目和 141 个参考状态转变。在 12 个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别一致……（摘要在此处截断）

GameAnything：从任意灵感创造可玩的游戏世界

该论文提出了开源智能体平台GameAnything及其配套基准GameAnything-Bench，可将多模态灵感素材通过迭代开发转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展，并同时评估功能正确性与实际游戏体验质量。

AI驱动的游戏开发具有将多样化的人类灵感转化为互动体验的潜力。然而，现有系统和基准主要聚焦于明确的开发规范，对适配多模态参考素材以及评估实际游戏体验的支持有限。我们提出了GameAnything，一个开源的智能体平台，能够通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。GameAnything将代码生成智能体与独立的试玩评审智能体、持久化的开发状态以及可复用的经验记忆相结合，以支持持续的迭代改进。我们进一步提出了GameAnything-Bench基准，涵盖多样化的参考模态、游戏创作目标和游戏环境，并通过探索性试玩测试来同时评估功能正确性与游戏体验质量。对九种代码生成智能体配置的评估显示……

arXiv:2611.29238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. item.title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，将容量控制高斯瓶颈编码器、带AR-DiT头的LLM、流匹配解码器与多任务识别模型相结合，在保留声学细节与保证自回归可预测性之间取得平衡，摆脱了传统方法中潜空间需预先学习并冻结的限制。

Tenlai-TTS 2.0：基于端到端训练的连续表示大语言模型语音合成系统

Tenlai-TTS 2.0: Continuous-Representation LLM-Based TTS System with End-to-End Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29226

Tenlai-TTS 2.0通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，将容量控制高斯瓶颈编码器、带AR-DiT头的LLM、流匹配解码器与多任务识别模型相结合，在保留声学细节与保证自回归可预测性之间取得平衡，摆脱了传统方法中潜空间需预先学习并冻结的限制。

基于连续语音潜变量的自回归文本转语音（TTS）避免了量化引起的信息损失，但通常依赖于一个单独学习并在语言模型训练之前被冻结的潜空间。这样的潜空间必须满足两个相互冲突的要求：既要保留足够的声学细节以实现高保真重建，又要具备足够的结构化和正则化特性以支持语言模型的自回归预测。我们提出了Tenlai-TTS 2.0，它通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，以平衡声学细节与自回归可预测性。该模型由以下部分组成：一个具有容量控制高斯瓶颈的语音编码器、一个带有自回归扩散变换器（AR-DiT）头的大语言模型（LLM）、一个流匹配（FM）梅尔频谱图解码器，以及一个多任务识别模型（RM）。通过能量归一化和固定方差高斯噪声，该……

arXiv:2611.29226v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) with continuous speech latents avoids quantization-induced information loss, but typically relies on a latent space that is learned separately and then frozen before language-model training. Such a space must satisfy two competing requirements: it must retain enough acoustic detail for high-fidelity reconstruction, yet be sufficiently structured and regularized to support autoregressive prediction by a language model. We present Tenlai-TTS 2.0, which learns continuous speech representations through end-to-end training to balance acoustic detail with autoregressive predictability. The model comprises a speech encoder with a capacity-controlled Gaussian bottleneck, a large language model (LLM) with an autoregressive diffusion transformer (AR-DiT) head, a flow-matching (FM) mel-spectrogram decoder, and a multi-task recognition model (RM). item.description:
Ego-HMB：基于运动桥接扩散模型从自视角图像实现人体运动桥接

Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29218

提出Ego-HMB统一扩散框架，仅凭两张第一人称自视角图像即可生成连贯的3D人体运动序列，摆脱了传统方法对结构化3D端点姿态的依赖。

我们提出了“自视角人体运动桥接”这一任务，即从两张端点自视角图像生成连贯的3D人体运动序列。与传统运动补全需要结构化的3D端点姿态不同，该设定使用VR/AR和机器人领域中可穿戴设备所能提供的原始第一人称观测。由于视角变化、人体部分可见性以及跨模态端点约束下的时间模糊性，该任务充满挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Ego-HMB，一个统一的基于扩散模型的框架，通过两个训练阶段在单一模型中同时学习端点姿态估计与时间一致的运动填充。第一阶段“自视角到规范空间预训练”采用逐步增大时间跨度的层级课程，以强化端点姿态先验；第二阶段“运动桥接扩散训练”融合了端点感知与物理感知，从邻……

arXiv:2611.29218v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. item.title: 提出单轨迹强化学习算法DFPO，无需依赖稀疏终端奖励和重复采样即可直接训练AI编程代理，在同等条件下任务解决率超过GSPO。
item.description:
面向AI编程代理的直接反馈策略优化

Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29193

提出单轨迹强化学习算法DFPO，无需依赖稀疏终端奖励和重复采样即可直接训练AI编程代理，在同等条件下任务解决率超过GSPO。

AI编程代理通过多轮交互来生成、修改和验证代码。现有的强化学习方法通常依赖稀疏的终端奖励，这使得难以评估中间决策对任务结果的影响，且组相对类方法还需要对每个任务进行重复采样。我们提出了直接反馈策略优化（DFPO），这是一种单轨迹强化学习算法，能够直接从单条轨迹中进行训练。在相同的基础模型和执行框架条件下，DFPO取得了比GSPO更高的任务解决率。

arXiv:2611.29193v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

item.title: loopxDINO以冻结的DINOv2骨干网络配合紧凑的权重绑定循环交叉注意力解码器，用迭代潜在推理取代深层堆叠解码器，以不到15M的可训练参数实现高效的密集视觉预测，同时显著降低内存开销与计算冗余。
item.description:
loopxDINO：通过迭代潜在推理实现密集视觉预测

loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29180

loopxDINO以冻结的DINOv2骨干网络配合紧凑的权重绑定循环交叉注意力解码器，用迭代潜在推理取代深层堆叠解码器，以不到15M的可训练参数实现高效的密集视觉预测，同时显著降低内存开销与计算冗余。

标准的密集视觉预测架构通过堆叠深层前馈解码器（6-16层transformer，参数量5000万至2亿）来扩展表示能力。这种显式的层堆叠在反向传播期间带来大量的激活内存开销，需要高片外内存带宽以支持非权重绑定的参数，并采用无法适应图像空间复杂度的静态计算分配方式。我们提出loopxDINO，用迭代潜在推理取代物理上的解码器深度。它包含两个解耦的组件：（1）一个冻结的DINOv2-Base骨干网络，通过单次前向传播提取空间特征，并将静态的Key-Value表示缓存至GPU内存；（2）一个紧凑的、权重绑定的循环交叉注意力解码器（核心参数仅7.96M，可训练参数总计14.85M），在T次迭代中循环更新查询向量。循环过程通过步数条件化的adaLN、基于LayerNorm的超椭球流形正则化（摘要在此处截断）加以稳定。

arXiv:2611.29180v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard dense visual prediction architectures scale representation capacity by stacking deep feedforward decoders (6-16 transformer layers with 50M-200M parameters). This explicit layer stacking brings substantial activation memory overhead during backpropagation, requires high off-chip memory bandwidth for non-tied weights, and uses static computational allocation that cannot adapt to spatial image complexity. We propose loopxDINO, which replaces physical decoder depth with iterative latent reasoning. It has two decoupled components: (1) a frozen DINOv2-Base backbone extracting spatial features in one forward pass and caching static Key-Value representations in GPU memory; (2) a compact weight-tied Looped Cross-Attention Decoder (7.96M core, 14.85M total trainable parameters) that recurrently updates queries across T iterations. item.title: 本文研究了深度强化学习中一个悬而未决的基本问题——如何在资格迹算法中使用自适应向量步长，提出了一种不依赖经验回放缓冲区的流式学习方法。
item.description:
深度强化学习中资格迹的自适应步长研究

On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29178

本文研究了深度强化学习中一个悬而未决的基本问题——如何在资格迹算法中使用自适应向量步长，提出了一种不依赖经验回放缓冲区的流式学习方法。

许多深度强化学习（RL）算法将智能体与环境的交互存储在经验回放缓冲区中，之后通过从中采样转移数据来进行学习。然而，这种方法可能在内存使用上效率低下，并且会延迟学习，因为智能体只有在缓冲区采样到某个转移数据时才能从中学习。此外，这些方法大多使用单步或短多步时序差分（TD）更新，这在信用分配方面速度较慢。另一种方法是在观测数据流到达时直接从中学习，而不依赖缓冲区。资格迹算法允许这种增量式更新，并且能够在多步上进行信用分配。这些算法在线性函数逼近时代很常见，但直到最近才被应用于深度强化学习。一些基本问题，例如如何在深度强化学习设置中将向量步长与资格迹结合使用，仍然悬而未决。在这项工作中，我们首先表明自适应向量步长必须……

arXiv:2611.29178v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms store agent-environment interactions in a replay buffer and later learn by sampling transitions from it. However, this approach can be memory-inefficient and can delay learning because the agent can learn from a transition only when the buffer samples it. Additionally, most of these methods use one-step or short multi-step temporal-difference (TD) updates, which are slow at credit assignment. An alternative approach is to learn from the stream of observations as they arrive without relying on a buffer. Eligibility-trace algorithms allow these incremental updates and can also assign credit over many steps. These algorithms were common with linear function approximation but have only recently been used in deep RL. Basic questions, such as how to use vector step sizes with eligibility traces in the deep RL setting, remain open. In this work, we first show that adaptive vector step sizes mus

item.title: 该研究发现，循环Transformer要实现超出训练长度的泛化，仅有循环机制并不足够——原子化（单token）的操作表示是关键，而多token模板表示和绝对位置编码会严重限制长度外推能力。
item.description:
《什么使循环结构能够跨长度泛化？》

What Makes Recurrence Generalize Across Lengths?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29171

该研究发现，循环Transformer要实现超出训练长度的泛化，仅有循环机制并不足够——原子化（单token）的操作表示是关键，而多token模板表示和绝对位置编码会严重限制长度外推能力。

多步推理要求模型在计算展开的过程中保存并更新中间信息。状态追踪正是对这一基本需求的刻画，但在固定范围的状态转移内表现良好的模型，在需要远超训练范围的更多更新时可能无法泛化。循环Transformer通过反复应用共享的Transformer块，为应对这一挑战提供了天然的机制，使计算能够随问题长度而扩展。我们在一个受控的状态追踪任务中研究这种循环计算何时能够泛化到训练范围之外，并变化了操作表示、位置编码和循环容量等因素。我们发现，仅有循环机制是不够的：多token模板表示和绝对位置编码会严重限制外推能力，而原子化的操作表示则能带来显著更强的长度泛化。位置结构的影响……

arXiv:2611.29171v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-step reasoning requires models to preserve and update intermediate information as computation unfolds. State tracking captures this fundamental requirement, but models that succeed within a fixed range of state transitions may not generalize when substantially more updates are required. Recurrent Transformers offer a natural mechanism for addressing this challenge by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, allowing computation to scale with problem length. We study when such recurrent computation generalizes beyond the training range in a controlled state-tracking task, varying operation representation, positional encoding, and recurrent capacity. We find that recurrence alone is insufficient: multi-token template representations and absolute positional encoding can severely limit extrapolation, whereas atomic operation representations enable substantially stronger length generalization. item.title: 研究发现，引入商业检查器CodeAssure等外部反馈（报告违规位置和修复目标）能大幅提升AI编程智能体修复项目规则违规的成功率，使更小更便宜的模型（修复率从26%升至69%）接近甚至逼近大型模型的修复效果。
item.description:
修复还是删除？外部反馈让更便宜的AI编程智能体修复规则违规

Fixed or Deleted? External Feedback Lets Cheaper AI Coding Agents Repair Rule Violations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29162

研究发现，引入商业检查器CodeAssure等外部反馈（报告违规位置和修复目标）能大幅提升AI编程智能体修复项目规则违规的成功率，使更小更便宜的模型（修复率从26%升至69%）接近甚至逼近大型模型的修复效果。

摘要：许多缺陷违反了代码本身无法反映的项目规则，例如分层约束或必需的测试。我们研究了当外部检查器报告这些违规及其位置和修复目标时，LLM编程智能体是否能更好地修复此类违规。由AI智能体驱动的三个模型（小型、中型和大型模型）处理了十个开源项目中25个包含31个植入缺陷的拉取请求，外加5个正确的对照组，分别在无外部反馈和结合商业检查器CodeAssure（CA）检测结果的条件下各运行五次。我们还将结果与GitHub Copilot代码审查进行比较，并将CodeAssure的检测能力与九个开箱即用的免费静态分析工具（包括Semgrep和SonarQube Community）进行对比。只有当修复后的代码能够编译并保留原有功能时，该次运行才被计为成功修复。实验结果显示，CA的检测结果使最小模型的修复率从26%提升至69%，中型模型从46%提升至90%，大型模型从45%提升至93%。

arXiv:2611.29162v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many defects violate project rules that the code itself does not reveal, such as layering constraints or required tests. We study whether LLM coding agents repair such violations better when an external checker reports them, with their location and a repair goal. Three models, a small, medium and large model, driven by an AI agent, worked on 25 pull requests with 31 planted defects in ten open-source projects, plus 5 correct controls, five times alone and five times with findings from CodeAssure (CA), a commercial checker. We also compare with GitHub Copilot code review, and compare CodeAssure's detection with nine free static-analysis tools run out of the box, including Semgrep and SonarQube Community. Counting a run as repaired only when the repaired code also compiles and keeps its feature, CA findings raised the repair rate from 26% to 69% for the smallest model, from 46% to 90% for the medium model and from 45% to 93% for the larg

item.title: 提出ContextFact方法，通过在记忆构建阶段保留事实的局部上下文并分离组织跨会话证据，改进长期对话智能体的事实记忆与证据检索效果。
item.description:
ContextFact：面向长期对话智能体的上下文事实记忆

ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29155

提出ContextFact方法，通过在记忆构建阶段保留事实的局部上下文并分离组织跨会话证据，改进长期对话智能体的事实记忆与证据检索效果。

基于大语言模型构建的智能体必须在与用户的多次重复交互中保持连续性。然而，长期对话中的事实分散在各个对话轮次和会话之间，使得难以检索到带有足够上下文的正确证据。因此，此类对话的记忆系统必须在保存事实的同时保留其上下文，并使证据能够被有选择地访问。我们首先研究了记忆构建方式与检索单元边界如何影响问题的可回答性和证据的可访问性。通过阅读整个记忆库，我们发现存在仅靠检索选择无法弥补的缺口，这表明在记忆构建过程中必须保留部分上下文。在相同的唯一轮次预算下，相邻轮次分组能够提升证据的可访问性，而更宽的窗口并不能持续带来帮助。这促使我们将事实特定的上下文保留在局部，同时将跨会话的证据分开组织。我们提出了ContextFact，它将保留上下文的事实记忆（与跨会话证据组织相链接）……

arXiv:2611.29155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact mem

item.title: 提出免训练的多视频理解框架MVAgent，通过为每个视频配备独立的LocalAgent处理观察决策，并由GlobalAgent协调跨视频推理，将观察与跨视频判断两类决策解耦。
item.description:
MVAgent：全局协调下的逐视频智能体用于多视频理解

MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29154

提出免训练的多视频理解框架MVAgent，通过为每个视频配备独立的LocalAgent处理观察决策，并由GlobalAgent协调跨视频推理，将观察与跨视频判断两类决策解耦。

多视频理解要求系统能够整合来自不同视频的证据以进行跨视频推理。回答这类问题涉及两类决策：观察决策必须适应每个视频的内容，而跨视频判断则需要根据问题关联来自不同视频的证据。大多数现有智能体在单一控制器中同时做出这两类决策，其上下文会不断累积来自每个视频的观察。我们在MVAgent中将这两类决策分离，这是一个免训练的多视频理解智能体框架，每个视频配备一个LocalAgent。每个LocalAgent规划自己视频的观察并维护私有的观察历史。GlobalAgent则通过指示各LocalAgent并将它们的报告与联合观察相结合来协调跨视频推理。我们在CVBench、MVU-Eval和CrossVid上，使用三个不同规模的Qwen3.5模型以及GPT-6-sol对MVAgent进行评估。使用Qwen3.5时，我们的框架提升了……

arXiv:2611.29154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves

item.title: 该研究针对孟加拉语非正式患者叙述构建了医学专科预测任务，并系统比较了机器学习、深度学习、Transformer和大语言模型四类方法的表现，其中微调的XLM-RoBERTa以86.26%的准确率取得最佳效果。
item.description:
基于孟加拉语患者叙述的医学专科预测：机器学习、深度学习、Transformer与大语言模型的比较研究

Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29151

该研究针对孟加拉语非正式患者叙述构建了医学专科预测任务，并系统比较了机器学习、深度学习、Transformer和大语言模型四类方法的表现，其中微调的XLM-RoBERTa以86.26%的准确率取得最佳效果。

及时获得合适的医疗专科服务仍是孟加拉国医疗体系的瓶颈，因为患者通常用非正式的孟加拉语而非临床术语来描述症状，导致转诊效率低下。本文比较了四类模型在从孟加拉语患者叙述中预测医学专科方面的表现：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六种机器学习（ML）模型、使用基于语料库训练的Word2Vec词向量的四种深度学习（DL）模型、四种微调的Transformer模型，以及五种以零样本（zero-shot）方式评估的大语言模型（LLM）。语料库包含覆盖20个专科的3798条患者记录，我们保留了记录数最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、胃肠科），并将由此得到的2730条记录按80:20划分为所有模型家族共用的训练集和测试集。表现最佳的Transformer模型是XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏平均F1为86.21%），最佳的机器学习模型是SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳的深度学习模型……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.29151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best D

item.title: 该论文提出了跨倍率来源验证（CMPV）新任务，构建了含306万坐标监督样本的PyraFault基准，并设计了独立于声明的验证器ZoomTrace，用于检验视觉智能体在全切片图像上的放大观测是否真实来源于其声称的位置。
item.description:
智能体能相信自己的放大镜吗？面向全切片图像的跨倍率来源验证

Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29150

该论文提出了跨倍率来源验证（CMPV）新任务，构建了含306万坐标监督样本的PyraFault基准，并设计了独立于声明的验证器ZoomTrace，用于检验视觉智能体在全切片图像上的放大观测是否真实来源于其声称的位置。

视觉智能体通过与其声称位置相关联的放大观测来导航全切片图像。然而，视觉上看似合理的观测并不一定真正来源于其声称的位置，尤其是在跨倍率观察以及组织结构相似的区域中。我们提出了跨倍率来源验证（Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification, CMPV）这一任务，用以评估视觉证据是否支持所声称的空间关联，在可能的情况下恢复观测的真实来源，并在证据不足时选择弃权。我们构建了PyraFault基准，包含来自五个TCGA队列中2200例病例的306万个坐标监督样本，涵盖上下文内替换、来源缺失故障以及几何扰动等情形。我们进一步提出ZoomTrace，一个独立于声明的验证器，它先估计观测的实际来源，再评估其与声称位置的一致性，结合了物理尺度对齐、视觉检索与几何重建等方法。

arXiv:2611.29150v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric re

item.title: VeriLogic 提出了一种将逻辑推理过程分解为显式可验证的中间判断、证明和最终决策的强化学习方法，通过“扎根—优化—精炼”流水线实现过程级监督，解决了传统结果信号忽视推理轨迹内部正确性异质性的问题。
item.description:
VeriLogic：基于可验证逻辑推理轨迹的强化学习

VeriLogic: Reinforcement Learning over Verifiable Logical Reasoning Traces

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29147

VeriLogic 提出了一种将逻辑推理过程分解为显式可验证的中间判断、证明和最终决策的强化学习方法，通过“扎根—优化—精炼”流水线实现过程级监督，解决了传统结果信号忽视推理轨迹内部正确性异质性的问题。

逻辑推理通过显式的中间推理步骤从前提推导出结论，为过程级验证与监督提供了天然基础。然而，现有的学习方法通常依赖响应层面的结果信号，忽略了推理轨迹内部正确性的异质性：一个正确的答案可能包含无效的推理，而有效的中间步骤也可能出现在错误的响应中。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可验证逻辑推理强化学习，将内部推理轨迹转化为显式且可验证的学习对象。VeriLogic 不将响应视为不可分割的学习单元，而是将逻辑推理分解为显式的中间判断、证明和最终决策，并将它们组织成一个统一的“扎根—优化—精炼”流水线：（1）基于验证的推理环境构建

arXiv:2611.29147v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified "Grounding - Optimization - Refinement" pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction

item.title: 该论文提出“重试税”概念，通过特化经典幸存者选择理论证明：对智能体失败后进行不传递反馈的静态同任务重试，虽然能增加完成数量，但每次完成的平均成本不低于一次性服务，且额外完成的边际成本递增，其根本原因在于重试后未解决任务池会偏向更难的任务。
item.description:
重试税：为什么同一任务的静态重试可能导致每次完成成本更高

The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29133

该论文提出“重试税”概念，通过特化经典幸存者选择理论证明：对智能体失败后进行不传递反馈的静态同任务重试，虽然能增加完成数量，但每次完成的平均成本不低于一次性服务，且额外完成的边际成本递增，其根本原因在于重试后未解决任务池会偏向更难的任务。

在失败后重试智能体可以完成更多任务，但同时会增加每次完成的成本。我们研究了一种静态策略：在验证成功或达到尝试次数上限时停止，否则重置原始提示和工作区，而不向前一个请求传递任何反馈。在任务成功率平稳、给定任务下各次尝试相互独立、且每次尝试成本相同的条件下，较容易的任务往往更早成功。当任务成功率存在差异时，未解决任务的组合会向更难的任务偏移。通过对经典的幸存者选择理论进行特化，我们证明了每次完成的成本至少不低于一次性服务的成本，并且在完成增量处处为正的情况下，每增加一次完成的边际成本是非递减的。这是两个不同的量：前者是分摊到所有完成上的平均支出，后者则是对额外一次尝试所新增完成进行的定价。随后，我们将每个任务现有的基准测试运行排列……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.29133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in diffe

item.title: DeepDOSReasoner通过原子-能量源注意力机制与连续性方程传输，在从结构上保证非负性和总态守恒的前提下，实现了电子与声子态密度的高精度预测，助力材料发现。
item.description:
DeepDOSReasoner：面向态密度预测与材料发现的物理原理驱动推理

DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29132

DeepDOSReasoner通过原子-能量源注意力机制与连续性方程传输，在从结构上保证非负性和总态守恒的前提下，实现了电子与声子态密度的高精度预测，助力材料发现。

从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学领域长期追求的目标。电子态密度（eDOS）和声子态密度（phDOS）决定了材料的关键电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，然而使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算它们的成本高昂：Materials Project数据库中约60%的条目缺少eDOS数据，超过80%的条目缺少phDOS数据。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池化的结构表示和逐点回归，这会模糊光谱特征并违反总态守恒。本研究提出DeepDOSReasoner，这是一个基于物理原理的框架，通过原子到能量源的注意力机制解码光谱，并通过学习到的连续性方程传输过程精炼归一化态密度，从结构上保证非负性和总态守恒。DeepDOSReasoner在eDOS和phDOS的所有评估指标上均取得了最高的预测精度。

arXiv:2611.29132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. DeepDOSReasoner achieves the highest prediction accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both eDOS and phDOS, rec

item.title: 该论文提出组平衡监督微调（GB-SFT），通过在序列内不同语义角色的 token 之间均衡分配监督损失预算，在法律、医学、代码和数学等领域显著提升大模型新知识注入效果，同时保留引用召回能力。
item.description:
面向知识密集型领域的组平衡监督微调

Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29127

该论文提出组平衡监督微调（GB-SFT），通过在序列内不同语义角色的 token 之间均衡分配监督损失预算，在法律、医学、代码和数学等领域显著提升大模型新知识注入效果，同时保留引用召回能力。

监督微调（SFT）对每个被监督的 token 赋予相同权重，因此在知识密集的语料上，损失预算是按 token 数量而非重要性分配的：在一个法律问答基准上，引用字符串占用了 81% 的监督损失权重预算，而真正要教授的答案仅占 5%。我们提出了组平衡 SFT（GB-SFT），它在一个目标序列内的不同 token 语义角色之间均衡分配损失预算。通过一个可调旋钮和一个结构性开关，GB-SFT 将标准 SFT、类级别和跨度级别的平衡包含为其几何上被精确刻画的端点。在法律、医学、代码和数学的基准上，我们跨多个模型家族地展示：(i) GB-SFT 比均匀 SFT、逐点 token 加权、记忆编辑以及匹配预算的数据混合能更好地注入新知识；(ii) 它达到了仅保留知识载荷而遮蔽其余内容的效果，同时保留了被遮蔽方法所破坏的引用召回能力。

arXiv:2611.29127v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destro

item.title: 该论文将Transformer隐藏状态的逐层演化建模为动力系统，利用Koopman算子理论提取主导模态子空间作为主题“谱指纹”，证明模型深度映射近似线性、指纹可判别不同学科主题且在多个模型间可复现。
item.description:
通过Koopman子空间解码Transformer动力学

Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29113

该论文将Transformer隐藏状态的逐层演化建模为动力系统，利用Koopman算子理论提取主导模态子空间作为主题“谱指纹”，证明模型深度映射近似线性、指纹可判别不同学科主题且在多个模型间可复现。

我们应用Koopman算子理论和动态模态分解（DMD）来刻画大型语言模型（LLMs）如何处理不同的输入主题。我们将隐藏状态的逐层演化视为一个动力系统，拟合一个线性Koopman算子，并将其主导模态张成的子空间作为每个主题的谱指纹。研究得出四项发现：第一，深度映射接近线性——单个线性算子即可预测每个下一层状态，相对误差约为18%（内部方差解释率约为0.99）；第二，在MMLU的57个学科上，该指纹具有主题判别性，与MMLU分类体系的最近邻纯度匹配度为0.72，与各学科语义邻域的any-hit@3达到0.75；第三，它是一种可复现的签名（折半自检索约为0.97）；最后，这些发现在七个基础模型（Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B、Llama-3 1B-8B）上保持一致，并呈现出一个具有提示意义的趋势（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.29113v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$).
