item.title: 这篇论文通过对注意力片段的分析发现，LLM智能体在80%的工具调用失败中其实最关注的正是正确的工具，失败源于决策读出环节而非工具列表干扰——修复提示词只能挽回≤23%的失败，而读出端干预可挽回59-91%。
item.description:
看见并不等于选中：LLM智能体工具选择失败的注意力-片段解释

Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16364

这篇论文通过对注意力片段的分析发现，LLM智能体在80%的工具调用失败中其实最关注的正是正确的工具，失败源于决策读出环节而非工具列表干扰——修复提示词只能挽回≤23%的失败，而读出端干预可挽回59-91%。

大语言模型（LLM）智能体会错误地调用工具，一个自然的猜测是：模型在拥挤的工具列表中没能“看到”正确的工具。我们通过一个被同期研究所忽视的视角——模型对带有标签的工具定义片段的注意力——证明了事实恰恰相反。在真实的BFCL失败案例上，通过逐候选的注意力argmax分析，模型在80%的情况下最关注的正是正确的工具（相比之下随机水平为21%），而正确工具成为注意力最低片段的情况仅占10%：模型看着正确的工具，却仍然选错了。这直接反驳了直觉上的“工具列表拥挤/迷失在中间”解释：失败发生在决策读出环节，而非工具列表本身，我们通过三种方式将失败定位于此。(1) 输入 vs. 读出：修复提示词（重新排序或复制正确工具）只能恢复不超过23%的失败案例，而读出端的干预可恢复59-91%。(2) 表征不变性：两种指向正确工具但作用于不同表征的干预——一种加性注意力logit偏置……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2606.16364v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly refutes the intuitive "crowded-harness / lost-in-the-middle" explanation: the failure is at the decision readout, not the harness, and we pin it there three ways. (1) Input vs. readout: repairing the prompt (reordering or duplicating the gold tool) recovers <=23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59-91%. item.title: 该论文通过基于标准补丁的执行验证系统审计了代码强化学习训练环境的奖励作弊问题，发现约22.4%（强攻击者下57.8%）的SWE-bench Verified任务会接受错误补丁，且模型在这些可作弊任务上的通过率显著更高，凸显了对RL训练环境进行作弊检测与修复审计的必要性。
item.description:
审计代码强化学习训练环境中的奖励可作弊性

Auditing Reward Hackability in Code RL Training Environments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16062

该论文通过基于标准补丁的执行验证系统审计了代码强化学习训练环境的奖励作弊问题，发现约22.4%（强攻击者下57.8%）的SWE-bench Verified任务会接受错误补丁，且模型在这些可作弊任务上的通过率显著更高，凸显了对RL训练环境进行作弊检测与修复审计的必要性。

代码强化学习根据策略是否通过任务的测试来给予奖励，因此一个会接受错误补丁的测试套件就会训练出错误的行为。我们测量了开源代码RL环境接受错误补丁的频率，以及可作弊任务被检测和修复的可靠性，并通过将每个补丁与任务的标准补丁进行执行对比来验证所有结论。首先，在49个SWE-bench Verified任务中，22.4%的任务会接受一个经Docker验证但与标准补丁行为不同的补丁，面对更强的攻击者时这一比例达57.8%。标准补丁检查是必要的：未被告知标准补丁的攻击者在其通过的“漏洞利用”中有31%实际上返回的就是标准补丁本身。其次，在134个公开的SWE-bench提交中，模型通过可作弊任务的频率比同等难度的任务高出28.6个百分点，这主要源于这些任务本身是可以通过的；在三次攻击者运行汇总来看，可作弊任务的通过率仍显著超过匹配的可完成任务（p = 0.014）。第三，修复比检测更难验证：61.9%由LLM编写的修复补丁……（摘要原文在此处截断）

item.title: 提出了Stubborn框架，将运动跟踪与摔倒恢复统一为单一任务进行端到端训练，摆脱了传统多阶段训练和独立恢复策略的束缚，实现了人形机器人在干扰下的鲁棒运动跟踪与摔倒恢复。
item.description:
Stubborn：一个用于人形机器人鲁棒运动跟踪与摔倒恢复的精简统一强化学习框架

Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12814

提出了Stubborn框架，将运动跟踪与摔倒恢复统一为单一任务进行端到端训练，摆脱了传统多阶段训练和独立恢复策略的束缚，实现了人形机器人在干扰下的鲁棒运动跟踪与摔倒恢复。

近期的强化学习方法在提升人形机器人运动跟踪性能以及实现干扰下的摔倒恢复方面展现出巨大前景。然而，现有的大多数工作将运动跟踪和摔倒恢复视为不同的任务，需要多阶段训练，并使用专门的恢复奖励和/或独立的恢复策略。此外，现有的基于强化学习的方法通常在出现严重跟踪失败后立即终止训练回合，限制了在不稳定或摔倒状态下面向恢复的探索。为解决上述问题，我们提出了Stubborn，一个精简且统一的强化学习框架，用于实现鲁棒的人形机器人运动跟踪和摔倒恢复。具体而言，Stubborn采用非对称Actor-Critic架构，由三个主要组件构成。首先，采用偏航对齐的跟踪表示来降低对全局漂移和航向的敏感性……

arXiv:2606.12814v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. item.title: AVIS提出了一种轻量级自适应策略，通过免训练的KDV视觉token剪枝和自适应自一致性，针对每个查询在视觉上下文扩展与视觉推理扩展两个维度上联合分配计算，从而显著降低视觉语言模型的推理成本。
item.description:
AVIS：面向视觉语言模型的自适应测试时扩展

AVIS: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11576

AVIS提出了一种轻量级自适应策略，通过免训练的KDV视觉token剪枝和自适应自一致性，针对每个查询在视觉上下文扩展与视觉推理扩展两个维度上联合分配计算，从而显著降低视觉语言模型的推理成本。

现代视觉语言模型（VLM）受益于思维链提示和测试时扩展，但由于庞大的视觉上下文和较长的解码链，这些收益往往伴随着高昂的推理成本。我们从两个相互耦合的维度来审视这一成本：视觉上下文扩展（VCS），控制传递给语言模型的视觉证据量；以及视觉推理扩展（VRS），控制在推理阶段执行多少推理搜索。现有方法通常一次只优化其中一个维度，而跨这两个维度的计算联合分配问题尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了自适应视觉推理扩展（AVIS），这是一种轻量级策略，可以针对每个查询自适应地调整VCS和VRS。AVIS通过关键多样性视觉（KDV）剪枝实现VCS——这是一种免训练的、基于键的O(N)规则，可在预填充前去除冗余视觉token；并通过自适应自一致性实现VRS，利用学习到的难度……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2606.11576v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) benefit from chain-of-thought prompting and test-time scaling, but these gains often come with prohibitive inference cost due to large visual contexts and long decoding chains. We view this cost through two coupled axes: Visual Context Scaling (VCS), which controls how much visual evidence is passed to the language model, and Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS), which controls how much inference-time reasoning search is performed. Existing methods typically optimize one axis at a time, leaving the joint allocation of compute across these axes underexplored. We introduce Adaptive Visual Inference Scaling (AVIS), a lightweight policy that adapts both VCS and VRS per query. item.title: YUBI 是一种手指驱动的顺应式夹爪接口，结合 VR 六自由度跟踪实现了直观且符合人体工学的大规模双手灵巧操作数据采集，构建了包含 8,434 小时、120 万片段和 119 个任务的空前规模数据集。
item.description:
YUBI：面向大规模双手灵巧操作的顺应式通用双指接口

YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10244

YUBI 是一种手指驱动的顺应式夹爪接口，结合 VR 六自由度跟踪实现了直观且符合人体工学的大规模双手灵巧操作数据采集，构建了包含 8,434 小时、120 万片段和 119 个任务的空前规模数据集。

我们提出了顺应式通用双指接口（YUBI），这是一种与手指对齐的夹爪，旨在为双手灵巧操作实现直观、符合人体工学且可扩展的数据采集。尽管通用操作接口（UMI）等手持式数据采集系统能够实现低成本的数据采集，但其笨重的手枪式握柄设计在精细、灵巧的操作任务中可能带来人体工学和使用体验方面的挑战。为解决这一问题，YUBI 提出了独特的设计原则：顺应式、手指驱动的执行方式，将人类手指的动作直接映射为夹爪爪部的运动。借助 YUBI 装置，我们搭建了一套集成了基于 VR 的夹爪六自由度跟踪的数据采集系统，确保高保真的轨迹数据获取。我们构建了基于 UMI 的前所未有规模的数据集：共 8,434 小时，涵盖 120 万条片段和 119 个任务。实验表明，YUBI 相比 UMI 夹爪在多功能性等方面具有优势。

While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. item.title: 该论文提出一种双分支门控融合框架，将XLSR-53与多维描述符CORES结合，通过输入自适应门控及交叉熵、能量边际损失和门控多样性项的联合训练，实现开放集音频深度伪造来源溯源，在MLAAD基准上取得97.6%的域内准确率。
item.description:
面向开放集音频深度伪造来源溯源的双分支门控融合方法

Dual-Branch Gated Fusion for Open-Set Audio Deepfake Source Tracing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10223

该论文提出一种双分支门控融合框架，将XLSR-53与多维描述符CORES结合，通过输入自适应门控及交叉熵、能量边际损失和门控多样性项的联合训练，实现开放集音频深度伪造来源溯源，在MLAAD基准上取得97.6%的域内准确率。

将合成语音归因于其来源系统仍是一个悬而未决的挑战：闭集模型无法拒绝未见过的合成器，并且会产生过度自信的预测。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种双分支门控融合框架，将XLSR-53与CORES相结合。CORES是一个66维描述符，与以往仅使用线性滤波器组（LFB）的工作不同，它涵盖倒谱、振荡、节奏、能量和频谱等多个维度，以捕获互补的合成伪迹。我们的分析表明，XLSR-53在域内（ID）保持判别能力，而CORES在分布偏移（OOD）下能稳定泛化，但由于SSL表征失衡，两者的简单拼接会失效。为解决该问题，输入条件门控在联合训练下自适应地为每个分支分配权重，联合训练包含交叉熵、用于ID/OOD分离的能量边际损失以及门控多样性项。在MLAAD基准上，我们的系统达到了97.6%的域内准确率、4.9%的EERc（摘要在此处截断）。

To address this, we propose a dual-branch gated fusion framework that pairs XLSR-53 with CORES, a 66-dimensional descriptor that, unlike prior Linear Filter Bank (LFB)-only work, spans cepstral, oscillatory, rhythmic, energy, and spectral dimensions to capture complementary synthesis artifacts. Our analysis shows XLSR-53 remains discriminative in-domain (ID) while CORES generalizes stably under distribution shift (OOD), yet their naive concatenation fails due to SSL representational imbalance. To resolve this, an input-conditioned gate adaptively weights each branch under joint training with cross-entropy, an energy margin loss for ID/OOD separation, and a gate diversity term. item.title: 该论文提出了一种面向操作系统集成AI的功能边界审计方法，通过隐私失效面分类体系、五维控制评估准则以及数据与权限路径记录，系统评估了苹果、谷歌、微软等主流操作系统级AI助手的隐私保护边界，并揭示了告知、保留、路径所有权与问责方面的模糊之处。
item.description:
超越本地化：面向操作系统集成AI的功能边界审计

Beyond Locality: Feature-Boundary Auditing for OS-Integrated AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10173

该论文提出了一种面向操作系统集成AI的功能边界审计方法，通过隐私失效面分类体系、五维控制评估准则以及数据与权限路径记录，系统评估了苹果、谷歌、微软等主流操作系统级AI助手的隐私保护边界，并揭示了告知、保留、路径所有权与问责方面的模糊之处。

设备端推理减少了对远程基础设施的暴露，但对于聚合跨应用数据、保留派生状态或委托执行操作的操作系统AI助手而言，这并不能真正确立隐私保护。我们提出了一种面向操作系统集成AI的功能边界审计方法。该方法结合了六个隐私失效面的分类体系、带有独立证据等级的五维控制评估准则，以及对相邻数据与权限路径的显式记录。我们基于一手公开文档，将该方法应用于Apple Foundation Models、Apple Private Cloud Compute、Android AICore/Gemini Nano以及Microsoft Recall。分析区分了请求隔离与上下文克制、保留状态控制与非保留策略，以及远程证明与任务适当的披露。对两份各含20项条目的评估记录进行形成性比较后，发现了在告知义务、数据保留、路径所有权与问责归属方面存在的模糊之处。

We apply the method to Apple Foundation Models, Apple Private Cloud Compute, Android AICore/Gemini Nano, and Microsoft Recall using primary public documentation. The analysis distinguishes request isolation from contextual restraint, retained-state controls from non-retention, and attestation from task-appropriate disclosure. item.title: 该论文为神经网络参数化的流匹配建立了首个理论基础，证明了过参数化两层ReLU网络梯度下降的收敛性、速度场匹配的泛化界以及生成样本的Wasserstein距离保证。
item.description:
神经网络流匹配的理论研究

A Theory on Flow Matching with Neural Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10089

该论文为神经网络参数化的流匹配建立了首个理论基础，证明了过参数化两层ReLU网络梯度下降的收敛性、速度场匹配的泛化界以及生成样本的Wasserstein距离保证。

在这项工作中，我们为基于神经网络参数化条件速度场的流匹配建立了理论基础。我们在过参数化的两层ReLU神经网络机制下建立了梯度下降的收敛性保证，并推导了条件速度场匹配目标的泛化界。基于这些结果，我们为诱导流生成的样本提供了Wasserstein距离保证。我们的分析基于具有无界损失的多任务表示学习的泛化界，这一结果在基于流的生成建模之外也可能具有独立的研究价值。这些理论结果通过在合成数据和真实世界图像基准上的大量实验得到了验证。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/qishuoyin/FlowMatchNN 获取。

arXiv:2606.10089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work, we develop theoretical foundation for flow matching with neural-network-parameterized conditional velocity fields. We establish convergence guarantees for gradient descent in the over-parameterized 2-layered ReLU neural network regime. We derive generalization bounds for the conditional velocity-field matching objective. Building on these results, we provide Wasserstein-distance guarantees for the samples generated by the induced flow. Our analysis is based on generalization bound for multi-task representation learning with unbounded losses, which may be of independent interest beyond flow-based generative modeling. These theoretical results are validated through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world image benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/qishuoyin/FlowMatchNN.

item.title: 该论文提出基于对数概率差异的因果影响度量并结合电路发现技术，量化了视觉语言模型幻觉输出的反事实鲁棒性，并推导出可靠检测幻觉不稳定性所需最小反事实样本数的经验界限。

需要多少个反事实样本？通过电路与因果效应探究视觉语言模型的幻觉现象

How Many Counterfactuals Does It Take? Probing VLM Hallucinations Through Circuits and Causal Effects

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08777

该论文提出基于对数概率差异的因果影响度量并结合电路发现技术，量化了视觉语言模型幻觉输出的反事实鲁棒性，并推导出可靠检测幻觉不稳定性所需最小反事实样本数的经验界限。

视觉语言模型已知会产生不基于视觉证据的幻觉预测，然而现有方法缺乏对这些预测在反事实扰动下鲁棒性的原理性理解。在这项工作中，我们研究了视觉语言模型中幻觉输出的反事实鲁棒性的样本复杂度。我们定义了一个基于事实、反事实和激活修补运行之间对数概率差异的因果影响度量，并用它来表征幻觉预测的稳定性。通过利用电路发现技术，我们识别出负责这些幻觉预测的模型组件，并跟踪它们在不同反事实样本间的激活差异。随后，我们利用集中不等式和方差估计，推导出可靠检测幻觉输出不稳定性所需的最小反事实样本数的经验界限。

arXiv:2606.08777v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) are known to produce hallucinated predictions that are not grounded in visual evidence, yet existing approaches lack a principled understanding of how robust such predictions are under counterfactual perturbations. In this work, we study the sample complexity of counterfactual robustness for hallucinated outputs in VLMs. We define a causal influence metric based on log-probability differences between factual, counterfactual, and activation-patched runs, and use it to characterize the stability of hallucinated predictions. By leveraging circuit discovery techniques (CD-T), we identify model components responsible for these predictions and track their activation differences across counterfactual samples. item.title: 这篇立场论文指出，当前由SFT和强化学习构成的大规模后训练范式本质上是向BERT时代“预训练+微调”方法的回归，并通过实验证明仅靠后训练（即使从随机初始化开始）也能在数学和代码基准上取得相当可观的成绩。
item.description:
后训练即（大规模）监督学习

Post-training is (Massive) Supervised Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07527

这篇立场论文指出，当前由SFT和强化学习构成的大规模后训练范式本质上是向BERT时代“预训练+微调”方法的回归，并通过实验证明仅靠后训练（即使从随机初始化开始）也能在数学和代码基准上取得相当可观的成绩。

训练大语言模型（LLM）的主流范式已经演变为依赖一个由监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）组成的大规模后训练阶段。在这篇立场论文中，我们认为这种方法实际上标志着向BERT时代“先预训练后微调”方法的回归，即显式地将模型定制为期望的行为以及用于评估的特定基准。我们首先对LLM进行了历史回顾，描述了LLM演化的不同阶段。我们认为当前的格局与LLM早期阶段惊人地相似，当时任务性能在很大程度上依赖于将模型拟合到分布内的数据集。为了实证证明这一点，我们将预训练模型与随机初始化的模型进行比较，在现代推理数据集上对两种变体进行微调，并在具有竞争力的数学和代码基准上进行评估。我们表明，从头开始进行后训练的模型能够取得高度可观的非平凡性能。

arXiv:2606.07527v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The prevailing paradigm for training LLMs has evolved to rely on a massive post-training phase consisting of SFT and RL. In this position paper, we argue that this methodology effectively marks a reversion to the ``pre-train then fine-tune'' approach of the BERT era, explicitly tailoring models to the desired behaviors and specific benchmarks on which they are evaluated. We begin with a historical overview of LLMs, describing the different phases of the LLM evolution. We argue that the current landscape is remarkably similar to the early days of LLMs, where task performance heavily relied on fitting the models to in-distribution datasets. To empirically demonstrate this, we compare pre-trained models to randomly initialized ones, by fine-tuning both variants on modern reasoning datasets and evaluating them on competitive math and code benchmarks. We show that models post-trained from scratch yield highly non-trivial performance

item.title: 本文提出监督记忆训练（SMT）方法，将RNN训练转化为对由Transformer编码器生成的单步记忆转移标签的监督学习，从而完全绕过循环信用传播，实现时间并行训练，且任意两个token之间的梯度路径长度稳定为O(1)。
item.description:
无需循环的循环网络预训练

Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06479

本文提出监督记忆训练（SMT）方法，将RNN训练转化为对由Transformer编码器生成的单步记忆转移标签的监督学习，从而完全绕过循环信用传播，实现时间并行训练，且任意两个token之间的梯度路径长度稳定为O(1)。

训练循环神经网络需要在长计算序列上进行信用分配。标准的沿时间反向传播（BPTT）方法对此问题的处理效果不佳：它在时间上是顺序进行的，限制了并行性，并且存在梯度消失或梯度爆炸的问题，使得长程关联难以学习。我们提出了监督记忆训练，这是一种训练非线性RNN的方法，它通过将RNN训练简化为对单步记忆转移标签 $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$ 的监督学习，完全绕开了循环信用传播。SMT通过在一个预测状态目标上训练基于Transformer的编码器来获取这些记忆标签——即仅保留过去中预测未来所必需的信息。通过将“记住什么”与“如何更新记忆”解耦，SMT实现了时间上并行的RNN训练，任意两个token之间的梯度路径长度稳定为O(1)——无需……

arXiv:2606.06479v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. item.title: 该论文提出利用预训练编码模型TRIBE v2生成的合成fMRI数据来增强小型数据集，使Top-10图像检索准确率最高提升68%，并指出增强数据的最优比例需依数据来源而定。
item.description:
利用 TRIBE v2 数据增强提升脑-图像解码

Boosting Brain-to-Image Decoding with TRIBE v2 Data Augmentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06345

该论文提出利用预训练编码模型TRIBE v2生成的合成fMRI数据来增强小型数据集，使Top-10图像检索准确率最高提升68%，并指出增强数据的最优比例需依数据来源而定。

脑解码受到有标签神经数据可获得性的限制，在低数据量情形下仍然充满挑战。为解决这一问题，我们研究了能否以及在何种情况下，通过使用由一个预训练的fMRI刺激响应模型生成的合成数据来扩充小型fMRI数据集，从而提升脑解码性能。我们使用TRIBE v2——一个在超过1000小时的视频、音频和语言fMRI响应上预训练的大型编码模型。对于每个数据集，我们评估了系统化的网格实验，展示图像解码器性能如何随用于训练的合成数据量而变化。基于两个数据集（7T fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset 和 3T fMRI BOLD5000）的结果表明，与仅用真实数据训练的解码器相比，Top-10图像检索准确率最高提升68%。重要的是，达到给定图像解码性能所需的增强数据比例需要根据数据来源进行调整。

arXiv:2606.06345v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Brain decoding is limited by the availability of labeled neural data, and remains challenging in low-data regimes. To address this issue, we investigate whether and when brain decoding can be boosted by augmenting small fMRI datasets with synthetic data generated by a pretrained model of fMRI responses to stimuli. We use TRIBE v2, a large encoding model pretrained on more than 1000 hours of fMRI responses to video, audio and language. For each dataset, we evaluate systematic grids that show how the performance of image decoders varies with the amount of synthetic data used for training. Our results, based on two datasets (the 7T fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset and 3T fMRI BOLD5000), show up to 68% improvement in Top-10 image-retrieval accuracy compared to decoders trained only on real data. Importantly, the proportion of augmented data required to reach a given image decoding performance needs to be adjusted depending on the data source.

item.title: 该论文发现VLA动作生成与文生图截然不同——只需将训练时间步分布偏向噪声端点，或直接将多步迭代解码替换为单次前向传播，即可获得性能相当的单步策略，其根本原因在于VLA生成的条件-目标结构更接近图生文任务。
item.description:
让它保持简单：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的单步动作生成

Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05737

该论文发现VLA动作生成与文生图截然不同——只需将训练时间步分布偏向噪声端点，或直接将多步迭代解码替换为单次前向传播，即可获得性能相当的单步策略，其根本原因在于VLA生成的条件-目标结构更接近图生文任务。

对于文生图或视频生成任务，从标准的扩散或流匹配训练直接实现单步生成，在不借助蒸馏或专门单步目标的情况下通常难以奏效。我们发现VLA动作生成却表现出截然不同的特性：仅将训练时间步分布向噪声端点偏置，就能在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro以及真实世界机器人任务上获得强大的单步策略。此外，对于不同架构的开源VLA模型，仅仅将迭代解码替换为单次前向传播，在LIBERO、CALVIN和SimplerEnv等基准上往往就能达到与原始多步解码相当的性能。我们将这一差异归因于VLA生成的条件-目标结构：它更接近于图生文而非文生图——丰富的观测对相对紧凑的目标形成了强约束。我们通过不可约简的速度损失将这一直觉形式化

arXiv:2606.05737v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: One-step generation from standard diffusion or Flow-Matching training is rarely effective for text-to-image or video generation without distillation or specialized one-step objectives. We find that VLA action generation behaves strikingly differently. Biasing only the training timestep distribution toward the noise endpoint yields strong one-step policies across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and real-world robot tasks. Moreover, for open-source VLA models with different architectures, simply replacing iterative decoding with a single forward pass often performs comparably to the original multi-step decoding on benchmarks such as LIBERO, CALVIN, and SimplerEnv. We attribute this difference to the condition-target structure of VLA generation, which is closer to image-to-text than text-to-image: rich observations strongly constrain a comparatively compact target. We formalize this intuition through the irreducible velocity loss

item.title: 该论文构建了首个多方审议对话数据集DeliChess，让参与者协作解决国际象棋谜题，揭示出初始答案多样性越高审议收益越大，以及审议过程中群体答案可被恢复、发现或丢失的规律。
item.description:
DeliChess：一个用于国际象棋谜题求解审议的多方对话数据集

DeliChess: A Multi-party Dialogue Dataset for Deliberation in Chess Puzzle Solving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04987

该论文构建了首个多方审议对话数据集DeliChess，让参与者协作解决国际象棋谜题，揭示出初始答案多样性越高审议收益越大，以及审议过程中群体答案可被恢复、发现或丢失的规律。

多方对话是研究协作推理与决策的关键场景，然而现有数据集很少关注结构化、推理密集型的任务。我们提出了DeliChess，这是一个群体审议对话数据集，参与者在其中协作解决多选式的国际象棋谜题。参与者首先独立作答，随后进行多方审议并修改各自答案。该数据集包含107个会话，涵盖24个独特棋局上的321次谜题讨论，并配有完整的对话转录文本、审议前后的答案选择，以及话语层面的交流功能、认知立场和支持审议有用性的标注。我们的分析表明，初始答案质量的多样性越高，审议带来的收益越大；同时，答案轨迹揭示了审议如何能够恢复、发现或丢失优质答案。

arXiv:2606.04987v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-party dialogue is a critical setting for studying collaborative reasoning and decision-making, yet existing datasets rarely focus on structured, reasoning-intensive tasks. We introduce DeliChess, a dataset of group deliberation dialogues in which participants collaboratively solve multiple-choice chess puzzles. Participants first answer independently, then engage in multi-party deliberation and revise their individual answers. The dataset comprises 107 sessions containing 321 puzzle discussions across 24 unique positions, with full transcripts, pre- and post-deliberation choices, and utterance-level annotations of communicative function, epistemic stance, and usefulness in supporting deliberation. Our analyses show that greater diversity in initial solution quality is associated with larger gains, while answer trajectories reveal how deliberation can recover, discover, or lose strong answers. item.title: 提出SFMambaNet，通过逐簇扫描让正确匹配在序列中平缓变化、错误匹配保持无规律，并在前后向扫描间引入可学习频域门控滤波，从而在相机位姿估计、外点剔除和单应性估计等双视图对应学习任务上超越空间域Mamba。
item.description:
平滑的内点、无规律的外点：面向双视图对应学习的频率感知Mamba

Smooth Inliers, Erratic Outliers: Frequency-Aware Mamba for Two-View Correspondence Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04493

提出SFMambaNet，通过逐簇扫描让正确匹配在序列中平缓变化、错误匹配保持无规律，并在前后向扫描间引入可学习频域门控滤波，从而在相机位姿估计、外点剔除和单应性估计等双视图对应学习任务上超越空间域Mamba。

当看到同一座大教堂两张照片之间的匹配时，人们一眼就能分辨出哪些匹配是错误的：一个窗户与其“相似物”的错误匹配会在邻近的正确匹配中显得突兀，而正确的匹配则一起平缓地变化。双视图对应学习（也称为对应剪枝）要求网络对数千个候选匹配做出这种判断，而其中大多数是错误的。Mamba是一种快速的序列模型，目前已能驱动强大的剪枝网络，但它将匹配当作普通序列来读取，其扫描机制能否捕捉到上述匹配间的一致性尚不清楚。我们提出SFMambaNet，它逐簇扫描匹配，使得正确的匹配沿序列缓慢变化，而错误的匹配则保持无规律，并在前向与后向扫描之间利用可学习的频域门控对扫描得到的特征进行过滤。在相机位姿估计、外点剔除和单应性估计任务上，我们发现SFMambaNet优于空间域的Mamba

arXiv:2606.04493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When shown matches between two photographs of the same cathedral, people can tell at a glance which ones are wrong: a window matched to its look-alike jumps against its neighbors, while correct matches shift together. Two-view correspondence learning, also called correspondence pruning, asks a network to make this judgment for thousands of candidate matches, most of which are wrong. Mamba, a fast sequence model, now drives strong pruners, but it reads the matches as a plain sequence, and whether its scan can capture such agreement is unclear. We propose SFMambaNet, which scans the matches cluster by cluster, so that correct matches vary slowly along the sequence while wrong ones stay erratic, and filters the scanned features with learnable frequency-domain gates between its forward and backward passes. On camera pose estimation, outlier removal and homography estimation, we find that SFMambaNet outperforms spatial-domain Mamba

item.title: LCSHBench是首个基于多家图书馆编目共识构建的多语言公开基准，涵盖15种语言2万余本书，用于评估LCSH主题标目的自动分配，并同时衡量精确匹配与概念级匹配两种结果。
item.description:
LCSHBench：一个多语言、基于共识的美国国会图书馆主题标目（LCSH）分配基准

LCSHBench: A Multilingual, Consensus-Grounded Benchmark for Library of Congress Subject Heading Assignment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04382

LCSHBench是首个基于多家图书馆编目共识构建的多语言公开基准，涵盖15种语言2万余本书，用于评估LCSH主题标目的自动分配，并同时衡量精确匹配与概念级匹配两种结果。

自动主题编目是将受控词表标目分配给书目记录的过程，但LCSH（美国国会图书馆主题词表）一直缺乏标准的公开基准。我们推出LCSHBench：该数据集包含来自哈佛大学、哥伦比亚大学和普林斯顿大学开放许可目录的15种语言共22,346本图书。只有当至少两个独立编目机构为记录分配了LCSH标目时，该记录才被纳入数据集；我们同时发布了逐馆来源信息以及并集和完全一致两种答案视图。针对三家图书馆共同编目的465,187部作品开展的一致性研究证明了这一设计的必要性：各图书馆通常在底层主题上达成一致（93.3%的记录共享概念级标目），但在确切表达上往往不同（仅39.4%的记录具有完全相同的标目集合）。因此，LCSHBench同时评估精确匹配与概念匹配，并按语言和标目类型细分集合与排序指标，涵盖开放词表生成和全词表检索两类任务。作为首次演示，对一个3亿参数的端侧嵌入模型进行低秩微调……

arXiv:2606.04382v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automated subject cataloging assigns controlledvocabulary headings to bibliographic records, but LCSH has no standard public benchmark. We introduce LCSHBench: 22,346 books in 15 languages from the openly licensed Harvard, Columbia, and Princeton catalogs. Records enter only when at least two independent cataloging agencies assigned LCSH; we release per-catalog provenance plus union and unanimous answer views. A concordance study of 465,187 works cataloged by all three libraries shows why this design matters: libraries usually agree on the underlying topic (93.3% share a concept-level heading) but often differ in exact expression (39.4% have identical heading sets). LCSHBench therefore scores both exact and concept matches, with set and rank metrics broken down by language and heading type, across open-vocabulary generation and full-vocabulary retrieval. item.title: OpenRFM 提出了一套完全开源的构建方案，通过在合成数据中加入依赖历史的标签并扩展上下文，仅凭合成数据库就能训练出媲美闭源前沿模型的关系基础模型，实现了关系数据预测智能的平民化。
item.description:
OpenRFM：让关系数据上的前沿预测智能平民化

OpenRFM: Democratizing Frontier Predictive Intelligence on Relational Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04320

OpenRFM 提出了一套完全开源的构建方案，通过在合成数据中加入依赖历史的标签并扩展上下文，仅凭合成数据库就能训练出媲美闭源前沿模型的关系基础模型，实现了关系数据预测智能的平民化。

关系数据库存储着大部分企业数据，长期以来，在其上进行预测都需要手工编写的特征连接，以及针对每个任务单独训练的模型。关系基础模型通过在单次前向传播中仅凭少量标注样本就能在未见过的数据库上进行预测，从而消除了这种针对每个任务的工程开销。然而，性能最强的RFM是闭源的，而在合成数据上预训练的开源RFM则远远落后。先前的工作将这一差距归因于缺乏真实的预训练数据。我们发现，这一差距的很大一部分来自不完整的合成先验以及稀疏的上下文。现有的合成先验缺乏依赖历史的标签，因此在合成先验上预训练的模型无法学习真实任务背后的时间动态和关系动态；受限的上下文也常常遗漏任务所需的证据。我们提出了OpenRFM，这是一种仅使用合成数据库构建RFM的开放方案，其数据生成器、模型和训练代码全部开源（原文此处截断）。

arXiv:2606.04320v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Relational databases hold most enterprise data, and predicting on them has long required hand-written feature joins and a model trained for each task. Relational foundation models (RFMs) remove this per-task engineering by predicting on an unseen database from a few labelled examples in one forward pass. However, the strongest RFMs are closed, and open RFMs pre-trained on synthetic data lag far behind. Prior work attributes this gap to the lack of real pre-training data. We find that much of this gap comes from an incomplete synthetic prior and from a sparse context. Existing synthetic priors lack history-dependent labels, so models pre-trained on them do not learn the temporal and relational dynamics behind real tasks. A bounded context also often misses the evidence that a task needs. item.title: 本文提出了GTBench——一个基于图论课程体系、包含63道按三级难度组织题目的基准测试，用于系统评估大语言模型作为数学研究助手在定义理解、算法推理和证明构造方面的能力。
item.description:
GTBench：一个基于课程体系的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型作为图论数学研究助手的能力

GTBench: A Curriculum-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Mathematical Research Assistants in Graph Theory

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03144

本文提出了GTBench——一个基于图论课程体系、包含63道按三级难度组织题目的基准测试，用于系统评估大语言模型作为数学研究助手在定义理解、算法推理和证明构造方面的能力。

大语言模型（LLM）在技术学科中被越来越多地用作自学助手，但它们作为数学推理助手的可靠性仍缺乏充分了解。我们提出了GTBench，这是一个基于课程体系的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型作为图论数学研究助手的能力，包含63道题目，按难度递增分为三组：本科阶段的定义与基本性质（第1组）、算法追踪与结构推理（第2组），以及研究生水平的证明构造（第3组）。题目来源于经过验证的学术材料，包括Diestel的《图论》教材。我们在零样本和思维链（chain-of-thought）提示设置下评估了五个前沿模型——GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Llama 3.3 70B和Mistral Large 3——对第1组和第2组采用精确匹配和LLM-as-judge评估方法，对第3组采用人类专家与LLM-as-judge相结合的混合评估协议。

arXiv:2606.03144v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as self-study assistants in technical disciplines, yet their reliability as mathematical reasoning assistants remains poorly understood. We introduce GTBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, comprising 63 problems organized into three groups of increasing difficulty: undergraduate definitions and basic properties (Group 1), algorithm tracing and structural reasoning (Group 2), and graduate-level proof construction (Group 3). Problems are sourced from verified academic materials including Diestel's Graph Theory. We evaluate five frontier models -- GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Large 3 -- under zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting, using exact-match and LLM-as-judge evaluation for Groups 1 and 2, and a hybrid human expert and LLM-as-judge protocol for Group 3. item.title: 该论文提出MusicRec——一个基于LLM的多模态音乐推荐框架，首次在统一的、基于歌曲内容的框架内联合建模音频/歌词嵌入、LLM生成的语义元数据和听歌完成率这三种互补信号，从而提升基于会话的音乐推荐效果。
item.description:
MusicRec：用于音乐推荐的音频、歌词与互动特征增强

MusicRec: Audio, Lyrics, and Engagement Feature Enrichment for Music Recommendation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00125

该论文提出MusicRec——一个基于LLM的多模态音乐推荐框架，首次在统一的、基于歌曲内容的框架内联合建模音频/歌词嵌入、LLM生成的语义元数据和听歌完成率这三种互补信号，从而提升基于会话的音乐推荐效果。

音乐推荐系统通常将歌曲视为不透明的标记，依赖于忽略语义或声学内容的交互历史。先前的LLM增强型、多模态以及文本增强型序列推荐器仅部分结合了语义、声学或互动信号，没有任何工作在基于歌曲内容的统一LLM框架内对这三种信号进行联合建模。在本工作中，我们提出了一个用于基于会话的音乐推荐的多模态框架，该框架通过三种互补信号来丰富LastFM-1K数据集：(1) 来自预训练音乐模型和文本模型的音频与歌词嵌入，(2) 使用MGPHot模式生成的LLM语义元数据，以及(3) 听歌完成率。我们针对全部58个属性，将生成的元数据与人工MGPHot标注进行了验证。我们通过多模态特征、包括SASRec、BERT4Rec和GRU4Rec在内的ItemID编码器骨干网络以及LLM骨干网络对E4SRec框架进行了扩展……

arXiv:2606.00125v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Music recommendation systems typically treat songs as opaque tokens, relying on interaction histories that overlook semantic or acoustic content. Prior LLM-augmented, multimodal, and text-enhanced sequential recommenders partially combine semantic, acoustic, or engagement signals, and none jointly model all three within a unified LLM-based framework grounded in song content. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework for session-based music recommendation that enriches the LastFM-1K dataset with three complementary signals: (1) audio and lyric embeddings from pretrained music and text models, (2) LLM-generated semantic metadata using the MGPHot schema, and (3) listening completion ratios. We validate the generated metadata against human MGPHot annotations across all 58 attributes. item.title: 该研究提出一种基于文本检测的AI使用得分新方法，通过分析2020–2025年间PLoS与Nature旗下14万余篇论文，揭示AI辅助写作与更小规模、更年轻的科研团队构成以及更高的短期学术可见性相关联。
item.description:
更小、更年轻、也更可见？AI辅助写作、科研团队构成与科学知识的可见性

Smaller, Younger, and More Visible? AI-Assisted Writing, Scientific Team Composition, and the Visibility of Scientific Knowledge

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27404

该研究提出一种基于文本检测的AI使用得分新方法，通过分析2020–2025年间PLoS与Nature旗下14万余篇论文，揭示AI辅助写作与更小规模、更年轻的科研团队构成以及更高的短期学术可见性相关联。

生成式人工智能正在重塑学术交流，然而人们对AI辅助写作与科学知识生产的组织方式及可见性之间的关系仍知之甚少。本研究考察了AI修改文本、发表团队特征与学术可见性之间的关联。基于2020至2025年间PLoS期刊家族与Nature Portfolio发表的144,930篇全文论文与综述，我们采用一种新颖的基于文本的检测方法来估计AI使用得分，作为AI辅助写作的间接指标。这些得分并不直接测度学术写作中实际的AI使用情况，而是提供AI辅助写作的间接信号。我们关注学术交流的两个维度：科学知识的生产与传播。前者体现为两项团队特征，后者则以短期引用量来衡量。我们考察了AI使用得分与……的关联（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2605.27404v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping scholarly communication, yet little is known about how AI-assisted writing relates to the organization and visibility of scientific knowledge production. This study examines the associations between AI-modified text, publication-team characteristics, and scholarly visibility. Drawing on 144,930 full-text articles and reviews from the PLoS family and the Nature Portfolio published between 2020 and 2025, we use a novel text-based detection approach to estimate AI usage scores as indirect indicators of AI-assisted writing. These scores do not directly measure actual AI use in academic writing but provide indirect signals of AI-assisted writing. We focus on two dimensions of scholarly communication: the production and dissemination of scientific knowledge. item.title: 提出了EEG-FM-Audit系统性评估与诊断流水线，通过公平校准基准测试、范式级别消融实验和神经生理学探测三大模块，全面审计脑电图基础模型的性能表现、各学习范式的真实贡献及其决策所依赖的神经生理学特征的有效性。
item.description:
EEG-FM-Audit：脑电图基础模型的系统性评估与分析流水线

EEG-FM-Audit: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis Pipeline for EEG Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26910

提出了EEG-FM-Audit系统性评估与诊断流水线，通过公平校准基准测试、范式级别消融实验和神经生理学探测三大模块，全面审计脑电图基础模型的性能表现、各学习范式的真实贡献及其决策所依赖的神经生理学特征的有效性。

脑电图基础模型（EEG-FMs）展现出从异构脑电信号中学习通用表征的潜力。然而，现有研究存在三个关键局限：模型调优过程不透明、复杂学习范式对EEG-FMs的贡献未经实证验证，以及对基础模型赖以做出决策的神经生理学特征理解有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EEG-FM-Audit，一个包含三个模块的系统性评估与诊断流水线：（1）公平校准的基准测试协议，通过对EEG-FMs和有监督基线模型进行量身定制的超参数优化来确保公平比较；（2）三个范式级别的消融工作流，用于分离异构数据规模、自监督预训练和预训练语言先验的贡献；（3）神经生理学探测（NPP）框架，用于探究基础模型是否利用了有效的脑电特征。

arXiv:2605.26910v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) show potential for learning generalized representations from heterogeneous EEG signals. However, existing studies exhibit three critical limitations: opaque model tuning, unverified contributions of complex learning paradigms to EEG-FMs, and a limited understanding of the neurophysiological features that FMs rely on to make decisions. To address these challenges, we propose EEG-FM-Audit, a systematic evaluation and diagnostic pipeline comprising three modules: (1) a fairness-calibrated benchmarking protocol ensuring fair comparisons through model-tailored hyperparameter optimization for EEG-FMs and supervised baselines; (2) three paradigm-level ablation workflows isolating contributions of heterogeneous data scale, self-supervised pretraining, and pretrained linguistic priors; and (3) a neurophysiological probing (NPP) framework exploring whether FMs leverage valid EEG features. item.title: 提出了 MemFail 诊断基准，将记忆系统分解为摘要、存储和检索三种操作，并通过五个对抗性设计的数据集系统性地隔离和压力测试大语言模型记忆系统的具体故障模式。
item.description:
MemFail：对大语言模型记忆系统故障模式的压力测试

MemFail: Stress-Testing Failure Modes of LLM Memory Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26667

提出了 MemFail 诊断基准，将记忆系统分解为摘要、存储和检索三种操作，并通过五个对抗性设计的数据集系统性地隔离和压力测试大语言模型记忆系统的具体故障模式。

大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖外部记忆系统以在长时程交互中保持一致性，但针对这些系统具体故障模式和设计选择的实证研究却非常匮乏。现有基准仅报告聚合的问答准确率，并将记忆系统视为黑箱，因此无法将错误的答案归因于系统的某个特定故障模式。我们提出了 MemFail，一个用于隔离现代大语言模型记忆系统故障模式的诊断性基准。我们首先将记忆系统形式化为三种经典操作——摘要、存储和检索——的组合，并识别每种操作可能引发的故障模式。基于这些假设的故障模式，我们构建了五个数据集、涵盖四个任务，每个数据集均以对抗方式设计，用于测试记忆系统的某一特定操作。利用这些数据……

arXiv:2605.26667v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to remain consistent across long-horizon interactions, but little empirical work has been done to understand the specific failure modes and design choices that these systems present. Existing benchmarks report aggregate question-answering accuracy and treat memory systems as black boxes, making it impossible to attribute an incorrect answer to a particular failure mode of the system. We introduce MemFail, a diagnostic benchmark that isolates the failure modes of modern LLM memory systems. We begin by formalizing memory systems as the composition of three canonical operations -- summarization, storage, and retrieval -- and identify the potential failure modes induced by each. Based on these hypothesized failure modes, we construct five datasets spanning four tasks, each adversarially designed to test a specific operation of a memory system. Using these data

item.title: 提出BOOST双层优化框架，内层在重加权合成轨迹上训练LLM，外层在真实验证任务上学习轻量级重加权头，无需外部评判器即可自动为合成轨迹分配连续权重，提升多轮微调性能。
item.description:
多轮LLM微调中合成轨迹的双层优化

Bilevel Optimization of Synthetic Trajectories for Multi-Turn LLM Fine-Tuning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24743

提出BOOST双层优化框架，内层在重加权合成轨迹上训练LLM，外层在真实验证任务上学习轻量级重加权头，无需外部评判器即可自动为合成轨迹分配连续权重，提升多轮微调性能。

尽管大语言模型（LLM）在单轮生成方面表现出色，但它们在长时程、多轮交互方面仍存在困难。离线强化学习（RL）提供了一种可扩展的方法，但其性能取决于多轮轨迹数据的可用性和质量。一种常见的补救措施是利用LLM或模拟器生成的合成轨迹来增强训练，但合成数据的质量高度参差不齐，简单地将所有轨迹视为同等信息量会降低性能。我们提出了BOOST，这是一个双层优化框架：内层在重新加权的数据上训练LLM，外层在留出的真实验证任务上训练一个轻量级的重加权头，从而为轨迹分配连续的轨迹级权重，且无需外部评判器。为了给该方法奠定理论基础，我们推导了一个PAC-Bayesian界，揭示了三方权衡：合成数据增加了多样性但带来任务偏移的风险，而集中……

arXiv:2605.24743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While LLMs excel at single-turn generation, they struggle with long-horizon, multi-turn interactions. Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a scalable approach, yet its performance hinges on the availability and quality of multi-turn trajectory data. A common remedy is to augment training with synthetic trajectories generated by LLMs or simulators, but synthetic data is highly heterogeneous in quality, and naively treating all trajectories as equally informative can degrade performance. We propose BOOST, a bilevel optimization framework where the inner level trains the LLM on reweighted data and the outer level trains a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks, assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without requiring an external judge. To ground this approach, we derive a PAC-Bayesian bound revealing a three-way trade-off: synthetic data increases diversity but risks task-shift, while concentra

item.title: 提出了一种基于分岔理论的表示动力学框架，利用仅从隐藏状态计算得到的无标签相位坐标 β(t)/β_c(t)，可实时检测神经网络中结构化表示的涌现时刻，并在稀疏自编码器、自监督学习和grokking等多种场景中验证了其有效性。
item.description:
特征彩票？概念涌现的分岔理论

Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24057

提出了一种基于分岔理论的表示动力学框架，利用仅从隐藏状态计算得到的无标签相位坐标 β(t)/β_c(t)，可实时检测神经网络中结构化表示的涌现时刻，并在稀疏自编码器、自监督学习和grokking等多种场景中验证了其有效性。

神经网络在训练过程中的特定时点会学习到结构化表示，然而精确定位这些转变通常需要事后的、依赖标签的度量指标。我们引入了一种表示动力学的分岔理论，以实时检测这些关键时刻。通过分析演化中编码器上的被动GMM探针，我们证明了结构的涌现对应于由损失Hessian矩阵驱动的超临界叉式分岔。将理论上可预测的过零点（β_c）与网络当前状态（β）进行比较，可得到一个动态比值 β(t)/β_c(t)。该比值仅由隐藏状态计算得出，是表示动力学的通用、无标签的相位坐标。我们在多种设置中验证了该坐标所预测的四种转变状态：语言模型（Pythia）上的稀疏自编码器（SAE）、自监督学习（CIFAR）以及grokking（模运算）现象。

arXiv:2605.24057v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neural networks learn structured representations at specific points during training, yet pinpointing these transitions usually requires post-hoc, label-dependent metrics. We introduce a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics to detect these moments in real time. By analyzing a passive GMM probe on an evolving encoder, we show that the emergence of structure corresponds to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian. Comparing a theoretically predictable zero-crossing ($\beta_c$) with the network's current state ($\beta$) yields a dynamic ratio, $\beta(t)/\beta_c(t)$. Computed solely from hidden states, this ratio is a universal, label-free phase coordinate for representation dynamics. We validate the four transition regimes this coordinate predicts across diverse settings: sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on language models (Pythia), self-supervised learning (CIFAR), and grokking (modular arithmetic). item.title: MemForest将智能体记忆重新表述为写入高效的时间数据管理问题，通过并行提取和MemTree分层时间索引实现并发记忆操作，用局部脏路径刷新替代全局重写，显著提升记忆写入效率。
item.description:
MemForest：一种具有分层时间索引的高效智能体记忆系统

MemForest: An Efficient Agent Memory System with Hierarchical Temporal Indexing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23986

MemForest将智能体记忆重新表述为写入高效的时间数据管理问题，通过并行提取和MemTree分层时间索引实现并发记忆操作，用局部脏路径刷新替代全局重写，显著提升记忆写入效率。

记忆是长上下文LLM智能体的基础组件，通过持续的“服务-更新”生命周期支持跨交互的持久状态维护。尽管已有大量先前工作，许多有状态系统在写入路径上仍保留顺序自回归提取或依赖状态的维护，从而延迟了新证据变得可查询的时间。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MemForest，一个将智能体记忆重新表述为写入高效的时间数据管理问题的记忆框架。MemForest通过并行提取打破顺序瓶颈，将记忆构建解耦为并发、独立的操作。我们进一步引入MemTree，一种分层时间索引，将记忆组织为按时间排序的树，并用局部脏路径刷新替代全局重写。脏摘要可以在跨节点和跨树之间并行刷新。端到端工作量仍与传入内容成比例。

arXiv:2605.23986v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Memory is a fundamental component for long-context LLM agents, supporting persistent state across interactions through a continuous serve-and-update lifecycle. Despite substantial prior work, many stateful systems retain sequential autoregressive extraction or state-dependent maintenance on the write path, delaying when new evidence becomes queryable. To address these challenges, we present MemForest, a memory framework that reformulates agent memory as a write-efficient temporal data-management problem. MemForest breaks the sequential bottleneck via parallel extraction, decoupling memory construction into concurrent, independent operations. We further introduce MemTree, a hierarchical temporal index that organizes memory as time-ordered trees and replaces global rewrites with localized dirty-path refresh. Dirty summaries can be refreshed in parallel across nodes and trees. End-to-end work remains proportional to incoming conte

item.title: 本文提出以随机特征选择作为基线来评估无监督特征选择方法，发现许多最先进的方法在性能和效率上竟然不如随机选择，强调了建立评估基线的重要性。
item.description:
比随机还差：无监督特征选择中基线的重要性——扩展版

Worse than Random: The Importance of a Baseline for Unsupervised Feature Selection -- Extended Version

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22973

本文提出以随机特征选择作为基线来评估无监督特征选择方法，发现许多最先进的方法在性能和效率上竟然不如随机选择，强调了建立评估基线的重要性。

每年都有许多新颖的无监督特征选择方法被提出，然而它们的实证评估仅限于在选定数据集上计算的有监督和无监督评估指标，以及与现有方法的比较。然而，在缺乏已建立的评估基线的情况下，很难确定这些方法为现有文献带来的额外价值，以及它们的基础方法究竟有多有效。在这项评估研究中，我们使用随机特征选择作为评估无监督特征选择方法的基线。虽然随机选择特征看起来似乎是一个相当弱的基线，但我们在这项评估研究中表明，许多最先进的无监督特征选择方法在性能和效率上都败给了随机特征选择。因此，我们强调在评估无监督特征选择方法时严格考虑随机特征选择基线的必要性。

arXiv:2605.22973v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many novel unsupervised feature selection methods are proposed each year, yet their empirical evaluation is limited to supervised and unsupervised evaluation metrics computed on selected datasets, along with comparisons to existing methods. However, in the absence of an established evaluation baseline, it is difficult to determine the value added to the existing literature by each of these methods, and how effective their underlying approaches are. In this evaluation study, we are using random feature selection as a baseline for evaluating unsupervised feature selection methods. While a random selection of features might seem to be a rather weak baseline, we show in this evaluation study that many of the state-of-the-art methods in unsupervised feature selection are outperformed by random feature selection in both performance and efficiency. Accordingly, we emphasize the strict requirement of considering random feature selectio

item.title: 该论文提出A-LEMS框架，将智能体AI系统的能耗计量单位从“每次模型调用”重新定义为“每成功目标的能耗”，从而更真实地反映包含重试与故障恢复在内的完整任务能耗成本。
item.description:
每成功目标的能耗：面向智能体AI系统的目标级能耗核算

Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22883

该论文提出A-LEMS框架，将智能体AI系统的能耗计量单位从“每次模型调用”重新定义为“每成功目标的能耗”，从而更真实地反映包含重试与故障恢复在内的完整任务能耗成本。

当前的AI能耗基准测试以每次模型调用为单位来衡量能耗。然而对于智能体系统而言，单个用户目标可能触发多步骤编排、工具调用、重试和故障恢复，调用次数只是实现层面的产物而非任务本身的属性，因此按推理次数进行归一化会歪曲完成一个目标的真实能耗成本。我们提出了A-LEMS（智能体LLM能耗测量系统），这是一个跨层框架，将AI能耗核算的基本单元重新定义为“每成功目标的能耗””：即跨越所有尝试（包括失败和重试）的总工作流能耗除以成功完成的目标数量。A-LEMS结合了时间边界模型、将硬件信号（x86上的RAPL；ARM上的SPBM和DCGM）映射到工作流能耗的五层归因管线，以及将每次测量与硬件、环境和运行时配置绑定的可复现性协议。基于EpG，我们进一步定义了Orch……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2605.22883v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Current AI energy benchmarks measure consumption per model invocation. For agentic systems, where a single user goal may trigger multistep orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure recovery, the invocation count is an implementation artifact rather than a task property, and per inference normalization misrepresents the energy cost of completing a goal. We present A-LEMS (Agentic LLM Energy Measurement System), a cross layer framework that redefines the unit of AI energy accounting as Energy per Successful Goal (EpG): total workflow energy across all attempts, including failures and retries, divided by successfully completed goals. A-LEMS combines a temporal boundary model, a five layer attribution pipeline mapping hardware signals (RAPL on x86; SPBM and DCGM on ARM) to workflow energy, and a reproducibility protocol binding every measurement to hardware, environment, and runtime configuration. Building on EpG, we define the Orc

item.title: ProxySHAP将树代理模型的高样本效率与情景残差校正相结合，实现了Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用估计在速度与精度上的兼得，并首次提出多项式时间的树集成精确交互指数计算方法。
item.description:
基于代理模型的Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用近似

Proxy-Based Approximation of Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22738

ProxySHAP将树代理模型的高样本效率与情景残差校正相结合，实现了Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用估计在速度与精度上的兼得，并首次提出多项式时间的树集成精确交互指数计算方法。

Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用能够刻画现代机器学习应用中固有的复杂动态。然而，现有的高阶交互作用估计器在速度与精度之间难以兼顾。为克服这一局限，我们提出了ProxySHAP。ProxySHAP将基于树的代理模型的高样本效率与情景残差校正相结合，从而恢复一致性。在理论层面，我们推导出了干预式TreeSHAP的多项式时间泛化方法，可为树集成模型计算精确的交互作用指数，从而规避了以往方法中指数级树深度的依赖。此外，我们对残差调整策略进行了正式分析，刻画了最大样本复用在何种具体条件下能够校正代理偏差，同时其方差不会随交互作用规模呈指数级增长。大量基准测试表明，ProxySHAP树立了新的最先进水平。

arXiv:2605.22738v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Shapley and Banzhaf interactions capture the complex dynamics inherent in modern machine learning applications. However, current estimators for these higher-order interactions trade off between speed and accuracy. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProxySHAP. ProxySHAP reconciles the high sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with a situational residual correction recovering consistency. On a theoretical level, we derive a polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP that computes exact interaction indices for tree ensembles, thereby bypassing exponential tree-depth dependencies in prior methods. Furthermore, we formally analyze the residual adjustment strategy, characterizing the specific conditions under which Maximum Sample Reuse (MSR) corrects proxy bias without its variance scaling exponentially with interaction size. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that ProxySHAP sets a new state-of-the-art

item.title: 该论文提出推理时论证框架，利用形式化论证语义同时指导大语言模型生成并评分支持和反对声明的论证、以及计算三元（真/假/不确定）的可解释声明验证预测。
item.description:
面向推理时论证的神经符号学习

Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20098

该论文提出推理时论证框架，利用形式化论证语义同时指导大语言模型生成并评分支持和反对声明的论证、以及计算三元（真/假/不确定）的可解释声明验证预测。

声明验证是包括健康和金融在内的高风险领域中的一个重要问题。当支撑声明的信息不完整或相互冲突时，给出不确定的答案可能比二元的真假分类更为合适。在所有情况下，对决定最终判断的考量因素给出忠实的解释都至关重要。我们提出了推理时论证，这是一个用于三元声明验证的可训练神经符号框架，其中用于衡量声明和论证强度的形式化论证语义被用于两个方面：(i) 在模型学习为声明生成支持和反对的论证并为其分配基础分数（代表内在强度）时，指导大语言模型的训练；(ii) 从生成的、已评分的论证中计算三元（真/假/不确定）预测。因此，在训练阶段，论证的生成与评分可以根据所得论证质量进行优化。

arXiv:2605.20098v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Claim verification is an important problem in high-stakes settings, including health and finance. When information underpinning claims is incomplete or conflicting, uncertain answers may be more appropriate than binary true or false classifications. In all cases, faithful explanations of the considerations determining the final verdict are crucial. We introduce inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification in which a formal argumentation semantics giving the strength of claims and arguments is used both (i) to guide LLM training as models learn to generate arguments for and against claims and assign them base scores (representing intrinsic strengths) and (ii) to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) predictions from generated, scored arguments. As a result, at training time, argument generation and scoring can be optimised according to the quality of the induced argumentative

item.title: 提出全循环Transformer（FLT），通过全循环架构和注意力注入两项无需新增参数的设计，解决了循环Transformer在多次循环迭代下难以优化的问题，实现稳定训练。
item.description:
全循环Transformer：一种简单稳定的循环稳定方法

Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18797

提出全循环Transformer（FLT），通过全循环架构和注意力注入两项无需新增参数的设计，解决了循环Transformer在多次循环迭代下难以优化的问题，实现稳定训练。

提升模型性能通常需要增大模型规模。循环Transformer（LT）提供了一种参数高效的替代方案：通过反复复用相同的Transformer块，在不增加参数量或上下文长度的情况下，将额外的计算转化为性能提升。然而，随着循环迭代次数的增加，LT变得越来越难以优化，常常导致梯度震荡、残差爆炸和训练崩溃等问题。我们提出了全循环Transformer（FLT），这是一种简单的、不引入参数的重新设计，无需添加可学习参数或施加特殊设计的优化约束即可解决这些问题。FLT将全循环架构（Fully Looped Architecture，将循环状态暴露给每一层）与注意力注入（Attention Injection，通过现有注意力模块控制循环信息流）相结合。这些改进使FLT能够在12次循环中稳定训练。

arXiv:2605.18797v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scaling model performance typically requires increasing model size. Looped Transformer (LT) offers a parameter-efficient alternative by repeatedly reusing the same Transformer blocks, converting additional computation into performance gains without increasing the parameter count or context length. However, increasing the number of loop iterations makes LT increasingly difficult to optimize, often leading to gradient oscillation, residual explosion, and training collapse. We propose the Fully Looped Transformer (FLT), a simple, parameter-free redesign that addresses these problems without adding learnable parameters or imposing specially designed optimization constraints. FLT combines a Fully Looped Architecture, which exposes the recurrent state to every layer, with Attention Injection, which controls recurrent information flow through the existing attention module. These modifications enable FLT to train stably through 12 loop

item.title: 提出了首个针对社交群体场景的AI记忆系统基准SocialMemBench，通过430个人设和1,031个问答对构成的合成社交网络，揭示了现有记忆系统在群体对话中的五种失败模式。
item.description:
SocialMemBench：AI记忆系统是否已为社交群体场景做好准备？

SocialMemBench: Are AI Memory Systems Ready for Social Group Settings?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17789

提出了首个针对社交群体场景的AI记忆系统基准SocialMemBench，通过430个人设和1,031个问答对构成的合成社交网络，揭示了现有记忆系统在群体对话中的五种失败模式。

面向AI助手的记忆系统是为单用户对话设计的，这一设计与多方社交群体场景并不匹配。这对当今正在构建的社交助手至关重要：聊天平台中以群体方式运作的智能体，以及主动式个人助手——其对用户的建模必须包含用户的社交背景。现有的记忆基准评估的是双人对话或职场对话；没有针对社交群体的基准，而在社交群体中，记忆必须将事实锚定于共享历史而非职业角色，区分群体规范与个体例外，并且在成员离开后仍能正确归属信息。我们提出了SocialMemBench，这是一个经人工验证的合成社交群体网络基准，涵盖五种群体原型和三种规模层级（4-30名成员），包含430个人设和1,031个问答对，分布于九个问题类别。我们的评估揭示了五种失败模式，并将其表述为可检验的假设，同时我们通过研究为其中两种提供了证据。

arXiv:2605.17789v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Memory systems for AI assistants were built for single-user dialogue, a design mismatched to multi-party social group settings. This matters for the social assistants being built today: group-acting agents in chat platforms, and proactive personal assistants whose model of a user must include their social context. Existing memory benchmarks evaluate dyadic or workplace dialogue; none targets social groups, where memory must anchor facts in shared history rather than professional roles, separate group norms from individual exceptions, and attribute correctly even after a member leaves. We introduce SocialMemBench, a benchmark of human-verified synthetic social group networks across five archetypes and three size tiers (4-30 members), with 430 personas and 1,031 QA pairs across nine question categories. Our evaluation exposes five failure modes, framed as testable hypotheses, and we provide evidence on two through the research

item.title: 提出信念引擎（BE）框架，将智能体立场建模为对命题的可审计贝叶斯证据状态，在对数几率空间中通过可解释参数进行更新，使LLM智能体在审议互动中的立场变化可追溯、可审计。
item.description:
信念引擎：使智能体立场在大语言模型审议中可审计

Belief Engine: Making Agent Stance Auditable in LLM Deliberation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15343

提出信念引擎（BE）框架，将智能体立场建模为对命题的可审计贝叶斯证据状态，在对数几率空间中通过可解释参数进行更新，使LLM智能体在审议互动中的立场变化可追溯、可审计。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体正越来越多地被用于模拟审议性的社会互动，包括谈判、冲突解决和多轮意见交流。模拟类人的观点变化需要智能体能够在既有信念与对新证据的开放性之间取得平衡，同时使其对该证据的响应可追溯。当前系统往往使这一点变得困难：智能体可能偏离被分配的角色、附和互动对象、在面对相反证据时仍坚持原有立场，或者仅仅因为提示词或检索到的上下文发生变化而“看起来”改变了观点。我们提出了信念引擎，这是一个以贝叶斯建模意义使用“信念”概念的框架，即把信念作为对某一命题持续维护的证据状态，并以标量立场的形式对外呈现。BE提取结构化证据、存储论证记录，并通过在对数几率空间中受贝叶斯启发的立场更新机制来更新信念状态，该机制包含两个可解释的控制参数：证据吸收度u（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2605.15343v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM-based AI agents are increasingly used to simulate deliberative social interactions, including negotiation, conflict resolution, and multi-turn opinion exchanges. Simulating human-like opinion change calls for agents that balance existing beliefs with openness to new evidence, while making their responses to that evidence traceable. Current systems often make this difficult: agents may drift from assigned roles, echo an interaction partner, keep a stance despite contrary evidence, or appear to change because the prompt or retrieved context has changed. We introduce the Belief Engine (BE), a framework that uses "belief" in a Bayesian modelling sense, as a maintained evidential state over a proposition that is exposed as a scalar stance. BE extracts structured evidence, stores argument records, and updates the belief state through a Bayesian-inspired stance update in log-odds space with two interpretable controls: evidence uptake u

item.title: 该研究发现大语言模型在高风险抵押贷款决策中虽然输出公平，但其内部各层仍保留并放大的种族偏见表征具有因果效力，重新注入可导致决策近乎完全逆转，且这种潜在偏见在不同人口群体间是不对称的。
item.description:
公平的输出，有偏见的内部：大语言模型在高风险决策中潜在偏见的因果效力与不对称性

Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15217

该研究发现大语言模型在高风险抵押贷款决策中虽然输出公平，但其内部各层仍保留并放大的种族偏见表征具有因果效力，重新注入可导致决策近乎完全逆转，且这种潜在偏见在不同人口群体间是不对称的。

经过指令微调的语言模型在高风险决策中表现出行为层面的公平性，同时其内部表征中仍保留着有偏见的关联。然而，这些被抑制的表征是否能够影响模型输出——以及这种因果效力是否在不同人口群体之间对称——仍然未知。我们使用仅在种族相关姓名上不同的匹配申请，研究了开源权重模型在抵押贷款承保中的应用，并揭示了一个关键的脱节现象：模型在输出层面没有表现出偏见，但在模型各层中却保留并放大了人口统计表征。通过激活引导和新型跨层干预方法，我们证明这些被抑制的信息与决策相关：当在关键层重新注入时，会产生近乎完全的决策逆转。至关重要的是，这种潜在偏见是不对称的——引导干预仅在一个人口统计方向上影响决策。

arXiv:2605.15217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Instruction-tuned language models exhibit behavioural fairness in high-stakes decisions while retaining biased associations in their internal representations. However, whether these suppressed representations can affect model outputs - and whether such causal potency is symmetric across demographic groups - remains unknown. We investigate the use of open-weight models for mortgage underwriting using matched applications that differ only in racially-associated names and reveal a critical disconnect: models show no output-level bias, yet retain and amplify demographic representations across model layers. Through activation steering and novel cross-layer interventions, we demonstrate that this suppressed information is decision-relevant: when reinjected at critical layers, it produces near-complete decision reversals. Critically, this latent bias is asymmetric - steering interventions affect decisions in one demographic direction, while

item.title: 提出MMGuard方法，通过注入利用LVLM学习动态的不可感知扰动生成“不可学习的多模态样本”，诱导模型过拟合于噪声，使数据所有者能够在侵权发生前主动保护多模态数据免受未经授权的模型微调。
item.description:
看见并不等于学会：保护多模态数据免受大型视觉语言模型的未授权微调

To See is Not to Learn: Protecting Multimodal Data from Unauthorized Fine-Tuning of Large Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14291

提出MMGuard方法，通过注入利用LVLM学习动态的不可感知扰动生成“不可学习的多模态样本”，诱导模型过拟合于噪声，使数据所有者能够在侵权发生前主动保护多模态数据免受未经授权的模型微调。

大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的快速发展伴随着对其多模态网络数据的未经授权抓取和训练，这给数据所有者带来了版权和隐私风险。现有的应对措施，如机器遗忘和水印技术，本质上都是事后方法，只能在知识产权侵权已经发生后才发挥作用。在这项工作中，我们提出了MMGuard，使数据所有者能够主动保护其多模态数据免受未经授权的LVLM微调。MMGuard通过注入人类无法察觉的扰动来生成不可学习的样本，这些扰动利用了LVLMs的学习动态。通过最小化训练损失，该扰动创建了一个优化捷径，导致模型过拟合于噪声，从而在推理阶段扰动不存在时降低模型的下游性能。为了进一步强化这种防御，MMGuard引入了跨模……

arXiv:2605.14291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) is increasingly accompanied by unauthorized scraping and training on multimodal web data, posing copyright and privacy risks to data owners. Existing countermeasures, such as machine unlearning and watermarks, are inherently post-hoc approaches that act only after intellectual property infringement has already occurred. In this work, we propose MMGuard to empower data owners to proactively protect their multimodal data against unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning. MMGuard generates unlearnable examples by injecting human-imperceptible perturbations that exploit the learning dynamics of LVLMs. By minimizing the training loss, the perturbation creates an optimization shortcut, causing the model to overfit to the noise and thereby degrading downstream performance when the perturbation is absent during inference. To further strengthen this defense, MMGuard introduces a cross-mo

item.title: RealICU是一个由资深医生回溯完整患者轨迹后进行标注的ICU评估基准，通过患者状态评估、急性问题、推荐行动和危险信号四个医生视角的任务，突破传统“模仿历史医生行为”的评估范式，从而更真实地衡量大语言模型在ICU长上下文数据上的临床推理能力。
item.description:
RealICU：大语言模型智能体真的理解长上下文ICU数据吗？一个超越行为模仿的基准测试

RealICU: Do LLM Agents Understand Long-Context ICU Data? A Benchmark Beyond Behavior Imitation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13542

RealICU是一个由资深医生回溯完整患者轨迹后进行标注的ICU评估基准，通过患者状态评估、急性问题、推荐行动和危险信号四个医生视角的任务，突破传统“模仿历史医生行为”的评估范式，从而更真实地衡量大语言模型在ICU长上下文数据上的临床推理能力。

重症监护病房（ICU）产生长而密集且不断演变的临床信息流，医生必须在时间压力下反复重新评估患者状态，这凸显了对可靠AI决策支持的迫切需求。现有的ICU基准通常将历史临床医生的操作作为真值标准。然而，这些操作是在信息不完整且对潜在患者状态的时间背景了解有限的情况下做出的，因此可能是次优的，这使得难以评估AI系统的真实推理能力。我们提出了RealICU，这是一个用于在真实ICU条件下评估大语言模型（LLM）的后视标注基准，其中标签由资深医生在审查完整患者轨迹后创建。我们设计了四个由医生需求驱动的任务：评估患者状态、急性问题、推荐行动，以及可能导致不安全结果的危险信号行动。我们对每条轨迹进行划分……

arXiv:2605.13542v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Intensive care units (ICU) generate long, dense and evolving streams of clinical information, where physicians must repeatedly reassess patient states under time pressure, underscoring a clear need for reliable AI decision support. Existing ICU benchmarks typically treat historical clinician actions as ground truth. However, these actions are made under incomplete information and limited temporal context of the underlying patient state, and may therefore be suboptimal, making it difficult to assess the true reasoning capabilities of AI systems. We introduce RealICU, a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory. We formulate four physician-motivated tasks: assess Patient Status, Acute Problems, Recommended Actions, and Red Flag actions that risk unsafe outcomes. We partition each trajectory

item.title: 本文提出EcoGEO框架，将生成式引擎优化（GEO）从单网页层面扩展为面向网络增强型LLM搜索智能体的环境级影响力问题，并设计了轨迹感知的协同证据生态系统TRACE，通过控制智能体浏览轨迹中证据的组织、连接与呈现方式来影响其搜索结果。
item.description:
EcoGEO：面向网络增强型大语言模型搜索代理的轨迹感知证据生态系统

EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12887

本文提出EcoGEO框架，将生成式引擎优化（GEO）从单网页层面扩展为面向网络增强型LLM搜索智能体的环境级影响力问题，并设计了轨迹感知的协同证据生态系统TRACE，通过控制智能体浏览轨迹中证据的组织、连接与呈现方式来影响其搜索结果。

arXiv:2605.12887v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：具备网络访问能力的大语言模型智能体正在改变在线信息影响搜索结果的方式。现有的生成式引擎优化（GEO）研究主要聚焦于单个网页。然而，智能体化的网络搜索并非单文档场景：智能体可能会发出查询、抓取页面、跟踪链接、重新表述搜索，并在多个浏览步骤中综合证据。因此，影响力不仅取决于页面内容，还取决于页面如何沿着智能体的浏览轨迹被组织、连接和呈现。我们通过生态系统生成式引擎优化（EcoGEO）来研究这一转变，该方法将GEO视为面向网络增强型大语言模型智能体的环境级影响力问题。为了具体实现这一视角，我们提出了TRACE——一个轨迹感知的协同证据生态系统。给定一个推荐查询和一个虚构的目标产品，我们的方法构建了一个受控的证据环境，该环境协调智能体辅助的……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2605.12887v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Web-enabled LLM agents are changing how online information influences search outcomes. Existing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) studies mainly focus on individual webpages. However, agentic web search is not a single-document setting: an agent may issue queries, crawl pages, follow links, reformulate searches, and synthesize evidence across multiple browsing steps. Influence therefore depends not only on page content, but also on how pages are organized, connected, and encountered along the agent's browsing trajectory. We study this shift through Ecosystem Generative Engine Optimization (EcoGEO), which treats GEO as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents. To instantiate this perspective, we propose TRACE, a Trajectory-Aware Coordinated Evidence Ecosystem. Given a recommendation query and a fictional target product, our method builds a controlled evidence environment that coordinates an agent-faci

item.title: 该研究将注意力感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）从事后归因方法扩展到基于Transformer架构的脑电图基础模型，既能验证模型决策，又能揭露“聪明汉斯”行为并生成生物学上合理的新神经科学假设。
item.description:
从“聪明汉斯”到科学假设：使用LRP解释脑电图基础模型Transformer

From Clever Hans to Hypotheses: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11885

该研究将注意力感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）从事后归因方法扩展到基于Transformer架构的脑电图基础模型，既能验证模型决策，又能揭露“聪明汉斯”行为并生成生物学上合理的新神经科学假设。

arXiv:2605.11885v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：脑电图（EEG）领域新兴的基础模型（FM）有望在数据稀缺的情况下，将深度学习扩展应用于诊断和脑机接口领域，但其不透明的特性仍是阻碍其广泛应用的壁垒。我们研究了注意力感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）作为脑电图基础模型的事后归因方法，将LRP在基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的脑电图模型上的应用扩展到当前基础模型所依赖的Transformer架构。我们发现，LRP既能够验证脑电图基础模型的决策，又能从中挖掘出新颖且生物学上合理的假设。在运动想象任务中，它揭露了“聪明汉斯”行为，即模型优先依赖与任务相关的眼部信号，而非预期的运动相关信号。在一个用于情感预测的自然范式实验中，它揭示了模型反复依赖于一个中央电极簇，这提示了一种可能代表唤醒状态的感觉运动特征。尽管热图解释……（原文摘要截断）

arXiv:2605.11885v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Emerging foundation models (FMs) in electroencephalography (EEG) promise a path to scale deep learning in diagnostics and brain-computer interfaces despite data scarcity, yet their opaque nature remains a barrier to wider adoption. We investigate attention-aware Layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) as a post-hoc attribution method for EEG-FMs, extending LRP's use on convolutional neural network (CNN)-based EEG models to the Transformer architectures that current FMs are based on. We find that LRP can both verify EEG-FM decisions and surface novel, biologically plausible hypotheses from them. In motor imagery, it unmasks 'Clever Hans' behavior where models prioritize task correlated ocular signals over the intended motor correlates. In a naturalistic paradigm for affect prediction, it reveals a recurring reliance on a central electrode cluster, suggesting a candidate sensorimotor signature of arousal. item.title: 提出SFFL视听推理框架，通过模态特定的思维链推理先将音频与视觉推理过程分离再融合，并利用模态偏好标签作为强化学习的辅助奖励，从而缓解视听大语言模型中的跨模态干扰与幻觉问题。
item.description:
先分离，后融合：利用模态特定思维链缓解视听大语言模型推理中的跨模态干扰

Separate First, Fuse Later: Mitigating Cross-Modal Interference in Audio-Visual LLMs Reasoning with Modality-Specific Chain-of-Thought

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09906

提出SFFL视听推理框架，通过模态特定的思维链推理先将音频与视觉推理过程分离再融合，并利用模态偏好标签作为强化学习的辅助奖励，从而缓解视听大语言模型中的跨模态干扰与幻觉问题。

音频与视觉为视听问答提供了互补的证据，然而当前的视听大语言模型可能受到跨模态干扰的影响：来自某一模态的信息会误导对另一模态的解读，从而引发幻觉。我们将这一问题归因于中间推理过程中不受控制的跨模态交互。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了“先分离，后融合”（Separate First, Fuse Later, SFFL），一个旨在减少跨模态干扰的视听推理框架。SFFL强制执行模态特定的思维链推理，生成独立的音频和视觉推理轨迹，并整合证据以进行回答。我们通过一个数据管道，在不同的模态输入设置下构建模态偏好标签。我们将这些标签作为强化学习中的辅助奖励，以鼓励模型在回答时对模态线索形成依赖于具体实例的偏好。我们进一步引入了一个模……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2605.09906v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Audio and vision provide complementary evidence for audio-visual question answering, yet current audio-visual large language models may suffer from cross-modal interference: information from one modality misguides the interpretation of another, thereby inducing hallucinations. We attribute this issue to uncontrolled cross-modal interactions during intermediate reasoning. To mitigate this, we propose Separate First, Fuse Later (SFFL), an audio-visual reasoning framework designed to reduce cross-modal interference. SFFL enforces modality-specific chain-of-thought reasoning, producing separate audio and visual reasoning traces and integrating evidence for answering. We construct modality-preference labels via a data pipeline under different modality input settings. We use these labels as an auxiliary reward in reinforcement learning to encourage a instance-dependent preference for modality cues when answering. We further introduce a mod

item.title: 本文首次开展跨层稀疏自编码器缩放研究，发现激活流形的内在维度与曲率等几何结构随深度的变化能够逐层预测 SAE 的缩放定律，从而解释了重构误差为何在各层间剧烈波动。
item.description:
几何之墙：流形结构预测稀疏自编码器的逐层缩放定律

The Geometric Wall: Manifold Structure Predicts Layerwise Sparse Autoencoder Scaling Laws

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09887

本文首次开展跨层稀疏自编码器缩放研究，发现激活流形的内在维度与曲率等几何结构随深度的变化能够逐层预测 SAE 的缩放定律，从而解释了重构误差为何在各层间剧烈波动。

SAE（稀疏自编码器）将线性表示假设付诸实践：它们将模型激活重构为字典原子的稀疏线性组合，这些字典原子被假设为承载有意义的线性方向。其重构误差在各层之间变化剧烈，而已有的在单一层上拟合的缩放定律无法解释这一现象。我们认为，这种变化正是激活流形几何结构随深度演变的经验痕迹：随着流形的内在维度和曲率逐层变化，用稀疏线性字典对其进行逼近的难度也随之改变，因此 SAE 的宽度—稀疏度缩放规律成为流形结构的逐层依赖函数，而非单一的普适定律。我们开展了首个跨层 SAE 缩放研究，对横跨 Gemma 2 2B 和 9B 全部 68 层的 844 个残差流 Gemma Scope SAE 检查点拟合逐层缩放定律曲面，并将拟合所得…

arXiv:2605.09887v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: SAEs operationalise the linear representation hypothesis: they reconstruct model activations as sparse linear combinations of dictionary atoms hypothesised to represent meaningful linear directions. Their reconstruction error varies sharply across layers in ways that existing scaling laws, fitted at a single layer, do not explain. We contend that this variation is the empirical trace of the changing geometric structure of activation manifolds across depth: as their intrinsic dimension and curvature vary from layer to layer, so does the difficulty of approximating them with sparse linear dictionaries, and SAE width-sparsity scaling becomes a layer-dependent function of manifold structure rather than a single universal law. item.title: Mosaic提出了一种CPU-GPU协同的块稀疏注意力系统，通过输出贡献感知的KV预算分配、注意力头特定且粒度感知的稀疏配置以及跨设备协同调度，解决了长上下文LLM解码中CPU驻留KV缓存访问受PCIe带宽限制和GPU闲置的低效问题。
item.description:
Mosaic：高效的CPU-GPU协同块稀疏注意力

Mosaic: Efficient CPU-GPU Coordinated Block-Sparse Attention

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07719

Mosaic提出了一种CPU-GPU协同的块稀疏注意力系统，通过输出贡献感知的KV预算分配、注意力头特定且粒度感知的稀疏配置以及跨设备协同调度，解决了长上下文LLM解码中CPU驻留KV缓存访问受PCIe带宽限制和GPU闲置的低效问题。

arXiv:2605.07719v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：长上下文LLM服务日益依赖于驻留在CPU上的上下文KV缓存，这由KV卸载和分离式预填充-解码执行所推动。尽管块稀疏注意力减少了KV访问量，但现有设计仍然效率低下：GPU集中式执行在每个解码步骤中都需要从CPU内存获取选定的KV块，使其受限于PCIe带宽；而CPU-GPU分区式执行则将CPU侧的稀疏注意力置于关键路径上，导致大量GPU时间闲置。本文提出了Mosaic，一个用于在CPU驻留上下文KV下实现高效长上下文解码的CPU-GPU协同块稀疏注意力系统。Mosaic建立在三个关键洞察之上：输出贡献感知的KV预算分配、针对注意力头且粒度感知的稀疏配置，以及针对CPU驻留KV的跨设备协同调度。基于这些洞察，Mosaic集成了一个轻量级的注意力头属性预测器和一个粒度-预算（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2605.07719v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-context LLM serving increasingly relies on CPU-resident context KV cache, driven by KV offloading and disaggregated prefill--decode execution. Although block-sparse attention reduces KV access, existing designs remain inefficient: GPU-centralized execution fetches selected KV blocks from CPU memory at each decoding step, making it PCIe-bound, while CPU--GPU partitioned execution places CPU-side sparse attention on the critical path, leaving substantial GPU time idle. This paper presents Mosaic, a CPU--GPU coordinated block-sparse attention system for efficient long-context decoding with CPU-resident context KV. Mosaic builds on three key insights: output-contribution-aware KV budgeting, head-specific and granularity-aware sparse configuration, and cross-device coordinated scheduling for sparse tasks over CPU-resident KV. item.title: LiteGUI通过“引导式在线策略蒸馏”与“多解双层GRPO强化学习”的两阶段后训练框架，使轻量级GUI智能体能够有效应对复杂任务的长时程特性和多条有效交互路径的挑战。
item.description:
LiteGUI：通过多解引导蒸馏与双层强化学习构建轻量级GUI智能体

LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07505

LiteGUI通过“引导式在线策略蒸馏”与“多解双层GRPO强化学习”的两阶段后训练框架，使轻量级GUI智能体能够有效应对复杂任务的长时程特性和多条有效交互路径的挑战。

我们提出了LiteGUI，一个用于构建轻量级GUI智能体的新框架。由于复杂任务的长时程特性以及存在多条有效交互路径，GUI交互带来了独特的挑战，而轻量级GUI智能体难以有效应对这些挑战。为了解决这些问题，LiteGUI引入了一个在记录的GUI状态上运行的两阶段后训练框架。首先，我们提出引导式在线策略蒸馏，通过从人工验证的多解动作标注中选择最匹配的有效动作，在每个GUI状态下提供训练时的特权教师指导，同时保持学生的在线策略rollout不变。其次，我们开发了多解双层GRPO，将动作级监督与基于历史条件、按状态评估的规划质量监督相结合，同时兼顾每个记录的GUI状态下存在的多个有效动作。这两个阶段共同支持多步……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2605.07505v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present LiteGUI, a new framework for building lightweight GUI agents. GUI interaction poses unique challenges due to the long-horizon nature of complex tasks and the existence of multiple valid interaction paths, which are difficult for lightweight GUI agents to handle effectively. To address these challenges, LiteGUI introduces a two-stage post-training framework operating on logged GUI states. First, we propose Guided On-Policy Distillation, which provides training-time privileged teacher guidance at each GUI state by selecting the most-matched valid action from human-verified multi-solution action annotations, while leaving the student's on-policy rollout unchanged. Second, we develop Multi-Solution Dual-Level GRPO, which combines action-level supervision with history-conditioned, per-state planning-quality supervision while accounting for multiple valid actions at each logged GUI state. item.title: 该大规模实证研究（206,000个查询-模型对、六个基准）发现，多LLM路由中报告的“不可解性上限”很大程度上是评估伪影（裁判偏差、截断、输出格式不匹配）造成的，并提出分解框架对失败原因进行归因。
item.description:
多LLM路由中的不可解性上限：评估伪影的实证研究

Unsolvability Ceiling in Multi-LLM Routing: An Empirical Study of Evaluation Artifacts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07395

该大规模实证研究（206,000个查询-模型对、六个基准）发现，多LLM路由中报告的“不可解性上限”很大程度上是评估伪影（裁判偏差、截断、输出格式不匹配）造成的，并提出分解框架对失败原因进行归因。

跨多个大语言模型的高效路由通过将查询导向最便宜的、能力足够的模型，实现了成本与质量的权衡。先前的工作将路由的提升空间归因于一种“不可解性上限”，即模型池中没有任何模型能够解决的查询。我们对多层LLM路由进行了一项大规模研究，使用Gemma 4和Llama 3.1模型家族，在六个基准（MMLU、MedQA、HumanEval、MBPP、Alpaca、ShareGPT）上共包含206,000个查询-模型对。通过LLM-as-a-judge（大模型作为裁判）和精确匹配两种指标进行评估，我们发现所报告的不可解性中有相当大一部分源于评估伪影：(i) 系统性的裁判偏差，偏好冗长而非正确性；(ii) 固定生成预算下的截断；(iii) 输出格式不匹配。通过双裁判验证和精确匹配校准，我们降低了各任务上测得的不可解性。我们引入了一个分解框架，将失败归因于这些伪影，揭示了一致的

arXiv:2605.07395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient routing across multiple LLMs enables cost-quality tradeoffs by directing queries to the cheapest capable model. Prior work attributes routing headroom to an "unsolvability ceiling", queries no model in the pool can solve. We present a large-scale study of multi-tier LLM routing with 206,000 query-model pairs across six benchmarks (MMLU, MedQA, HumanEval, MBPP, Alpaca, ShareGPT) using the Gemma 4 and Llama 3.1 families. Evaluating with both LLM-as-a-judge and exact-match metrics, we show that a substantial portion of reported unsolvability stems from evaluation artifacts: (i) systematic judge biases favoring verbosity over correctness, (ii) truncation under fixed generation budgets, and (iii) output format mismatches. Through dual-judge validation and exact-match grounding, we reduce measured unsolvability across tasks. item.title: 该论文提出了 SpatialEpiBench，一个包含 11 个流行病数据集、采用标准化滚动评估和疫情专用指标的时空流行病预测基准，评估发现结合空间信息和流行病学先验的大多数预测方法在真实场景下表现欠佳。
item.description:
SpatialEpiBench：评估空间信息与流行病学先验在预测中作用的基准

SpatialEpiBench: Benchmarking Spatial Information and Epidemic Priors in Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06530

该论文提出了 SpatialEpiBench，一个包含 11 个流行病数据集、采用标准化滚动评估和疫情专用指标的时空流行病预测基准，评估发现结合空间信息和流行病学先验的大多数预测方法在真实场景下表现欠佳。

准确的流行病预测对公共卫生响应、资源分配和疫情干预至关重要，但由于数据稀疏、噪声大且高度非平稳，预测工作仍然十分困难。由于流行病在相互作用的区域之间展开，时空方法是改进预测的天然选择。尽管人们对空间信息的兴趣日益增长，但目前尚不存在标准化的基准，且现有评估通常采用简单的按时间顺序划分训练集与测试集的方式，无法反映实时预测的实际做法。我们通过 SpatialEpiBench 来填补这一空白，这是一个面向真实公共卫生场景的高难度时空流行病预测基准。SpatialEpiBench 包含 11 个流行病数据集，并采用标准化的滚动评估方式以及针对疫情爆发的专用指标。我们评估了结合广泛使用的流行病学先验（即将通用模型适配到流行病学领域）的邻接信息感知预测模型，但发现大多数方法的表现不佳。

arXiv:2605.06530v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate epidemic forecasting is crucial for public health response, resource allocation, and outbreak intervention, but remains difficult with sparse, noisy, and highly non-stationary data. Because epidemics unfold across interacting regions, spatiotemporal methods are natural candidates for improving forecasts. Despite growing interest in spatial information, no standardized benchmark exists, and current evaluations often use simple chronological train-test splits that do not reflect real-time forecasting practice. We address this gap with SpatialEpiBench, a challenging benchmark for spatiotemporal epidemic forecasting in realistic public-health settings. SpatialEpiBench includes 11 epidemic datasets with standardized rolling evaluations and outbreak-specific metrics. item.title: HaM-World将Mamba选择性记忆与软哈密顿潜在动力学先验相结合，通过把潜在状态分解为规范 子空间和上下文子空间，在长时程规划和动力学分布偏移下实现更稳定的想象展开，并在DeepMind Control Suite任务上取得领先性能。
item.description:
HaM-World：用于规划的具有选择性记忆的软哈密顿世界模型

HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05951

HaM-World将Mamba选择性记忆与软哈密顿潜在动力学先验相结合，通过把潜在状态分解为规范 子空间和上下文子空间，在长时程规划和动力学分布偏移下实现更稳定的想象展开，并在DeepMind Control Suite任务上取得领先性能。

世界模型通过学习到的潜在动力学支持基于模型的规划，但随着规划时域的增长或动力学分布发生偏移，想象展开可能变得不稳定。我们提出HaM-World，这是一种结构化世界模型，它将历史条件化的选择性记忆与软哈密顿潜在动力学先验相结合。潜在状态被分解为规范 (q,p) 子空间和上下文子空间 c。Mamba选择性状态空间记忆总结过去的观测和动作，并为同一潜在转移提供条件，该潜在转移被用于预测、奖励与价值估计、想象展开以及交叉熵方法规划。(q,p) 子空间遵循由能量导出的哈密顿向量场，并增强了可学习的残差和控制动力学，而 c 则表示语义、耗散以及其他非保守因素。在六个DeepMind Control Suite任务上，HaM-World在四个任务中排名第一，在两个任务中排名第二，取得了……

Mamba selective state-space memory summarizes past observations and actions and conditions the same latent transition used for prediction, reward and value estimation, imagined rollouts, and cross-entropy method planning. The (q,p) subspace follows an energy-derived Hamiltonian vector field augmented with learnable residual and control dynamics, while c represents semantic, dissipative, and other non-conservative factors. item.description:
基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中通信结构优化的主动学习方法

Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05703

该论文发现LLM多智能体系统的通信结构优化高度依赖训练任务的选择，并提出了一种基于集成信息论与集合卡尔曼反演的主动任务选择框架，通过主动挑选最具信息量的任务来提升优化效果和下游性能。

优化基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的通信结构已被证明可以提升下游性能并减少token消耗。现有方法通常在随机采样的任务上进行训练。我们表明，这种优化对训练任务的选择非常敏感：下游准确率在不同的随机任务集之间差异很大，且增加更多随机任务并不能持续提升性能。为了从任务-答案对池中主动识别最有价值的任务，我们提出了一种基于集成的信息论任务选择框架。该框架通过候选任务对图参数分布的改变程度来估计任务的信息量，并采用集合卡尔曼反演作为贝叶斯更新的高效无导数近似。由此得到的估计器特别适用于黑盒且含噪声的多智能体系统，并且在集成规模远小于常规设置的情况下仍然保持有效。

arXiv:2605.05703v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optimizing the communication structure of large language model based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) has been shown to improve downstream performance and reduce token usage. Existing methods typically train on randomly sampled tasks. We show that this optimization is sensitive to the choice of training tasks: downstream accuracy varies widely across random task sets, and adding more random tasks does not consistently improve it. To actively identify the most valuable tasks from a pool of task-answer pairs, we propose an ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework. It estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the Bayesian update. item.description:
PepSpecBench：肽段串联质谱预测的统一评估基准

PepSpecBench: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for Peptide Tandem Mass Spectrometry Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01945

提出了PepSpecBench——一个肽段串联质谱谱图预测的统一评估基准，通过统一的数据预处理与输出空间、防止序列泄露的数据划分策略以及对域偏移和碰撞能量、前体电荷鲁棒性的系统评估，解决了该领域模型无法公平比较的三大挑战。

串联质谱为复杂生物样品中蛋白质的鉴定与定量提供了高通量框架。在计算蛋白质组学中，预测肽段的MS/MS（二级质谱）谱图是一项关键任务，它支撑着大规模肽段鉴定与定量等下游应用。尽管深度学习架构已显著提升了预测准确度，但三个评估方面的挑战掩盖了该领域的真实进展。第一，不一致的数据预处理和互不兼容的模型输出空间阻碍了模型间的公平比较。第二，有缺陷的数据划分策略可能导致隐藏的序列泄露，从而虚增所报告的性能。第三，现有评估通常缺乏对异构零样本域偏移以及对碰撞能量和前体电荷鲁棒性的系统性评估。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PepSpecBench，一个用于肽段MS/MS谱图预测的统一基准。

arXiv:2605.01945v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tandem mass spectrometry provides a high-throughput framework for identifying and quantifying proteins in complex biological samples. In computational proteomics, predicting peptide MS/MS spectra is a critical task, enabling downstream applications such as large-scale peptide identification and quantification. While deep learning architectures have substantially improved prediction accuracy, three evaluation challenges obscure the true progress of the field. First, inconsistent data preprocessing and incompatible model output spaces hinder fair model comparison. Second, flawed data splitting strategies can permit hidden sequence leakage and inflate reported performance. Third, existing evaluations typically lack systematic assessment of heterogeneous zero-shot domain shift and robustness to collision energy and precursor charge. item.title: 该论文将法律经济学的威慑与执行理论引入AI对齐研究，提出对齐本质上是一个求解器与审计者之间的激励博弈不动点问题——过度惩罚求解器反而可能削弱审计者监督的动力。
item.description:
通过激励与纠正实现AI对齐

AI Alignment via Incentives and Correction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01643

该论文将法律经济学的威慑与执行理论引入AI对齐研究，提出对齐本质上是一个求解器与审计者之间的激励博弈不动点问题——过度惩罚求解器反而可能削弱审计者监督的动力。

我们通过法律与经济学中的威慑与执行模型来研究AI对齐问题。在这些模型中，不当行为不被视为外部故障，而是对激励的战略性回应：行为者会权衡违规所得收益与被发现的概率及惩罚的严厉程度。我们认为同样的逻辑在智能体（agentic）AI流水线中会自然出现。求解器可能通过生成有说服力但不正确的答案、隐藏不确定性或利用虚假捷径而获益，而审计者或验证者则必须决定昂贵的监控是否值得。因此，对齐是一个不动点问题：更强的惩罚可能会阻止求解器的不当行为，但也可能降低审计者进行检查的动机，因为此时审计主要只是在一个看起来越来越对齐的群体上产生成本。这一视角还改变了什么应被视为训练后信号。标准反馈通常……

arXiv:2605.01643v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study AI alignment through the lens of law-and-economics models of deterrence and enforcement. In these models, misconduct is not treated as an external failure, but as a strategic response to incentives: an actor weighs the gain from violation against the probability of detection and the severity of punishment. We argue that the same logic arises naturally in agentic AI pipelines. A solver may benefit from producing a persuasive but incorrect answer, hiding uncertainty, or exploiting spurious shortcuts, while an auditor or verifier must decide whether costly monitoring is worthwhile. Alignment is therefore a fixed-point problem: stronger penalties may deter solver misbehavior, but they can also reduce the auditor's incentive to inspect, since auditing then mainly incurs cost on a population that appears increasingly aligned. item.title: 提出PRISM三阶段流水线，通过黑盒在线策略蒸馏的对抗博弈，在SFT与RLVR之间插入显式分布对齐阶段，缓解监督微调引起的分布偏移对多模态强化学习的损害。

超越SFT到RL：基于黑盒在线策略蒸馏的多模态强化学习预对齐

Beyond SFT-to-RL: Pre-alignment via Black-Box On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal RL

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28123

提出PRISM三阶段流水线，通过黑盒在线策略蒸馏的对抗博弈，在SFT与RLVR之间插入显式分布对齐阶段，缓解监督微调引起的分布偏移对多模态强化学习的损害。

大型多模态模型（LMMs）的标准后训练方案是在精心筛选的演示数据上进行监督微调（SFT），随后进行带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。然而，SFT引入了分布偏移，既无法保留模型的原始能力，也无法忠实地匹配监督分布。这一问题在多模态推理中被进一步放大，因为感知错误和推理失败遵循不同的漂移模式，并在后续强化学习过程中相互叠加。我们提出了PRISM，一个三阶段流水线，通过在SFT和RLVR之间插入显式的分布对齐阶段来缓解这种漂移。基于在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的原理，PRISM将对齐过程建模为策略与一个配备专门感知和推理专家的混合专家判别器（MoE）之间的黑盒、响应级对抗博弈，从而提供解耦的修正信号……

arXiv:2604.28123v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The standard post-training recipe for large multimodal models (LMMs) applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated demonstrations followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, SFT introduces distributional drift that neither preserves the model's original capabilities nor faithfully matches the supervision distribution. This problem is further amplified in multimodal reasoning, where perception errors and reasoning failures follow distinct drift patterns that compound during subsequent RL. We introduce PRISM, a three-stage pipeline that mitigates this drift by inserting an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR. item.title: 提出了一种无需训练的开放词汇变化检测框架MemOVCD，通过将双时相分析建模为跨时相记忆条件推理并引入全局-局部自适应校正机制，解决了现有方法跨时相证据不可用和预测碎片化的问题。
item.description:
MemOVCD：基于跨时相记忆推理与全局-局部自适应校正的无训练开放词汇变化检测

MemOVCD: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Cross-Temporal Memory Reasoning and Global-Local Adaptive Rectification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26774

提出了一种无需训练的开放词汇变化检测框架MemOVCD，通过将双时相分析建模为跨时相记忆条件推理并引入全局-局部自适应校正机制，解决了现有方法跨时相证据不可用和预测碎片化的问题。

开放词汇变化检测旨在利用文本指定的目标类别，在双时相遥感影像中识别语义变化。代表性的基础模型流水线在比较预测结果之前会对两个时相进行独立解码，导致语义解码无法获取跨时相证据。此外，当前的逐块推理方式可能破坏全局语义连续性，产生碎片化的预测结果。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了MemOVCD，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将开放词汇变化检测重新表述为跨时相记忆条件下的推理任务。具体而言，MemOVCD将双时相分析转化为双向双帧跟踪问题，并利用视频SAM的记忆机制在时相之间传播语义候选区域，将这些区域的特征池化并平均为局部示例标记。随后，通过一个共享记忆（其原型数量由…确定）——（摘要在此处被截断）

Specifically, MemOVCD casts bi-temporal analysis as a bidirectional two-frame tracking problem and exploits the memory mechanism of video SAM to propagate semantic candidate regions across timestamps. 该论文揭示了基于超网络的即时LLM适应方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）在文档与预训练知识冲突时存在的“覆盖鸿沟”问题，并提出选择性层增强（SLB）和冲突感知内化（CA）两种免训练方法，将Gemma深度冲突准确率从46.4%提升至71.0%。

基于超网络的方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）能够在单次前向传播中将文档内化到LLM的权重中，但当文档与预训练知识相矛盾时，这些方法表现不佳。我们通过预训练答案边际与生成的适配器所引起的偏移之间的竞争来研究这种覆盖鸿沟。在194个Gemma冲突样本上，基线准确率从最弱先验四分位组的65.3%下降到最强先验四分位组的16.3%。我们提出了两种无需训练的方法：选择性层增强（SLB），它在适配器活动度最高的层对其进行缩放；以及冲突感知内化（CA），它通过简短的基座模型探测在标准适应与更强适应之间做出选择。强增强将Gemma在深度冲突场景下的准确率从46.4%提升至71.0%，在Mistral-7B和Qwen-4B上也观察到了冲突增益。匹配范数的对照实验表明，更新的幅度和分配方式都很重要：SLB受益于生成的层...

arXiv:2604.23750v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hypernetwork-based methods such as Doc-to-LoRA internalize a document into an LLM's weights in a single forward pass, but struggle when the document contradicts pretraining knowledge. We study this override gap through the competition between the pretrained answer margin and the shift induced by the generated adapter. On 194 Gemma conflicts, baseline accuracy falls from 65.3% in the weakest-prior quartile to 16.3% in the strongest. We introduce two training-free methods: Selective Layer Boosting (SLB), which scales the adapter at its highest-activity layers, and Conflict-Aware Internalization (CA), which chooses between standard and stronger adaptation using a short base-model probe. Strong boosting raises Gemma deep-conflict accuracy from 46.4% to 71.0%, with conflict gains also observed on Mistral-7B and Qwen-4B. 研究发现，即使思维链推理轨迹本身是错误的，其隐藏状态（尤其集中于中后层和轨迹早期）仍编码了足以恢复正确答案的任务相关信息，通过激活修补将这些隐藏状态注入直接回答过程可显著提升答题准确率。

arXiv:2604.23351v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：中间推理在计算上究竟是有用的，还是仅仅起解释作用，取决于思维链（CoT）标记中是否包含与任务相关的信息。我们利用激活修补（activation patching）对 GSM8K 上的思维链进行了机制层面的因果分析：将同一问题在思维链生成中得到的标记级隐藏状态转移到直接回答的运行中，然后测量其对最终答案准确率的影响。在各个模型上，修补后生成答案的准确率显著高于直接回答提示和原始思维链轨迹，这表明即使原始推理轨迹是错误的，单个思维链标记也能编码足以恢复正确答案的信息。这种与任务相关的信息在正确的思维链运行中比在错误的运行中更为普遍，并且在各标记之间分布不均：它集中于中间至较深的层，并在推理轨迹的较早位置出现。此外，修补语言标记，例如……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2604.23351v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Whether intermediate reasoning is computationally useful or merely explanatory depends on whether chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contain task-relevant information. We present a mechanistic causal analysis of CoT on GSM8K using activation patching: transferring token-level hidden states from a CoT generation to a direct-answer run for the same question, then measuring the effect on final-answer accuracy. Across models, generating after patching yields substantially higher accuracy than both direct-answer prompting and the original CoT trace, revealing that individual CoT tokens can encode sufficient information to recover the correct answer, even when the original trace is incorrect. This task-relevant information is more prevalent in correct than incorrect CoT runs and is unevenly distributed across tokens, concentrating in mid-to-late layers and appearing earlier in the reasoning trace.
