item.title: BAGEL是一个基于维基百科、GloBI和bioRxiv的6,822题动物知识选择题基准，评估发现前沿大模型尽管在百科和文献类题目上表现出色，但在生态相互作用等参与式数据推理上仍明显薄弱。
item.description:
BAGEL：语言模型中的动物知识专长基准测试

BAGEL: Benchmarking Animal Knowledge Expertise in Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16241

BAGEL是一个基于维基百科、GloBI和bioRxiv的6,822题动物知识选择题基准，评估发现前沿大模型尽管在百科和文献类题目上表现出色，但在生态相互作用等参与式数据推理上仍明显薄弱。

arXiv:2604.16241v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：大型语言模型在广泛的知识基准测试中表现良好，然而在统一的评估协议下，其在动物领域的专业能力仍缺乏充分表征。我们提出了BAGEL（语言模型动物知识专长基准测试），这是一个包含6,822道选择题的基准测试，题目来源于维基百科、全球生物相互作用数据库（GloBI）以及bioRxiv。该基准涵盖百科全书式的物种知识、生态相互作用推理，以及对动物主题预印本的解读。题目通过自动化方式生成，并由GPT-5.5依据一套基于150个专家审核条目校准的评分标准进行筛选；这一过程并非详尽的人工裁决。我们在不使用外部检索的条件下评估了14个模型，仅依靠模型参数和题目局部证据。准确率因题目来源和类型不同而呈现显著差异：在维基百科和bioRxiv任务上表现出色的前沿模型，在GloBI参与式数据（题目）方面表现相对较弱。

arXiv:2604.16241v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models perform well on broad knowledge benchmarks, yet their animal-domain competence remains poorly characterized under a consistent protocol. We introduce BAGEL (\textbf{B}enchmarking \textbf{A}nimal knowled\textbf{G}e \textbf{E}xpertise in \textbf{L}anguage models), a 6,822-question multiple-choice benchmark drawn from Wikipedia, Global Biotic Interactions (GloBI), and bioRxiv. It spans encyclopedic species knowledge, ecological interaction inference, and interpretation of animal-focused preprints. Questions are generated automatically and screened by GPT-5.5 using a rubric calibrated on 150 expert-reviewed items; this process is not exhaustive human adjudication. We evaluate 14 models without external retrieval, using model parameters and question-local evidence. item.title: 该论文提出RankFormer，一种基于纯Transformer的“先提出后选择”框架，无需依赖图结构或人工标注意图，即可实现考虑时间依赖性和空间交互的多智能体多模态轨迹预测。
item.description:
RankFormer：一种用于多智能体多模态轨迹预测的“先提出后选择”Transformer模型

RankFormer: A Propose-then-Select Transformer for Multi-Agent Multimodal Trajectory Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07126

该论文提出RankFormer，一种基于纯Transformer的“先提出后选择”框架，无需依赖图结构或人工标注意图，即可实现考虑时间依赖性和空间交互的多智能体多模态轨迹预测。

预测交通参与者轨迹在自动驾驶、交通运营、交通安全分析等领域发挥着重要作用。尽管已经设计了许多深度学习算法来预测参与者的未来轨迹，但由于决策过程的复杂性、与周围车辆的交互作用，以及即使在相似场景下行驶参与者也可能存在多种意图，轨迹预测问题仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有方法受限于对图结构（如图神经网络）的要求或对人工标注意图的依赖。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于纯Transformer的深度学习模型，用于考虑时间依赖性和智能体间空间交互的多模态轨迹预测。在对历史轨迹进行编码后，采用两个并行解码器来生成轨迹及其对应概率……

arXiv:2604.07126v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Predicting traffic agent trajectories plays an important role in autonomous driving, traffic operations, transportation safety analysis, etc. Although many deep learning algorithms are devised to predict future agent trajectories, the trajectory prediction problem is still challenging due to the complexity of decision-making process, interactions with surrounding vehicles, and the existence of multiple possible intentions for the traveling agents even under similar scenarios. Most existing methods are limited by the requirement of graph structures (e.g., Graph Neural Network) or the requirement of manually labeled intentions. In this study, we propose a pure Transformer-based deep learning model for multi-modal trajectory prediction considering temporal dependencies and agent-agent spatial interactions. item.title: Claw-Eval是一个端到端的自主智能体可信评估套件，通过300个人工验证任务、执行轨迹/审计日志/环境快照三通道证据记录及2,159个细粒度评分项，从完成度、安全性和鲁棒性三个维度全面且透明地评估智能体能力。
item.description:
Claw-Eval：迈向自主智能体的可信评估

Claw-Eval: Towards Trustworthy Evaluation of Autonomous Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06132

Claw-Eval是一个端到端的自主智能体可信评估套件，通过300个人工验证任务、执行轨迹/审计日志/环境快照三通道证据记录及2,159个细粒度评分项，从完成度、安全性和鲁棒性三个维度全面且透明地评估智能体能力。

大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为自主智能体，在真实软件环境中执行多步骤工作流。然而，现有的智能体基准测试存在诸多局限：评分过程轨迹不透明、安全性与鲁棒性评估定义不足、以及模态和交互范式覆盖范围狭窄。我们提出了Claw-Eval，一个端到端的评估套件，通过300个经人工验证的任务来弥补这些不足，这些任务涵盖三大组共9个类别：通用服务编排、多模态感知与交互、以及多轮专业对话。为实现基于轨迹的评分，每次运行通过三个独立的证据通道进行记录：执行轨迹、审计日志和环境快照，共产生2,159个细粒度评分细则项。评分协议从完成度、安全性和鲁棒性三个维度进行评估，并通过三次试验的平均分数、Pass@k和Pass^k指标，以区分真实能力与偶然成功。

arXiv:2604.06132v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for multi-step workflows in real-world software environments. However, existing agent benchmarks are limited by trajectory-opaque grading, underspecified safety and robustness evaluation, and narrow coverage of modalities and interaction paradigms. We introduce Claw-Eval, an end-to-end evaluation suite addressing these gaps with 300 human-verified tasks spanning 9 categories across three groups: general service orchestration, multimodal perception and interaction, and multi-turn professional dialogue. To enable trajectory-aware grading, each run is recorded through three independent evidence channels: execution traces, audit logs, and environment snapshots, yielding 2,159 fine-grained rubric items. The scoring protocol evaluates Completion, Safety, and Robustness, with Average Score, Pass@k, and Pass^k across three trials to distinguish genuine capability from lucky

item.title: 提出无需训练的TRACE框架，通过分析冻结语音基础模型嵌入轨迹的一阶动力学来检测部分音频深度伪造——真实语音嵌入轨迹平滑缓慢变化，而拼接边界会引入突变。
item.description:
TRACE：基于语音基础模型嵌入轨迹分析的无训练部分音频深度伪造检测

TRACE: Training-Free Partial Audio Deepfake Detection via Embedding Trajectory Analysis of Speech Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01083

提出无需训练的TRACE框架，通过分析冻结语音基础模型嵌入轨迹的一阶动力学来检测部分音频深度伪造——真实语音嵌入轨迹平滑缓慢变化，而拼接边界会引入突变。

部分音频深度伪造是指将合成的语音片段拼接进真实录音中，这类伪造极具欺骗性，因为音频的大部分内容仍然是真实的。现有的检测器都是有监督的：它们需要帧级标注，容易过拟合到特定的合成流程，并且每当新的生成模型出现时都必须重新训练。我们认为这种监督是不必要的。我们假设语音基础模型隐式地编码了取证信号：真实的语音会形成平滑、缓慢变化的嵌入轨迹，而拼接边界会在帧级过渡中引入突然的中断。基于这一假设，我们提出了TRACE（基于表示的无训练音频对抗方法——通过嵌入动力学实现），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过分析冻结的语音基础模型表示的一阶动力学来检测部分音频深度伪造，全程无需任何训练、标注数据或架构修改。

arXiv:2604.01083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Partial audio deepfakes, where synthesized segments are spliced into genuine recordings, are particularly deceptive because most of the audio remains authentic. Existing detectors are supervised: they require frame-level annotations, overfit to specific synthesis pipelines, and must be retrained as new generative models emerge. We argue that this supervision is unnecessary. We hypothesize that speech foundation models implicitly encode a forensic signal: genuine speech forms smooth, slowly varying embedding trajectories, while splice boundaries introduce abrupt disruptions in frame-level transitions. Building on this, we propose TRACE (Training-free Representation-based Audio Countermeasure via Embedding dynamics), a training-free framework that detects partial audio deepfakes by analyzing the first-order dynamics of frozen speech foundation model representations without any training, labeled data, or architectural modification

item.title: 该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的框架，根据专家的结构化认知视角生成条件化AI解释，使科学知识图谱上的解释（如药物再利用和药物-靶点相互作用预测）更符合不同专家的判断偏好。
item.description:
为科学发现塑造面向专家视角的AI解释

Shaping AI Explanations to Expert Perspectives for Scientific Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21846

该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的框架，根据专家的结构化认知视角生成条件化AI解释，使科学知识图谱上的解释（如药物再利用和药物-靶点相互作用预测）更符合不同专家的判断偏好。

科学发现中的AI解释通常围绕单一的解释质量标准进行优化。然而，专家们在评估证据、权衡机制重要性和判断相关性方面存在差异，这意味着通用型解释可能无法提供专家认为最有信息量或最有说服力的证据。我们证明这些差异呈现出结构化的认知视角，并探究以这些视角为条件的解释是否更受专家青睐。为研究这一问题，我们引入了一个基于强化学习的框架，用于生成“视角条件化解释”，该框架由基于专家评估构建的LLM人格化代理的判断来引导。我们在科学知识图谱上实例化该框架，并通过药物再利用和药物-靶点相互作用预测在药物发现领域进行评估。专家研究表明，视角条件化解释能够捕捉（原文此处截断）

arXiv:2603.21846v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI explanations for scientific discovery are typically optimized around a single notion of explanation quality. Experts, however, differ in how they assess evidence, prioritize mechanisms, and judge relevance, meaning that a general-purpose explanation may not provide the evidence an expert finds most informative or convincing. We show that these differences exhibit structured epistemic perspectives and ask whether explanations conditioned on these perspectives are preferred by experts. To study this, we introduce a reinforcement learning-based framework for generating \textit{perspective-conditioned explanations}, which is guided by the judgments of LLM-based personas derived from expert evaluations. We instantiate the framework over scientific knowledge graphs and evaluate it in drug discovery through drug repurposing and drug--target interaction prediction. item.title: 该研究通过两个定制网络靶场和76个CTF任务系统评估了十三款前沿AI模型的自主网络攻击能力，发现攻击步数进展随推理时计算量大致呈对数线性增长，且更新的模型在固定token预算下能完成更多攻击步骤。
item.description:
衡量AI智能体在多步骤网络攻击场景中的进展

Measuring AI Agents' Progress on Multi-Step Cyber Attack Scenarios

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11214

该研究通过两个定制网络靶场和76个CTF任务系统评估了十三款前沿AI模型的自主网络攻击能力，发现攻击步数进展随推理时计算量大致呈对数线性增长，且更新的模型在固定token预算下能完成更多攻击步骤。

我们在两个专门构建的网络靶场上评估了前沿AI智能体的自主攻击性网络能力——包括一个32步骤的企业网络攻击场景和一个针对模拟冷却塔的7步骤工业控制系统攻击场景——并辅以一个涵盖四个难度等级、共76个任务的私有CTF（夺旗赛）套件。人类专家解决企业靶场所需时间估计约为20小时，解决冷却塔靶场约为15小时；CTF时间标注范围从1分钟到超过42小时，包括实测试玩、设计者估算以及由未完成试玩得出的时间下界。在二十个月内发布的十三款模型中——从2024年8月的GPT-4o到2026年4月的GPT-5.5——我们观察到两个趋势：首先，在测试范围内（最高至1亿token），步数进展随推理时计算量大致呈对数线性增长；其次，在固定token预算下，更新的前沿模型通常能完成更多步骤。GPT-5.5在

arXiv:2603.11214v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We evaluate the autonomous offensive cyber capabilities of frontier AI agents on two purpose-built cyber ranges---a 32-step corporate network attack and a 7-step industrial control system attack targeting a simulated cooling tower---complemented by a private 76-task CTF suite spanning four difficulty tiers. Human-expert solve times are estimated at roughly 20 hours for the corporate range and 15 hours for the cooling tower; CTF time annotations range from 1 minute to over 42 hours and include measured playtests, designer estimates, and lower bounds from unsolved playtests. Across thirteen models released over a twenty-month period---from GPT-4o in August 2024 to GPT-5.5 in April 2026---we observe two trends. First, step-count progress increases approximately log-linearly with inference-time compute over the tested range (up to 100M tokens). Second, newer frontier models generally complete more steps at fixed token budgets. GPT-5.5 an

item.title: 该论文提出NeFTY，一种硬约束神经场框架，将未知扩散率表示为基于坐标的神经网络并嵌入可微隐式欧拉热求解器中端到端优化，从而解决了传统PINN无法恢复内部结构的严重病态三维逆热传导（热断层扫描）问题。
item.description:
神经场热断层扫描（NeFTY）：一种面向无损检测的可微物理框架

Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11045

该论文提出NeFTY，一种硬约束神经场框架，将未知扩散率表示为基于坐标的神经网络并嵌入可微隐式欧拉热求解器中端到端优化，从而解决了传统PINN无法恢复内部结构的严重病态三维逆热传导（热断层扫描）问题。

对于刚性抛物型偏微分方程（PDE）的逆问题，例如逆热传导问题（IHCP），其病态性非常严重：正向映射会在内部高频结构到达边界之前将其迅速衰减。软约束的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将PDE作为残差惩罚项嵌入，在其标准的双网络逆问题建模中使扩散率与表面数据解耦；我们评估的这些变体虽然能够拟合边界测量值，但内部场却基本保持原样、未被触及。我们提出了神经场热断层扫描，这是一个用于无标签三维逆热传导问题的硬约束神经场框架。NeFTY将未知的扩散率表示为连续的基于坐标的神经网络，并在每个优化步骤中将候选场通过一个带调和平均界面通量的可微隐式欧拉热求解器……

arXiv:2603.11045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Inverse problems for stiff parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs), such as the inverse heat conduction problem (IHCP), are severely ill-posed: the forward map rapidly damps high-frequency interior structure before it reaches the boundary. Soft-constrained physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), which embed the PDE as a residual penalty, decouple the diffusivity from the surface data in their standard two-network inverse formulation, and the evaluated variants fit boundary measurements while leaving the interior field essentially untouched. We propose Neural Field Thermal Tomography (NeFTY), a hard-constrained neural field framework for label-free three-dimensional inverse heat conduction. NeFTY represents the unknown diffusivity as a continuous coordinate-based neural network, and at every optimization step passes the candidate field through a differentiable implicit-Euler heat solver with harmonic-mean interface flu

item.title: 提出AlphaFlowTSE，将目标说话人提取建模为混合语音到目标语音的有限区间传输，通过无需JVP的条件AlphaFlow目标结合局部轨迹匹配与教师-学生监督，实现无需多步采样的单步高质量低延迟语音提取。
item.description:
AlphaFlowTSE：基于条件AlphaFlow的单步生成式目标说话人提取

AlphaFlowTSE: One-Step Generative Target Speaker Extraction via Conditional AlphaFlow

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10701

提出AlphaFlowTSE，将目标说话人提取建模为混合语音到目标语音的有限区间传输，通过无需JVP的条件AlphaFlow目标结合局部轨迹匹配与教师-学生监督，实现无需多步采样的单步高质量低延迟语音提取。

目标说话人提取（TSE）旨在利用目标说话人的一段简短注册语音，从多人混合语音中恢复指定说话人的语音。真实的对话应用要求在复杂混合条件下同时具备高提取质量和低延迟推理。现有的生成式TSE方法提升了语音保真度，但基于扩散模型和流模型的方法通常依赖多步采样。单步变体虽然降低了迭代推理成本，但往往需要估计与混合比例相关的轨迹坐标，从而引入了额外的依赖。我们提出AlphaFlowTSE，将TSE表述为从观测混合语音到干净目标语音的有限区间传输。AlphaFlowTSE沿混合语音到目标语音的轨迹学习条件平均速度，并使用无需雅可比向量积（JVP-free）的AlphaFlow目标函数，将局部轨迹匹配与区间一致的教师-学生监督相结合。

arXiv:2603.10701v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Target speaker extraction (TSE) aims to recover the speech of a specified speaker from a multi-talker mixture using a short enrollment utterance from that speaker. Real conversational applications require both high extraction quality and low-latency inference across complex mixture conditions. Existing generative TSE approaches improve speech fidelity, but diffusion and flow-based models usually rely on multi-step sampling. One-step variants reduce iterative inference cost, yet often require estimating a trajectory coordinate related to the mixing ratio, introducing an additional dependency. We propose AlphaFlowTSE, which formulates TSE as finite-interval transport from the observed mixture to clean target speech. AlphaFlowTSE learns a conditional mean velocity along a mixture-to-target trajectory and uses a JVP-free AlphaFlow objective that combines local trajectory matching with interval-consistent teacher--student supervisio

item.title: 该研究通过人类实验发现，同等最优的组合解中，人们更容易理解那些与贪心启发式算法一致、箱内组成简单、且视觉表示有序的解，其中有序表示和贪心一致性对可解释性的影响最强。
item.description:
解读可解释性：面向最优组合解的以人为中心的评判标准

Unpacking Interpretability: Human-Centered Criteria for Optimal Combinatorial Solutions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08856

该研究通过人类实验发现，同等最优的组合解中，人们更容易理解那些与贪心启发式算法一致、箱内组成简单、且视觉表示有序的解，其中有序表示和贪心一致性对可解释性的影响最强。

算法支持系统所返回的解虽然是最优的，但可能对人类而言难以理解。同一个问题可能存在多个同等最优、但在可解释性上差异显著的解。然而，目前尚无精确的理论来解释究竟是什么使一个解比另一个解更易于理解。为了识别与可解释性相关的结构性质，我们研究了基于多子集求和问题（MSSP）的装箱实验范式，让参与者判断将物品装入箱子的两个同等最优解中哪一个更容易理解。我们发现，参与者的偏好可靠地追踪了解结构的三个性质：与贪心启发式算法的一致性、箱内物品组成的简单性，以及视觉表示的有序程度。其中，有序的视觉表示和与贪心启发式的一致性表现出最强的关联，组成简单性也显示出一致的相关性。

arXiv:2603.08856v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Algorithmic support systems can return solutions that are optimal but hard to interpret for humans. A given problem can have multiple, equally optimal solutions that differ substantially in how interpretable they are. Yet there is no precise account of what makes one solution more interpretable than another. To identify structural properties associated with interpretability, we studied a packing paradigm based on the multiple subset sum problem (MSSP), in which participants judged which of two equally optimal solutions for packing items into bins was easier to understand. We found that preferences reliably tracked three properties of solution structure: alignment with a greedy heuristic, simple within-bin composition, and how ordered the visual representation was. The strongest associations were observed for ordered representations and alignment with a greedy heuristic. Compositional simplicity also showed a consistent associat

item.title: CompACT是一种将每个观测压缩至仅8个token的离散分词器，使潜在世界模型在保持规划性能的同时实现数量级的规划加速，为实时控制和实际部署提供了可行方案。
item.description:
8个Token内的规划：一种面向潜在世界模型的紧凑离散分词器

Planning in 8 Tokens: A Compact Discrete Tokenizer for Latent World Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05438

CompACT是一种将每个观测压缩至仅8个token的离散分词器，使潜在世界模型在保持规划性能的同时实现数量级的规划加速，为实时控制和实际部署提供了可行方案。

世界模型提供了一个强大的框架，可以在动作或指令条件下模拟环境动态，从而支持动作规划或策略学习等下游任务。近期的方法将世界模型作为学习得到的模拟器来使用，但其应用于决策时规划时计算成本过高，难以实现实时控制。一个关键瓶颈在于潜在表征：传统分词器将每个观测编码为数百个token，使得规划既缓慢又消耗大量资源。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CompACT，一种离散分词器，它将每个观测压缩到仅8个token，在保留规划所需关键信息的同时大幅降低了计算成本。采用CompACT分词器的动作条件世界模型在实现数量级更快规划速度的同时，达到了具有竞争力的规划性能，为迈向真实世界的实际部署迈出了务实的一步。

arXiv:2603.05438v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: World models provide a powerful framework for simulating environment dynamics conditioned on actions or instructions, enabling downstream tasks such as action planning or policy learning. Recent approaches leverage world models as learned simulators, but its application to decision-time planning remains computationally prohibitive for real-time control. A key bottleneck lies in latent representations: conventional tokenizers encode each observation into hundreds of tokens, making planning both slow and resource-intensive. To address this, we propose CompACT, a discrete tokenizer that compresses each observation into as few as 8 tokens, drastically reducing computational cost while preserving essential information for planning. An action-conditioned world model that occupies CompACT tokenizer achieves competitive planning performance with orders-of-magnitude faster planning, offering a practical step toward real-world deployment

item.title: 该论文提出方向性注意力引导，一种基于现代霍普菲尔德动力学分析、无需训练的单通道引导方法，通过仅放大稀疏-稠密注意力差异中与检索方向对齐的分量，在少步扩散模型采样中有效替代无分类器引导。
item.description:
基于稀疏霍普菲尔德检索的扩散模型方向性注意力引导

Directional Attention Guidance for Diffusion Models via Sparse Hopfield Retrieval

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02531

该论文提出方向性注意力引导，一种基于现代霍普菲尔德动力学分析、无需训练的单通道引导方法，通过仅放大稀疏-稠密注意力差异中与检索方向对齐的分量，在少步扩散模型采样中有效替代无分类器引导。

无分类器引导在扩散模型中提升了样本质量，但其双通道推理和空条件训练限制了它在少步生成场景中的应用。注意力空间引导是一种单通道替代方案，然而稀疏与稠密注意力引导为何有效仍不明确。我们通过现代霍普菲尔德动力学分析注意力外推，并在共享条件下建立了稀疏-稠密差异的两个方向性性质，将其识别为指向主导存储模式的加速方向。基于此，我们提出了方向性注意力引导，这是一种无需训练、单通道的规则，仅放大与检索方向对齐的差异分量；稳定性源于弱收缩性质，并且在真实交叉注意力层内部的分析表明，这种对齐在整个采样过程中均可观察到。DAG可泛化应用于UNet和MMDiT骨干网络。

arXiv:2603.02531v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) improves sample quality in diffusion models, but its dual-pass inference and null-condition training limit its use in few-step regimes. Attention-space guidance is a single-pass alternative, yet why sparse-versus-dense attention guidance works remains elusive. We analyze attention extrapolation through Modern Hopfield dynamics and establish two directional properties of the sparse-dense discrepancy under shared conditioning that identify it as an acceleration direction toward the dominant stored pattern. Building on this, we propose Directional Attention Guidance (DAG), a training-free, single-pass rule that amplifies only the component of the discrepancy aligned with the retrieval direction; stability follows from a weak contraction property, and an analysis inside real cross-attention layers shows that this alignment is observed throughout sampling. DAG generalizes across UNet and MMDiT backbone

item.title: 提出EraseAnything++统一框架，将概念擦除建模为受约束的多目标优化问题，使流匹配架构的图像和视频扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion v3、Flux、OpenSora）能够在擦除不良概念的同时保持生成质量。
item.description:
EraseAnything++：利用多目标优化在整流流Transformer中实现概念擦除

EraseAnything++: Enabling Concept Erasure in Rectified Flow Transformers Leveraging Multi-Object Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00978

提出EraseAnything++统一框架，将概念擦除建模为受约束的多目标优化问题，使流匹配架构的图像和视频扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion v3、Flux、OpenSora）能够在擦除不良概念的同时保持生成质量。

在保持整体生成质量的同时，从大规模文生图（T2I）和文生视频（T2V）扩散模型中移除不需要的概念仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是随着Stable Diffusion v3、Flux和OpenSora等现代模型采用流匹配和基于Transformer的架构，并扩展到长时程视频生成。为早期T2I/T2V模型设计的现有概念擦除方法往往难以泛化到这些新范式。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EraseAnything++，一个针对采用流匹配目标的图像和视频扩散模型的统一概念擦除框架。我们方法的核心是将概念擦除表述为一个受约束的多目标优化问题，显式地平衡概念移除与生成能力的保持。为解决由此产生的目标冲突，我们引入了一种高效的保持生成能力的遗忘策略……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2603.00978v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Removing undesired concepts from large-scale text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models while preserving overall generative quality remains a major challenge, particularly as modern models such as Stable Diffusion v3, Flux, and OpenSora employ flow-matching and transformer-based architectures and extend to long-horizon video generation. Existing concept erasure methods, designed for earlier T2I/T2V models, often fail to generalize to these paradigms. To address this issue, we propose EraseAnything++, a unified framework for concept erasure in both image and video diffusion models with flow-matching objectives. Central to our approach is formulating concept erasure as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem that explicitly balances concept removal with preservation of generative utility. To solve the resulting conflicting objectives, we introduce an efficient utility-preserving unlearning strategy ba

item.title: 本研究在英国COVID-19时间序列数据上系统对比了四种计量经济学方法与十一种因果结构学习算法，发现不同方法学习到的时序依赖图在密度、复杂度、拟合度和稳定性上差异显著且与先验知识图谱一致性有限，提示将此类方法用于政策干预分析时需谨慎。
item.description:
计量经济学方法与因果结构学习在时间序列数据上的对比：基于COVID-19数据对政策干预的启示

Econometric vs. Causal structure learning for time-series data: Implications for policy interventions using COVID-19 data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00041

本研究在英国COVID-19时间序列数据上系统对比了四种计量经济学方法与十一种因果结构学习算法，发现不同方法学习到的时序依赖图在密度、复杂度、拟合度和稳定性上差异显著且与先验知识图谱一致性有限，提示将此类方法用于政策干预分析时需谨慎。

本研究比较了基于回归的计量经济学方法与因果结构学习方法在恢复英国COVID-19数据中时间依赖性方面的表现，并评估了它们在政策分析中的适用性。我们使用一个共同的滞后扩展数据集评估了四种计量经济学方法和十一种结构学习算法，该数据集仅允许从过去变量指向当前变量的边。数据集包含866个日观测值和45个变量，经过类别编码后由55个数值序列表示。研究考察了1、7、14、17和21天的最大滞后；所有四种计量经济学方法和十种结构学习算法在每个滞后设定下均成功返回了结构。我们比较了不同滞后设定下的图结构、复杂度、拟合度以及时间边的稳定性。所得的图在密度、复杂度、拟合度和稳定性方面差异显著。与知识图谱的一致性有限，而较低的结构汉明距离有时……（原文摘要截断）

arXiv:2603.00041v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This study compares regression-based and causal structure-learning approaches to recovering temporal dependencies in UK COVID-19 data and assesses their suitability for policy analysis. We evaluate four econometric methods and eleven structure-learning algorithms using a common lag-expanded dataset that permits edges only from past to current variables. The dataset comprises 866 daily observations and 45 variables, represented by 55 numeric series after categorical encoding. Maximum lags of 1, 7, 14, 17 and 21 days are examined; all four econometric methods and ten structure-learning algorithms successfully return structures at every lag specification. We compare graph structure, complexity, fit and temporal-edge stability across lag specifications. The resulting graphs vary substantially in density, complexity, fit and stability. Agreement with the knowledge graph is limited, while low structural Hamming distance sometimes r

item.title: 该论文提出了一种将大语言模型作为图结构增强层的谣言检测框架，通过LLM评估信息子链并在图中引入虚拟节点，将潜在语义模式转化为显式拓扑特征，从而捕捉传播路径上的文本连贯性。
item.description:
基于虚拟节点诱导边预测的大语言模型增强谣言检测

LLM-Enhanced Rumor Detection via Virtual Node Induced Edge Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13279

该论文提出了一种将大语言模型作为图结构增强层的谣言检测框架，通过LLM评估信息子链并在图中引入虚拟节点，将潜在语义模式转化为显式拓扑特征，从而捕捉传播路径上的文本连贯性。

谣言在社交网络上的迅速扩散对信息完整性构成了重大威胁。尽管谣言的传播形成了复杂的结构模式，现有的检测方法往往无法捕捉文本连贯性与传播动态之间错综复杂的相互作用。当前方法通常通过孤立的文本嵌入来表示节点，忽略了整个传播路径上的语义流动。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了一种新颖的框架，将大语言模型（LLM）集成为基于图的谣言检测的结构增强层。超越传统方法，我们的框架利用LLM评估信息子链，并有策略地在图中引入一个虚拟节点。这种结构修改将潜在的语义模式转化为显式的拓扑特征，有效捕捉了历来难以获取的文本连贯性。

arXiv:2602.13279v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The rapid proliferation of rumors on social networks poses a significant threat to information integrity. While rumor dissemination forms complex structural patterns, existing detection methods often fail to capture the intricate interplay between textual coherence and propagation dynamics. Current approaches typically represent nodes through isolated textual embeddings, neglecting the semantic flow across the entire propagation path. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) as a structural augmentation layer for graph-based rumor detection. Moving beyond conventional methods, our framework employs LLMs to evaluate information subchains and strategically introduce a virtual node into the graph. This structural modification converts latent semantic patterns into explicit topological features, effectively capturing the textual coherence that has historically been inaccessible

item.title: 该论文借鉴动态自组网络的经典问题，提出了RAPS——一种声誉感知的发布-订阅范式，使大语言模型智能体能够基于声明的意图而非预定义拓扑进行自适应、可扩展且鲁棒的协调通信。
item.description:
面向自适应、可扩展且鲁棒的大语言模型智能体协调：动态自组网络的视角

Towards Adaptive, Scalable, and Robust Coordination of LLM Agents: A Dynamic Ad-Hoc Networking Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08009

该论文借鉴动态自组网络的经典问题，提出了RAPS——一种声誉感知的发布-订阅范式，使大语言模型智能体能够基于声明的意图而非预定义拓扑进行自适应、可扩展且鲁棒的协调通信。

基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多智能体架构已经展示了通过精心设计的协作实现群体智能的潜力。然而，繁重的人工编排负担从根本上要求对智能体工作流进行自动化设计。我们将这一智能体协调挑战归结为动态自组网络中的一个经典问题：如何在数量可扩展的智能体主机之间建立自适应且可靠的通信？针对这一尚未解决的难题，我们提出了RAPS——一种具备声誉感知的发布-订阅范式，用于实现大语言模型智能体的自适应、可扩展且鲁棒的协调。RAPS建立在分布式发布-订阅协议的基础之上，使大语言模型智能体能够基于其声明的意图而非预定义的拓扑结构来交换消息。在此基础之上，RAPS进一步整合了两个协同的覆盖层：（一）响应式订阅，使智能体能够动态……

arXiv:2602.08009v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-agent architectures built on large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the potential to realize swarm intelligence through well-crafted collaboration. However, the substantial burden of manual orchestration inherently raises an imperative to automate the design of agentic workflows. We frame such an agent coordination challenge as a classic problem in dynamic ad-hoc networking: How to establish adaptive and reliable communication among a scalable number of agentic hosts? In response to this unresolved dilemma, we introduce RAPS, a reputation-aware publish-subscribe paradigm for adaptive, scalable, and robust coordination of LLM agents. RAPS is grounded in the Distributed Publish-Subscribe Protocol, allowing LLM agents to exchange messages based on their declared intents rather than predefined topologies. item.title: Shiva-DiT提出了一种基于残差的可微分Top-k token选择方法，借助残差感知直通估计器同时学习token分数与预算k，并结合上下文感知路由器和自适应比率策略，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低扩散Transformer的FLOPs与延迟（在SD3-Medium上实现1.54倍加速）。
item.description:
Shiva-DiT：基于残差的可微分Top-k选择，实现高效扩散Transformer

Shiva-DiT: Residual-Based Differentiable Top-$k$ Selection for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05605

Shiva-DiT提出了一种基于残差的可微分Top-k token选择方法，借助残差感知直通估计器同时学习token分数与预算k，并结合上下文感知路由器和自适应比率策略，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低扩散Transformer的FLOPs与延迟（在SD3-Medium上实现1.54倍加速）。

扩散Transformer（DiT）在高分辨率下计算成本高昂，因为自注意力的计算量随token序列长度呈二次方增长。现有的剪枝方法无法同时提供端到端可学习性、低训练开销以及确定性的token数量以实现可预测的按token计算。我们提出了Shiva-DiT，其基于基于残差的可微分Top-k选择（Residual-Based Differentiable Top-k Selection）。它的前向传播执行硬top-k选择，同时残差感知的直通估计器将梯度同时传播到token分数和预算k，而无需评估第二条骨干网络路径。上下文感知路由器（Context-Aware Router）和自适应比率策略（Adaptive Ratio Policy）在目标平均预算下学习与层和时间步相关的token保留方案。在SD3-Medium、Flux.1-dev和PixArt-Σ上的实验表明，该方法在FLOPs和实测延迟方面均实现了持续降低。在SD3-Medium上，Shiva-DiT提供了四个保真度-延迟工作点，并达到了1.54倍的墙钟时间加速。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2602.05605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) are costly at high resolution because self-attention scales quadratically with token sequence length. Existing pruning methods do not jointly provide end-to-end learnability, low training overhead, and deterministic token counts for predictable token-dependent computation. We propose Shiva-DiT, based on Residual-Based Differentiable Top-k Selection. Its forward pass executes hard top-k selection, while a residual-aware straight-through estimator propagates gradients to both token scores and the budget k without evaluating a second backbone path. A Context-Aware Router and Adaptive Ratio Policy learn layer- and timestep-dependent retention schedules under a target average budget. Experiments on SD3-Medium, Flux.1-dev, and PixArt-{\Sigma} show consistent reductions in FLOPs and measured latency. On SD3-Medium, Shiva-DiT provides four fidelity-latency operating points and reaches a 1.54x wall-clock sp

item.title: 本文提出DomusFM，这是首个专门针对智能家居稀疏事件流设计的基础模型，通过预训练和微调实现行为监测任务的可迁移表示学习，克服了传统监督方法对大量标注数据的依赖。
item.description:
DomusFM：智能家居中基于事件的居家行为监测的基础模型

DomusFM: A Foundation Model for Event-Based Behavioral Monitoring in Smart-Homes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01910

本文提出DomusFM，这是首个专门针对智能家居稀疏事件流设计的基础模型，通过预训练和微调实现行为监测任务的可迁移表示学习，克服了传统监督方法对大量标注数据的依赖。

基于智能家居传感器的行为监测在医疗保健、独立生活以及早期发现功能或认知变化方面具有巨大潜力。在此背景下，活动识别、预测和模式发现等任务为日常生活提供了互补视角，支持对个人常规习惯及其长期变化的建模。然而，现有方法面临关键限制。监督方法需要不切实际的大量标注活动数据，以捕捉不同居民和环境间日常行为的变异性。基础模型是学习从传感器数据中潜在行为模式的可迁移表示的有前景方向，但当前工作大多针对连续的惯性或生理传感器数据设计，未能处理智能家居产生的稀疏、离散且语义丰富的事件流。在本文中，我们提出DomusFM，一个专门为智能家居事件流定制的基于事件的基础模型，通过预训练和微调策略实现行为监测任务的有效表示学习。

arXiv:2602.01910v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Smart-home sensor-based behavioral monitoring holds significant potential for healthcare, independent living, and early detection of functional or cognitive changes. In this setting, tasks like activity recognition, prediction, and pattern discovery provide complementary views of daily life, supporting the modeling of personal routines and habits, and their long-term changes. Existing approaches, however, face critical limitations. Supervised approaches require impractical amounts of labeled activity data to capture the variability of daily behavior across residents and environments. Foundation models represent a promising direction for learning transferable representations of latent behavioral patterns from sensor data. Still, current efforts are mostly designed for continuous inertial or physiological sensor data and do not address the sparse, discrete, and semantically rich event streams produced by smart homes. In this paper, we

item.title: 提出认知超感知训练范式，通过潜在视觉意象预测头与强化学习相结合，使多模态大语言模型能够在潜在空间中进行视觉推理，从而提升认知视觉推理能力，避免将视觉计算强行转化为文本标记。
item.description:
面向多模态大语言模型的认知超感知

Toward Cognitive Supersensing in Multimodal Large Language Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01541

提出认知超感知训练范式，通过潜在视觉意象预测头与强化学习相结合，使多模态大语言模型能够在潜在空间中进行视觉推理，从而提升认知视觉推理能力，避免将视觉计算强行转化为文本标记。

多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在开放词表视觉理解方面取得了快速进展，但它们在需要维持、转换和模拟抽象视觉状态的认知视觉推理任务上常常表现不佳。现有方法主要是在语言层面扩展思维链（CoT）推理，将本质上是空间性或视觉性的计算强行压缩进离散的文本标记中。我们提出了“认知超感知”，这是一种训练范式，通过集成潜在视觉意象预测头，使多模态大语言模型具备潜在视觉推理能力。该LVIP头逐步学习与不断演化的推理上下文和目标答案相一致的精细化视觉潜在状态，从而为内部推理提供结构化的视觉锚定信号。我们进一步引入了强化学习阶段，利用答案证据和基于LVIP的潜在锚定来优化推理轨迹，鼓励推理（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2602.01541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in open-vocabulary visual understanding, yet they often struggle with cognitive visual reasoning tasks that require maintaining, transforming, and simulating abstract visual states. Existing approaches primarily scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in language, forcing inherently spatial or visual computations into discrete text tokens. We introduce Cognitive Supersensing, a training paradigm that equips MLLMs with latent visual reasoning by integrating a Latent Visual Imagery Prediction (LVIP) head that progressively learns refined visual latent states aligned with the evolving reasoning context and target answer, thereby providing a structured visual grounding signal for internal reasoning. We further introduce a reinforcement learning stage that optimizes rationale trajectories using both answer evidence and LVIP-based latent grounding, encouraging reasoning

item.title: 提出SYNAPSE框架，使各组织能在差分隐私保护下联合训练请求生成器并发布加噪的工具使用计数，在不泄露私密使用记录的情况下跨组织共享工具使用经验，从而提升智能体的工具检索效果。
item.description:
SYNAPSE：基于差分隐私的跨组织工具使用经验共享

SYNAPSE: Sharing Tool-Use Experience Across Organizations with Differential Privacy

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00911

提出SYNAPSE框架，使各组织能在差分隐私保护下联合训练请求生成器并发布加噪的工具使用计数，在不泄露私密使用记录的情况下跨组织共享工具使用经验，从而提升智能体的工具检索效果。

拥有大型工具目录的智能体在处理每个请求时，首先会检索出若干候选工具。人们使用每个工具的实际示例有助于这一步骤，但使用记录是私密的，并保留在持有这些记录的组织内部。我们提出了SYNAPSE，这是一种让组织在不共享记录的前提下共享工具使用经验的方法。各组织在差分隐私（DP）保护下联合训练一个请求生成器，并发布加噪的每工具使用计数，这些计数决定了生成器为每个工具生成多少条请求。生成的请求成为共享索引中每个工具的“使用”字段，并与公开文档一同参与评分。在评分设置固定的情况下，只要噪声保持保密、五个客户端中至少三个是诚实的，且安全聚合成立，每次发布即满足记录级差分隐私；若在第二次发布时选择评分设置，则隐私预算翻倍。我们的基准测试以公开噪声和从同一池中抽取的五个客户端来模拟该机制，因此它衡量的是效用而非隐私……

arXiv:2602.00911v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An agent with a large tool catalog first retrieves a few candidate tools for each request. Examples of how people used each tool help this step, but usage records are private and stay with the organizations that hold them. We present SYNAPSE, a way for organizations to share tool-use experience without sharing records. They jointly train a request generator under differential privacy (DP) and release noisy per-tool usage counts, which set how many requests the generator writes for each tool. The generated requests become each tool's usage field in a shared index, scored beside public documentation. For fixed scoring settings, each release is record-level DP if its noise stays secret, at least three of five clients are honest and secure aggregation holds; choosing the settings on a second release doubles the budget. item.title: 本文提出重置与丢弃（ReD）查询方法，克服了pass@k幂律行为导致的边际收益递减问题，在固定预算下显著提升大语言模型回答独特问题的数量（coverage@cost），并能定量预测节省的尝试次数。
item.description:
物有所值：使用重置与丢弃（ReD）方法在固定预算下提升大语言模型的推理能力

More Bang for the Buck: Improving the Inference of Large Language Models at a Fixed Budget using Reset and Discard (ReD)

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21522

本文提出重置与丢弃（ReD）查询方法，克服了pass@k幂律行为导致的边际收益递减问题，在固定预算下显著提升大语言模型回答独特问题的数量（coverage@cost），并能定量预测节省的尝试次数。

大语言模型（LLM）在可验证任务上的性能通常用pass@k来衡量，即在k次尝试中至少一次正确回答问题的概率。在固定预算下，更合适的指标是coverage@cost，即作为总尝试次数函数的已正确回答的独特问题平均数量。我们建立了这两个指标之间的联系，并证明在经验上观察到的pass@k幂律行为会导致coverage@cost的次线性增长（即边际收益递减）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了重置与丢弃（ReD），这是一种大语言模型查询方法，无论pass@k的具体形式如何，都能在给定预算下提高coverage@cost。此外，在给定pass@k的情况下，我们可以定量预测使用ReD所能节省的总尝试次数。如果模型的pass@k不可用，ReD可以推断其幂律指数。我们在三个大语言模型上进行了实验，涵盖编程（HumanEval）、数学（GSM8K）和推理（MMLU-Pro）任务。

arXiv:2601.21522v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The performance of large language models (LLMs) on verifiable tasks is usually measured by pass@k, the probability of answering a question correctly at least once in k trials. At a fixed budget, a more suitable metric is coverage@cost, the average number of unique questions answered as a function of the total number of attempts. We connect the two metrics and show that the empirically-observed power-law behavior in pass@k leads to a sublinear growth of the coverage@cost (diminishing returns). To solve this problem, we propose Reset-and-Discard (ReD), a query method of LLMs that increases coverage@cost for a given budget, regardless of the pass@k form. Moreover, given a pass@k, we can quantitatively predict the savings in the total number of attempts using ReD. If pass@k is not available for the model, ReD can infer its power-law exponent. item.title: 本文提出 Zenith，一种以稀疏混合专家（SMoE）为核心的可扩展高效排序架构，通过在特征交互和长序列编码中统一扩展模型容量，在十亿级直播推荐场景下以最小的推理延迟开销学习复杂特征交互。
item.description:
Zenith：面向十亿级直播推荐场景的可扩展排序模型

Zenith: Scaling up Ranking Models for Billion-scale Livestreaming Recommendation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21285

本文提出 Zenith，一种以稀疏混合专家（SMoE）为核心的可扩展高效排序架构，通过在特征交互和长序列编码中统一扩展模型容量，在十亿级直播推荐场景下以最小的推理延迟开销学习复杂特征交互。

在推荐系统中，准确捕捉特征交互至关重要，近期的趋势表明，扩大模型容量可能是实现更高预测性能的关键驱动力。尽管先前的工作已经探索了多种模型架构来捕捉多粒度的特征交互，但在高效特征处理以及在不引入过多推理延迟的前提下扩展模型容量方面，所受到的关注相对较少。在本文中，我们通过提出 Zenith 来应对这一挑战，Zenith 是一种可扩展且高效的排序架构，能够以最小的运行时开销学习复杂的特征交互。Zenith 采用稀疏混合专家模型（SMoE）作为特征交互和长序列编码的统一容量扩展机制，并针对不同的 token 类型调整其参数化方式。特征交互单元对一小组固定的高维 Prime 特征应用逐 token 注意力和 SMoE……

arXiv:2601.21285v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurately capturing feature interactions is essential in recommender systems, and recent trends show that scaling up model capacity could be a key driver for next-level predictive performance. While prior work has explored various model architectures to capture multi-granularity feature interactions, relatively little attention has been paid to efficient feature handling and scaling model capacity without incurring excessive inference latency. In this paper, we address this challenge by presenting Zenith, a scalable and efficient ranking architecture that learns complex feature interactions with minimal runtime overhead. Zenith uses Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) as a common capacity-scaling mechanism across feature interaction and long-sequence encoding, while adapting its parameterization to each token regime. item.title: 本研究通过随机实验发现，依赖AI辅助学习新编程库会削弱概念理解、代码阅读和调试能力且平均不带来显著效率提升，但涉及认知投入的AI交互模式（六种模式中的三种）能够保护学习成果。
item.description:
人工智能如何影响技能形成

How AI Impacts Skill Formation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20245

本研究通过随机实验发现，依赖AI辅助学习新编程库会削弱概念理解、代码阅读和调试能力且平均不带来显著效率提升，但涉及认知投入的AI交互模式（六种模式中的三种）能够保护学习成果。

AI辅助在各个专业领域带来了显著的生产力提升，尤其对新手工作者而言。然而，这种辅助如何影响有效监督AI所需技能的发展仍不清楚。过度依赖AI完成不熟悉任务的新手工作者可能会在此过程中损害自身的技能习得。我们通过随机实验研究了开发者在使用与不使用AI辅助的情况下如何掌握一个新的异步编程库。我们发现，使用AI会削弱概念理解、代码阅读和调试能力，且平均而言并未带来显著的效率提升。完全将编码任务委托给AI的参与者虽然表现出一定的生产力提升，但代价是未能学会该库。我们识别出六种不同的AI交互模式，其中三种涉及认知投入，即使参与者接受（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）……

arXiv:2601.20245v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI assistance produces significant productivity gains across professional domains, particularly for novice workers. Yet how this assistance affects the development of skills required to effectively supervise AI remains unclear. Novice workers who rely heavily on AI to complete unfamiliar tasks may compromise their own skill acquisition in the process. We conduct randomized experiments to study how developers gained mastery of a new asynchronous programming library with and without the assistance of AI. We find that AI use impairs conceptual understanding, code reading, and debugging abilities, without delivering significant efficiency gains on average. Participants who fully delegated coding tasks showed some productivity improvements, but at the cost of learning the library. item.title: 该论文提出了融合因果与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化框架，通过引入因果 Sinkhorn 散度构建模糊集并给出强对偶形式，同时设计了可微、光滑且可解释的软回归森林决策规则来求解最优策略。
item.description:
具有因果与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化

Contextual Distributionally Robust Optimization with Causal and Continuous Structure

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11016

该论文提出了融合因果与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化框架，通过引入因果 Sinkhorn 散度构建模糊集并给出强对偶形式，同时设计了可微、光滑且可解释的软回归森林决策规则来求解最优策略。

我们提出了一个考虑底层分布的因果结构与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架，并开发了可解释且易处理的决策规则。我们首先引入因果 Sinkhorn 散度（CSD），这是一种熵正则化的因果 Wasserstein 距离，在保持因果一致性的同时鼓励连续的传输计划。随后，我们基于 CSD 构建了模糊集，建立了情境化 DRO 模型，称为因果 Sinkhorn DRO（Causal-SDRO），并推导出其强对偶重构形式，其中最坏情况分布被刻画为 Gibbs 分布的混合。为了获得（无限维的）最优策略，我们提出了软回归森林（SRF）决策规则：它既保留了经典决策树的可解释性，又是完全参数化、可微且 Lipschitz 光滑的，从而能够实现内在的解释性。

arXiv:2601.11016v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: WWe propose a framework for contextual distributionally robust optimization (DRO) that considers the causal and continuous structure of the underlying distribution, and we develop interpretable and tractable decision rules. We first introduce the causal Sinkhorn discrepancy (CSD), an entropy-regularized causal Wasserstein distance that encourages continuous transport plans while preserving causal consistency. We then formulate a contextual DRO model with a CSD-based ambiguity set, termed Causal Sinkhorn DRO (Causal-SDRO), and derive its strong dual reformulation, where the worst-case distribution is characterized as a mixture of Gibbs distributions. To obtain an (infinite-dimensional) optimal policy, we propose a soft regression forest (SRF) decision rule: it preserves the interpretability of classical decision trees while being fully parametric, differentiable, and Lipschitz-smooth, enabling intrinsic interpretation from both

item.title: 该论文提出通过测试时扩展实现“渐近通用对齐”的新框架，证明生成 k 个候选回答的乘积策略能以最优且不可超越的速率 f(k)=k/(k+1) 逼近完美胜率，为处理用户偏好冲突提供了理论基础。
item.description:
渐近通用对齐：一种基于测试时扩展的新型对齐框架

Asymptotic Universal Alignment: A New Alignment Framework via Test-Time Scaling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08777

该论文提出通过测试时扩展实现“渐近通用对齐”的新框架，证明生成 k 个候选回答的乘积策略能以最优且不可超越的速率 f(k)=k/(k+1) 逼近完美胜率，为处理用户偏好冲突提供了理论基础。

让大型语言模型（LLM）能够服务于具有异构且可能相互冲突偏好的用户，是个性化与可信人工智能面临的核心挑战。我们通过测试时扩展形式化了一种理想化的通用对齐概念：对于每个提示，模型生成 k≥1 个候选回答，用户从中选择自己最喜欢的一个。我们提出了 (k, f(k))-鲁棒对齐，即要求该 k 输出模型相对于任何其他单输出模型具有 f(k) 的胜率；并进一步提出渐近通用对齐（U-alignment），即要求当 k→∞ 时 f(k)→1。我们的主要结果刻画了最优收敛速率：存在一族单输出策略，其 k 样本乘积策略能够以 f(k)=k/(k+1) 的速率实现 U-alignment，而且在一般情况下没有任何方法能够达到更快的速率。我们证明，包括从人类反馈中进行纳什学习（NLHF）在内的主流后训练方法可以……

arXiv:2601.08777v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to serve users with heterogeneous and potentially conflicting preferences is a central challenge for personalized and trustworthy AI. We formalize an ideal notion of universal alignment through test-time scaling: for each prompt, the model produces $k\ge 1$ candidate responses and a user selects their preferred one. We introduce $(k,f(k))$-robust alignment, which requires the $k$-output model to have win rate $f(k)$ against any other single-output model, and asymptotic universal alignment (U-alignment), which requires $f(k)\to 1$ as $k\to\infty$. Our main result characterizes the optimal convergence rate: there exists a family of single-output policies whose $k$-sample product policies achieve U-alignment at rate $f(k)=\frac{k}{k+1}$, and no method can achieve a faster rate in general. We show that popular post-training methods, including Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF), can fund

item.title: 该论文提出了WIT基准，通过固定预测状态并系统变化未来场景构建受控场景集，以评估多模态时间序列预测模型能否恰当响应未来场景信息。
item.description:
What If TSF：评估场景引导的多模态时间序列预测

What If TSF: Evaluating Scenario-Guided Multimodal Time Series Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08509

该论文提出了WIT基准，通过固定预测状态并系统变化未来场景构建受控场景集，以评估多模态时间序列预测模型能否恰当响应未来场景信息。

近期大语言模型的进展使时间序列预测得以超越纯数值观测，在多模态设置中融入外部信息。这类信息可以提升预测性能，但仅凭准确率可能无法揭示模型是否恰当地响应了这些信息：模型可能忽略相关信息、无法区分具有不同含义的场景，或对无关或微弱信号过度反应。我们提出了 What If TSF（WIT），一个用于评估模型是否有效响应未来场景的基准。WIT 通过固定预测状态的同时系统地变化未来场景，构建受控场景集，从而支持三种互补的评估：事实比较，衡量事实场景信息的预测效用；关系比较，评估预测是否满足预期的方向、对比、强度与克制等关系。

arXiv:2601.08509v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled time series forecasting to move beyond numerical observations and incorporate external information in multimodal settings. Such information can improve forecasting performance, but accuracy alone may not reveal whether models appropriately respond to it: a model may ignore relevant information, fail to distinguish scenarios with different implications, or overreact to irrelevant or weak signals. We introduce What If TSF (WIT), a benchmark for evaluating whether models effectively respond to future scenarios. WIT constructs controlled scenario sets by fixing the forecasting state while systematically varying future scenarios, enabling three complementary evaluations: Factual Comparison, which measures the predictive utility of factual scenario information; Relational Comparison, which evaluates whether forecasts satisfy expected direction, contrast, intensity, and restraint

item.title: PRISMA提出了一种以结构化模式为通信协议的“规划-检索-检查-求解-记忆”多智能体框架，通过各阶段解耦训练与逐跳证据链审计机制，有效解决了开放域多跳问答中的检索错误级联传播和错误归因困难问题。
item.description:
PRISMA：一种面向开放域多跳问答的模式协调多智能体框架

PRISMA: A Schema-Coordinated Multi-Agent Framework for Open-Domain Multi-Hop Question Answering

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05465

PRISMA提出了一种以结构化模式为通信协议的“规划-检索-检查-求解-记忆”多智能体框架，通过各阶段解耦训练与逐跳证据链审计机制，有效解决了开放域多跳问答中的检索错误级联传播和错误归因困难问题。

在海量语料库中构建可靠的证据链是开放域多跳问答的核心挑战。单次检索难以定位链式推理所需的桥接段落；在多步骤流水线中，早期检索错误可能在各跳之间级联传播，而轨迹级训练也难以将错误归因到具体阶段。我们提出PRISMA，一个采用“规划-检索-检查-求解-记忆”架构的多智能体框架，该架构反映了专家的信息检索行为。PRISMA使用结构化生成作为智能体间的通信模式，每个智能体的输出既约束其自身推理，又定义了下游智能体的输入接口。检查器在每个跳处审计证据链并触发针对性恢复。我们采用带有智能体专属奖励的解耦训练策略：第一阶段将规划器和求解器专门化为任务专家，第二阶段冻结已训练的流水线……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2601.05465v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Constructing reliable evidence chains across massive corpora is a core challenge in open-domain multi-hop question answering. Single-pass retrieval struggles to locate the bridge passages required for chained reasoning. In multi-step pipelines, early retrieval errors can cascade across hops, and trajectory-level training makes it hard to attribute errors to specific stages. We propose PRISMA, a multi-agent framework with a Plan-Retrieve-Inspect-Solve-Memoize Architecture that reflects expert information seeking behavior. PRISMA uses structured generation as an inter-agent communication schema. Each agent's output constrains its reasoning and defines the input interface for downstream agents. An Inspector audits the evidence chain at each hop and triggers targeted recovery. We adopt a decoupled training strategy with agent-specific rewards. item.title: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think是一个专注于韩语语言文化语境推理与智能体能力的开源视觉-语言模型，在韩语基准测试和智能体评估任务上表现优异。
item.description:
HyperCLOVA X 32B Think

HyperCLOVA X 32B Think

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03286

HyperCLOVA X 32B Think是一个专注于韩语语言文化语境推理与智能体能力的开源视觉-语言模型，在韩语基准测试和智能体评估任务上表现优异。

在本报告中，我们提出了HyperCLOVA X 32B Think，这是一个视觉-语言模型，特别侧重于韩语语言和文化背景下的推理能力以及智能体能力。HyperCLOVA X 32B Think在预训练阶段高度专注于推理能力，随后通过后训练来支持多模态理解、增强推理、智能体行为以及与人类偏好的对齐。针对同等规模模型的实验评估表明，我们的模型在韩语文本到文本和视觉到文本基准测试以及面向智能体的评估任务上取得了强劲的表现。通过开源HyperCLOVA X 32B Think，我们旨在支持更广泛的应用，并促进学术和工业界的进一步研究与创新。

arXiv:2601.03286v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this report, we present HyperCLOVA X 32B Think, a vision-language model designed with particular emphasis on reasoning within the Korean linguistic and cultural context, as well as agentic ability. HyperCLOVA X 32B Think is pre-trained with a strong focus on reasoning capabilities and subsequently post-trained to support multimodal understanding, enhanced reasoning, agentic behaviors, and alignment with human preferences. Experimental evaluations against comparably sized models demonstrate that our model achieves strong performance on Korean text-to-text and vision-to-text benchmarks, as well as on agent-oriented evaluation tasks. By open-sourcing HyperCLOVA X 32B Think, we aim to support broader adoption and facilitate further research and innovation across both academic and industrial communities.

item.title: 提出FlowPlan-G2P框架，通过构建发明要素与功能关系的有向概念图并将其划分为有序分节子图，将科学论文自动转化为法律合规的专利说明书，专家法律合规评分达4.7/5，远超零样本方法的1.5分。
item.description:
FlowPlan-G2P：一种将科学论文转化为专利说明书的结构化生成框架

FlowPlan-G2P: A Structured Generation Framework for Transforming Scientific Papers into Patent Descriptions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02589

提出FlowPlan-G2P框架，通过构建发明要素与功能关系的有向概念图并将其划分为有序分节子图，将科学论文自动转化为法律合规的专利说明书，专家法律合规评分达4.7/5，远超零样本方法的1.5分。

研究人员通常以科学论文的形式发表发明，然而将其转化为专利说明书仍然困难重重，因为法定的充分公开要求严格且符合法律结构的披露。现有的专利撰写方法要么假设输入是专利原生格式（如权利要求），要么通过局部检索从大纲片段生成分节内容，而缺乏对技术依赖关系的显式文档级表示。我们提出了FlowPlan-G2P，一个以图为中介的框架，它（1）归纳出发明要素及功能关系的有向概念图，（2）依据连通性、同质性和领域约束惩罚对图进行评分，并将其划分为有序的分节子图，（3）使用针对各分节的特定撰写策略来综合生成专利说明书。在Pap2Pat-EvalGold基准上，零样本方法取得了最高的BERTScore（0.87），但专家法律合规性评分仅为5分制中的1.5分，而FlowPlan-G2P则达到4.7分（摘要原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2601.02589v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Researchers routinely publish inventions as scientific papers, yet turning them into patent descriptions remains difficult because statutory enablement demands rigid, legally structured disclosure. Prior patent drafting methods either assume patent-native inputs such as claims or generate sections from outline chunks via local retrieval without an explicit document-level representation of technical dependencies. We propose FlowPlan-G2P, a graph-mediated framework that (1) induces a directed concept graph of invention elements and functional relations, (2) partitions it into ordered section subgraphs scored by connectivity, homogeneity, and domain-constraint penalties, and (3) synthesizes patent descriptions using section-specific drafting strategies. item.title: HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 是 HyperCLOVA X 系列首个支持文本、音频和视觉任意输入输出的统一全模态模型，通过共享的下一词预测接口整合多模态理解与生成，在韩英双语下达到与同规模模型相当的性能并计划开源权重。
item.description:
HyperCLOVA X 8B 全模态模型（HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni）

HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01792

HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 是 HyperCLOVA X 系列首个支持文本、音频和视觉任意输入输出的统一全模态模型，通过共享的下一词预测接口整合多模态理解与生成，在韩英双语下达到与同规模模型相当的性能并计划开源权重。

在本报告中，我们提出了 HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni，这是 HyperCLOVA X 系列中首个支持文本、音频和视觉同时作为输入与输出的任意到任意全模态模型。通过将多模态理解与生成整合进单一模型，而非采用针对特定模态的分离式流水线，HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 作为 8B 规模的全模态探索起点，为构建实用的任意到任意全能助手指明方向。在总体设计上，该模型通过对交错的模态序列共享下一词预测接口来统一各模态，同时由视觉和音频编码器注入连续嵌入，以实现细粒度的理解与定位。实证评估表明，在涵盖文本、音频和视觉的多种输入输出组合下，该模型在韩语和英语两种语言中均展现出与同规模模型相比具有竞争力的性能。我们预计 HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 的开源权重发布将为广泛的研究提供支持。

arXiv:2601.01792v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this report, we present HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni, the first any-to-any omnimodal model in the HyperCLOVA X family that supports text, audio, and vision as both inputs and outputs. By consolidating multimodal understanding and generation into a single model rather than separate modality-specific pipelines, HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni serves as an 8B-scale omni-pathfinding point toward practical any-to-any omni assistants. At a high level, the model unifies modalities through a shared next-token prediction interface over an interleaved multimodal sequence, while vision and audio encoders inject continuous embeddings for fine-grained understanding and grounding. Empirical evaluations demonstrate competitive performance against comparably sized models across diverse input-output combinations spanning text, audio, and vision, in both Korean and English. item.title: DynaFix的核心创新在于在迭代修复过程中反复收集（通过ByteTrace获取变量状态、分支路径和调用栈）并更新执行层动态信息，将其融入提示并以重执行验证补丁，形成闭环，使基于LLM的自动程序修复扎根于具体的运行时行为。
item.description:
DynaFix：由执行层动态信息驱动的迭代式自动程序修复

DynaFix: Iterative Automated Program Repair Driven by Execution-Level Dynamic Information

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24635

DynaFix的核心创新在于在迭代修复过程中反复收集（通过ByteTrace获取变量状态、分支路径和调用栈）并更新执行层动态信息，将其融入提示并以重执行验证补丁，形成闭环，使基于LLM的自动程序修复扎根于具体的运行时行为。

arXiv:2512.24635v3 通告类型：replace-cross 摘要：自动程序修复（APR）旨在为有缺陷的程序生成正确的补丁，但近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的修复系统对表面代码变化较为敏感，并且在迭代修复过程中往往依赖粗糙的测试结果。我们提出DynaFix，一个基于LLM的APR框架，它将执行层动态信息集成到闭环修复工作流中。DynaFix的显著特点不在于使用执行层信息本身，而在于在整个迭代修复过程中反复更新并利用这些信息。在每一轮修复中，DynaFix使用ByteTrace收集变量状态、分支路径和调用栈，将这些运行时信号融入结构化提示中，通过重新执行来验证生成的补丁，并将由此获得的更新后的追踪信息反馈到后续的修复迭代中。这一过程使补丁生成立足于具体的执行行为，而非……（原文截断）

arXiv:2512.24635v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) seeks to generate correct patches for buggy programs, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based repair systems remain sensitive to superficial code changes and often rely on coarse test outcomes during iterative repair. We propose DynaFix, an LLM-based APR framework that integrates execution-level dynamic information into a closed-loop repair workflow. The distinguishing feature of DynaFix lies not in using execution-level information per se, but in repeatedly updating and exploiting such information throughout the iterative repair process. In each repair round, DynaFix uses ByteTrace to collect variable states, branch paths, and call stacks, incorporates these runtime signals into structured prompts, validates generated patches through re-execution, and feeds the resulting updated traces into subsequent repair iterations. item.title: 本文提出“主观函数”这一新概念——一种基于智能体自身特征而非外部任务定义的高阶目标函数，并以预期预测误差为例，为解释和实现AI自主生成目标的能力提供了新途径。
item.description:
主观函数

Subjective functions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15948

本文提出“主观函数”这一新概念——一种基于智能体自身特征而非外部任务定义的高阶目标函数，并以预期预测误差为例，为解释和实现AI自主生成目标的能力提供了新途径。

目标函数从何而来？我们如何选择要追求的目标？人类智能善于即时合成新的目标函数。这一机制是如何运作的，我们能否赋予人工系统同样的能力？本文提出了一种回答这些问题的新思路，首先引入了“主观函数”的概念——一种内生于智能体的高阶目标函数（即相对于智能体自身的特征而非外部任务来定义）。论文将预期预测误差作为主观函数的一个具体例子进行了研究。该提议与心理学、神经科学和机器学习中的诸多思想存在联系。

arXiv:2512.15948v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Where do objective functions come from? How do we select what goals to pursue? Human intelligence is adept at synthesizing new objective functions on the fly. How does this work, and can we endow artificial systems with the same ability? This paper proposes an approach to answering these questions, starting with the concept of a subjective function, a higher-order objective function that is endogenous to the agent (i.e., defined with respect to the agent's features, rather than an external task). Expected prediction error is studied as a concrete example of a subjective function. This proposal has many connections to ideas in psychology, neuroscience, and machine learning.

item.title: FedSTAR提出了一种风格感知的个性化联邦学习框架，通过将客户端风格因素与内容表示解耦、利用Transformer注意力机制聚合类别原型，并仅交换紧凑的原型与风格向量而非完整模型参数，从而在保持个性化的同时有效应对数据异构、参与不平衡和通信约束。
item.description:
联邦式风格感知的Transformer表示聚合

Federated style aware transformer aggregation of representations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18841

FedSTAR提出了一种风格感知的个性化联邦学习框架，通过将客户端风格因素与内容表示解耦、利用Transformer注意力机制聚合类别原型，并仅交换紧凑的原型与风格向量而非完整模型参数，从而在保持个性化的同时有效应对数据异构、参与不平衡和通信约束。

个性化联邦学习（PFL）面临持续的挑战，包括来自多样化客户端数据的领域异构性、因参与倾斜导致的数据不平衡，以及严格的通信约束。传统联邦学习往往缺乏个性化，因为单一的全局模型无法捕捉客户端特有的特征，从而导致预测偏差和泛化能力差，尤其是对于数据分布高度差异化的客户端。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了FedSTAR，一种风格感知的联邦学习框架，它将客户端特定的风格因素从共享的内容表示中解耦出来。FedSTAR使用基于Transformer的注意力机制聚合类别级原型，使服务器能够在保持个性化的同时自适应地为客户端贡献加权。此外，通过交换紧凑的原型和风格向量而非完整的模型参数，FedSTAR显著……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2511.18841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) faces persistent challenges, including domain heterogeneity from diverse client data, data imbalance due to skewed participation, and strict communication constraints. Traditional federated learning often lacks personalization, as a single global model cannot capture client-specific characteristics, leading to biased predictions and poor generalization, especially for clients with highly divergent data distributions. To address these issues, we propose FedSTAR, a style-aware federated learning framework that disentangles client-specific style factors from shared content representations. FedSTAR aggregates class-wise prototypes using a Transformer-based attention mechanism, allowing the server to adaptively weight client contributions while preserving personalization. item.title: 该论文提出一个以数据为中心的合成数据生成框架，利用真实共现模式和ICD知识生成9万份覆盖7902个ICD编码的合成出院摘要，以缓解ICD编码长尾分布不平衡问题并提升罕见编码的自动编码性能。
item.description:
面向罕见ICD编码的合成临床笔记：一种以数据为中心的长尾医疗编码框架

Synthetic Clinical Notes for Rare ICD Codes: A Data-Centric Framework for Long-Tail Medical Coding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14112

该论文提出一个以数据为中心的合成数据生成框架，利用真实共现模式和ICD知识生成9万份覆盖7902个ICD编码的合成出院摘要，以缓解ICD编码长尾分布不平衡问题并提升罕见编码的自动编码性能。

从临床文本中自动进行ICD编码是医学自然语言处理中的一项关键任务，但诊断编码的极端长尾分布仍然阻碍着该任务的发展。数千个罕见和零样本的ICD编码在MIMIC-III等数据集中严重欠表示，导致宏观F1分数较低。在本工作中，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的框架，通过生成高质量的合成出院摘要来缓解这种不平衡。我们的方法利用真实世界的共现模式、ICD描述、同义词、分类体系以及相似的临床笔记，构建以罕见编码为锚点的真实多标签编码集合。利用这些结构化提示，我们生成了90,000份覆盖7,902个ICD编码的合成笔记，显著扩展了训练数据的分布。我们在原始数据集和扩展数据集上微调了两个最先进的基于Transformer的模型PLM-ICD和GKI-ICD。实验表明，我们的方法适度提升了宏观F1分数。

arXiv:2511.14112v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automatic ICD coding from clinical text is a critical task in medical NLP but remains hindered by the extreme long-tail distribution of diagnostic codes. Thousands of rare and zero-shot ICD codes are severely underrepresented in datasets like MIMIC-III, leading to low macro-F1 scores. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework that generates high-quality synthetic discharge summaries to mitigate this imbalance. Our method constructs realistic multi-label code sets anchored on rare codes by leveraging real-world co-occurrence patterns, ICD descriptions, synonyms, taxonomy, and similar clinical notes. Using these structured prompts, we generate 90,000 synthetic notes covering 7,902 ICD codes, significantly expanding the training distribution. item.title: AdvisorX是一个“人在回路”的大语言模型聊天机器人，通过自动化信息收集、政策查询和回复起草等耗时任务来辅助学业指导，同时让指导老师保持人工监督，用户研究显示大多数指导老师认为该系统有用。
item.description:
AdvisorX：一个人机协同的AI驱动聊天机器人，用于支持高等教育中的学业指导

AdvisorX: A Human-in-the-Loop AI-Powered Chatbot to Support Academic Advising in Higher Education

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.05706

AdvisorX是一个“人在回路”的大语言模型聊天机器人，通过自动化信息收集、政策查询和回复起草等耗时任务来辅助学业指导，同时让指导老师保持人工监督，用户研究显示大多数指导老师认为该系统有用。

学业指导对学生的成功至关重要，然而过高的学生与指导老师之比限制了指导老师提供及时支持的能力。先前的研究已将大语言模型（LLM）应用于学业指导并取得了令人鼓舞的成果，表明精心的设计可以生成基于院校信息来源的个性化回复。然而，现有的AI增强型指导系统主要面向学生、聚焦于学生体验，而将指导老师——学业指导中的核心利益相关者——排除在设计与评估之外。为弥补这一空白，我们推出了AdvisorX，这是一个由LLM驱动的聊天机器人，能够自动化耗时的指导任务——例如信息收集、政策查询和回复起草——同时让指导老师保持在流程之中，以保留人工监督。我们通过与八位指导老师的用户研究对AdvisorX进行了评估。大多数指导老师认为该系统有用，一半的指导老师表示他们最初的顾虑有所缓解（注：原始摘要此处似有截断）。

arXiv:2511.05706v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Academic advising is critical to student success, yet high student-to-advisor ratios limit advisors' capacity to provide timely support. Prior work has applied large language models (LLMs) to academic advising with promising results, showing that careful design can produce personalized responses grounded in institutional sources. However, existing AI-augmented advising systems are primarily student-facing and focus on student experience, leaving advisors, a central stakeholder in academic advising, out of both design and evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce AdvisorX, an LLM-powered chatbot that automates time-consuming advising tasks--such as information collection, policy lookup, and response drafting--while keeping advisors in the loop to preserve human oversight. item.title: ArchPilot提出了一个由编排、生成和评估三个智能体组成的多智能体系统，通过MCTS启发式的自适应搜索与基于代理的轻量级评估代替重复完整训练，大幅降低了自动机器学习工程的计算开销并加速了迭代周期。
item.description:
ArchPilot：一种用于机器学习工程的代理引导多智能体方法

ArchPilot: A Proxy-Guided Multi-Agent Approach for Machine Learning Engineering

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03985

ArchPilot提出了一个由编排、生成和评估三个智能体组成的多智能体系统，通过MCTS启发式的自适应搜索与基于代理的轻量级评估代替重复完整训练，大幅降低了自动机器学习工程的计算开销并加速了迭代周期。

近年来，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在自动化机器学习工程领域展现出了强大的能力。然而，它们严重依赖重复的完整训练运行来评估候选解决方案，导致显著的计算开销、对大型搜索空间的可扩展性受限以及缓慢的迭代周期。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ArchPilot，一个将架构生成、基于代理的评估和自适应搜索整合到统一框架中的多智能体系统。ArchPilot由三个专门的智能体组成：编排智能体，使用受蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）启发的新型算法（带有重启机制）来协调搜索过程，并管理先前候选方案的存储记忆；生成智能体，迭代地生成、改进和调试候选架构；以及评估智能体，执行代理训练运行、生成和优化代理函数，并汇总代理得分。

arXiv:2511.03985v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in automated ML engineering. However, they heavily rely on repeated full training runs to evaluate candidate solutions, resulting in significant computational overhead, limited scalability to large search spaces, and slow iteration cycles. To address these challenges, we introduce ArchPilot, a multi-agent system that integrates architecture generation, proxy-based evaluation, and adaptive search into a unified framework. ArchPilot consists of three specialized agents: an orchestration agent that coordinates the search process using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-inspired novel algorithm with a restart mechanism and manages memory of previous candidates; a generation agent that iteratively generates, improves, and debugs candidate architectures; and an evaluation agent that executes proxy training runs, generates and optimizes proxy functions, and aggregates the proxy sco

item.title: 本文通过为actor和critic递归设计改进的学习率，将双时间尺度critic-actor算法的样本复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ 提升至 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$，达到了此前仅单时间尺度actor-critic算法才能实现的水平。
item.description:
改进Critic-Actor算法的样本复杂度

Improving Sample Complexity of Critic-Actor Algorithms

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04189

本文通过为actor和critic递归设计改进的学习率，将双时间尺度critic-actor算法的样本复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ 提升至 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$，达到了此前仅单时间尺度actor-critic算法才能实现的水平。

关于actor-critic（AC）算法的理论收敛性保证（包括渐近和非渐近保证）已经有大量的研究。在最近的两篇论文中，研究者提出了双时间尺度的critic-actor（CA）算法，其中actor和critic的角色被颠倒，使算法模仿值迭代而非策略迭代。已有工作对采用函数逼近的双时间尺度critic-actor算法进行了有限时间分析，得到了 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ 的样本复杂度，其中 $\delta>0$ 是取决于两个步长之间分离程度的参数。本文获得了改进的样本复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$，这一复杂度此前仅能由单时间尺度的actor-critic算法实现。我们为actor和critic的递归提出了改进的学习率，从而得到了这一更优的样本复杂度。

arXiv:2510.04189v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: There has been significant research activity on studying the theoretical convergence guarantees (both asymptotic and non-asymptotic) for actor-critic (AC) algorithms. In a couple of recent papers, two-timescale critic-actor algorithms have been proposed where the role of the actor and critic is reversed, resulting in the algorithm mimicking value iteration as opposed to policy iteration. Finite time analysis has been carried out for a two-timescale critic-actor (CA) algorithm with function approximation and a sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ is obtained for some $\delta>0$ that is a function of the separation between the two step sizes. In this paper, we obtain improved sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ that had previously been achieved only by the single-timescale actor-critic algorithm. item.title: Rhythm-TTS 提出了一种捷径零样本文本转语音框架，将预测的离散编解码器标记作为语义-声学先验，直接生成高保真的整体连续语音潜变量，并结合概率化节奏生成，从而兼顾离散标记的可因子分解性与连续表示的高保真度。

Rhythm-TTS：面向零样本文本转语音的高保真捷径潜变量建模与概率化节奏生成

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.02848

Rhythm-TTS 提出了一种捷径零样本文本转语音框架，将预测的离散编解码器标记作为语义-声学先验，直接生成高保真的整体连续语音潜变量，并结合概率化节奏生成，从而兼顾离散标记的可因子分解性与连续表示的高保真度。

零样本文本转语音（TTS）系统通常建立在离散编解码器标记（codec tokens）或连续声学表示之上。离散标记模型受益于稳定的序列建模和显式的语音因子分解，但其最终通过码本查找和码字组合来合成语音，这会累积误差并对自然度和说话人相似度造成质量上限。连续表示模型可以直接生成细粒度的语音潜变量，但往往需要更繁重的上下文建模且对齐不够显式。本文提出 Rhythm-TTS，一种捷径（shortcut）零样本文本转语音框架，它将离散编解码器标记的可因子分解性与连续潜变量生成的高保真度相结合。Rhythm-TTS 不把预测出的编解码器标记直接作为最终声学表示，而是将其用作语义-声学先验，并直接生成整体的连续语音潜变量……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2510.02848v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) systems are commonly built on either discrete codec tokens or continuous acoustic representations. Discrete-token models benefit from stable sequence modeling and explicit speech factorization, but they ultimately synthesize speech through codebook lookup and codeword composition, which can accumulate errors and impose a quality ceiling on naturalness and speaker similarity. Continuous-representation models can generate fine-grained speech latents directly, but often require heavier in-context modeling and less explicit alignment. This paper presents \textbf{Rhythm-TTS}, a shortcut zero-shot TTS framework that combines the factorizability of discrete codec tokens with the fidelity of continuous latent generation. Instead of using predicted codec tokens as the final acoustic representation, Rhythm-TTS uses them as a semantic-acoustic prior and directly generates holistic continuous speech latents w

item.title: 提出两阶段框架PPGFlowECG，利用CardioAlign编码器在共享潜在空间中对齐PPG与ECG，并通过潜在整流流从可穿戴设备的PPG信号生成临床可用心电图，用于心血管疾病检测。
item.description:
PPGFlowECG：基于跨模态编码的潜在整流流，用于PPG引导的心电图生成与心血管疾病检测

PPGFlowECG: Latent Rectified Flow with Cross-Modal Encoding for PPG-Guided ECG Generation and Cardiovascular Disease Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19774

提出两阶段框架PPGFlowECG，利用CardioAlign编码器在共享潜在空间中对齐PPG与ECG，并通过潜在整流流从可穿戴设备的PPG信号生成临床可用心电图，用于心血管疾病检测。

心电图（ECG）是心血管疾病（CVD）评估的临床金标准，但连续监测受限于对专用硬件和受过训练人员的依赖。光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）在可穿戴设备中无处不在且易于规模化，但其缺乏电生理特异性，限制了诊断的可靠性。尽管生成式方法旨在将PPG转化为临床可用的ECG信号，但现有方法受限于生成模型中生理语义的不对齐以及高维信号建模的复杂性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了PPGFlowECG，这是一个两阶段框架，首先使用CardioAlign编码器在共享潜在空间中对齐PPG和ECG，然后通过潜在整流流合成ECG。我们进一步对这种耦合提供了形式化分析，表明CardioAlign编码器对于保证稳定和……是必要的（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2509.19774v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) is the clinical gold standard for cardiovascular disease (CVD) assessment, yet continuous monitoring is constrained by the need for dedicated hardware and trained personnel. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is ubiquitous in wearable devices and readily scalable, but it lacks electrophysiological specificity, limiting diagnostic reliability. While generative methods aim to translate PPG into clinically useful ECG signals, existing approaches are limited by the misalignment of physiological semantics in generative models and the complexity of modeling in high-dimensional signals. To address these limitations, we propose PPGFlowECG, a two-stage framework that aligns PPG and ECG in a shared latent space using the CardioAlign Encoder and then synthesizes ECGs with latent rectified flow. We further provide a formal analysis of this coupling, showing that the CardioAlign Encoder is necessary to guarantee stable and

item.title: 本文提出“圆桌政策”推理框架，通过多个大语言模型的置信度加权共识聚合，在仅需黑盒访问的条件下显著提升多智能体系统在复杂科学任务中的推理能力，并兼具结构化与可解释性。
item.description:
圆桌政策：置信度加权共识聚合提升多智能体系统推理

Roundtable Policy: Confidence-Weighted-Consensus Aggregation Improves Multi-Agent-System Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16839

本文提出“圆桌政策”推理框架，通过多个大语言模型的置信度加权共识聚合，在仅需黑盒访问的条件下显著提升多智能体系统在复杂科学任务中的推理能力，并兼具结构化与可解释性。

多智能体系统在下游任务中已展现出超越多种单智能体基线的卓越性能。越来越多的研究工作探索了改进其推理与协作的方法，从投票、辩论到复杂的交互协议。然而，为什么在多智能体系统中应优先选择某种特定方法仍然不明确。受民主委员会决策机制和“心智社会”理论的启发，我们提出了圆桌政策，这是一种面向多智能体系统的推理时框架，通过多个大语言模型的加权共识来执行推理。通过大量实验，我们证明该方法能显著增强在复杂异构科学任务中的推理能力。圆桌政策强调结构化且可解释的推理，而非不透明的收敛过程，同时仅需黑盒访问权限和统一流程，因此具有广泛的适用性。

arXiv:2509.16839v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-agent systems have demonstrated exceptional performance in downstream tasks beyond diverse single agent baselines. A growing body of work has explored ways to improve their reasoning and collaboration, from vote, debate, to complex interaction protocols. However, it still remains opaque why specific choice would be preferred in multi-agent systems. Inspired by the decision-making mechanism of democratic committees and The Society of Mind, we introduce Roundtable Policy, an inference-time reasoning framework for multi-agent systems that performs inference through the weighted consensus of multiple LLMs. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate its that this approach significantly enhances reasoning in complex heterogeneous scientific tasks. Roundtable Policy emphasizes structured and interpretable inference rather than opaque convergence, while requires only black-box access and uniform procedures, making it broadly applica

item.title: 该论文通过对 11 个大语言模型在 16 种非洲语言上的评估，揭示了更高的分词生育率会系统性降低准确率并使训练成本翻两番，从而量化了低资源、形态复杂语言所承受的“代币税”偏见。
item.description:
代币税：多语言分词中的系统性偏差

The Token Tax: Systematic Bias in Multilingual Tokenization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05486

该论文通过对 11 个大语言模型在 16 种非洲语言上的评估，揭示了更高的分词生育率会系统性降低准确率并使训练成本翻两番，从而量化了低资源、形态复杂语言所承受的“代币税”偏见。

分词效率低下给形态复杂、资源匮乏的语言带来了结构性劣势，导致计算资源消耗增加和准确率下降。我们在 AfriMMLU 数据集（5 个学科；16 种非洲语言）上评估了 11 个大语言模型（LLM）；在能够计算分词生育率的 10 个模型中，分词生育率越高与准确率越低相关：全部 50 个模型—学科斜率均为负值，其中 24 个在 p<0.05 水平上显著，12 个在错误发现率（FDR）校正后仍然显著。我们进一步发现，推理模型（如 DeepSeek R1、o1）在所评估的模型中具有最高的平均准确率和最小的英语—非洲语言差距。在经济方面，token 数量翻倍会导致训练成本和时间增至四倍，凸显了许多语言所面临的“代币税”。这些结果推动了形态感知分词、公平定价以及面向公平自然语言处理的多语言基准的发展。

arXiv:2509.05486v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tokenization inefficiency is associated with structural disadvantages for morphologically complex, low-resource languages, inflating compute resources and reducing accuracy. We evaluate 11 large language models (LLMs) on AfriMMLU (5 subjects; 16 African languages); for the 10 models whose fertility we could compute, higher token fertility is associated with lower accuracy: all 50 model--subject slopes are negative, 24 are significant at p<0.05, and 12 remain significant after false-discovery-rate correction. We further find that reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek R1, o1) have the highest average accuracy and the smallest English-African gaps among the models evaluated. In terms of economics, a doubling in tokens results in quadrupled training cost and time, underscoring the "token tax" faced by many languages. These results motivate morphologically aware tokenization, fair pricing, and multilingual benchmarks for equitable natura

item.title: 提出SpikeSTAG神经形态架构，通过树突图模块将谱图卷积与脉冲神经元动力学在单一单元内耦合，并利用双流整合模块自适应融合空间与时间表示，从而在多变量时间序列预测中同时捕捉时空依赖关系。
item.description:
SpikeSTAG：一种用于多变量时间序列预测的树突隔室化脉冲图网络

SpikeSTAG: A Dendritic Compartmental Spiking Graph Network for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02069

提出SpikeSTAG神经形态架构，通过树突图模块将谱图卷积与脉冲神经元动力学在单一单元内耦合，并利用双流整合模块自适应融合空间与时间表示，从而在多变量时间序列预测中同时捕捉时空依赖关系。

脉冲神经网络凭借其内在的膜电位动力学，为时间建模提供了一种独特的范式。然而，现有的基于SNN的预测方法仅专注于时间处理，缺乏捕捉变量间空间依赖关系的机制。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了SpikeSTAG，这是一种神经形态时空架构，将基于图的空间推理融入脉冲驱动的时间计算之中。我们方法的核心是树突图模块，该模块将谱图卷积重新解释为生物学意义上的树突整合——在单一计算单元内将多尺度空间聚合与脉冲神经元的时间动力学耦合起来。为了自适应地融合由此产生的空间与时间表示，我们进一步引入了双流整合模块，该模块采用竞争门控和基于重合的放大机制，选择性地增强……

arXiv:2508.02069v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a distinctive paradigm for temporal modeling through their intrinsic membrane potential dynamics. However, existing SNN-based forecasting methods focus exclusively on temporal processing, lacking mechanisms to capture spatial dependencies among variables. To bridge this gap, we propose SpikeSTAG, a neuromorphic spatiotemporal architecture that integrates graph-based spatial reasoning into spike-driven temporal computation. Central to our approach is the Dendritic Graph Module, which reinterprets spectral graph convolutions as biological dendritic integration --- coupling multi-scale spatial aggregation with the temporal dynamics of spiking neurons within a single computational unit. To adaptively fuse the resulting spatial and temporal representations, we further introduce a Dual-Stream Integration Module that employs competitive gating and coincidence-based amplification, selectively enhanc

item.title: 该论文提出Time-MAGNET，一种结合图注意力、专家混合架构与LoRA高效微调的联邦多模态学习框架，通过自适应融合异构传感模态来提升人体活动识别的判别能力和鲁棒性。
item.description:
Time-MAGNET：用于人体活动识别的联邦多模态图神经专家Transformer

Time-MAGNET: Federated Multimodal Graph Neural Expert Transformer for Human Activity Recognition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.01701

该论文提出Time-MAGNET，一种结合图注意力、专家混合架构与LoRA高效微调的联邦多模态学习框架，通过自适应融合异构传感模态来提升人体活动识别的判别能力和鲁棒性。

人体活动识别（HAR）在健身追踪、智能家居和医疗健康监测等应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。单模态HAR系统依赖单一来源的传感信息，因此可能受到特定传感器噪声和信号退化的影响，从而限制其区分不同活动的能力。为了解决这些局限性，本工作提出了Time-MAGNET，这是一种新颖的多模态学习框架，能够自适应地融合异构感知模态，为HAR学习具有判别性的表示。该框架利用图注意力和专家混合架构自适应地建模异构模态之间的交互。为了捕获复杂的时序依赖关系，我们采用了专为多模态HAR定制的轻量级编码器式T5架构，并借助低秩自适应（LoRA）技术进行高效训练。在现实世界的应用中，多模态HAR数据通常分布式地……（摘要在此处不完整）

arXiv:2508.01701v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Human Activity Recognition plays a vital role in applications such as fitness tracking, smart homes, and healthcare monitoring. Single modality HAR systems rely on a single source of sensory information and can therefore be affected by sensor specific noise and signal degradation, which may limit their ability to distinguish between activities. To address these limitations, this work proposes Time-MAGNET, a novel multimodal learning framework that adaptively fuses heterogeneous sensing modalities to learn discriminative representations for HAR. It adaptively models interactions among heterogeneous modalities using graph attention and a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. To capture complex temporal dependencies, we employ a lightweight encoder-only T5 architecture customized for multimodal HAR and efficiently trained using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). In real world applications, multimodal HAR data are typically distributed acros

item.title: 提出了首个利用音频中的空间听觉线索（如响度和频率所揭示的声源位置与移动方向）来生成空间感知视频的框架SpA2V，突破了现有方法仅依赖语义信息的局限。
item.description:
SpA2V：利用空间听觉线索实现音频驱动的空间感知视频生成

SpA2V: Harnessing Spatial Auditory Cues for Audio-driven Spatially-aware Video Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00782

提出了首个利用音频中的空间听觉线索（如响度和频率所揭示的声源位置与移动方向）来生成空间感知视频的框架SpA2V，突破了现有方法仅依赖语义信息的局限。

音频驱动的视频生成旨在合成与输入音频记录相一致的真实感视频，类似于人类根据听觉输入在脑海中呈现场景的能力。然而，现有方法主要专注于探索语义信息，例如音频中发声源的类别，这限制了它们生成具有准确内容和空间构图的视频的能力。相比之下，我们人类不仅能够自然地识别发声源的语义类别，还能确定其深层蕴含的空间属性，包括位置和移动方向。这些有用的信息可以通过源自声音固有物理特性（如响度或频率）的特定空间指标来揭示。由于先前的方法在很大程度上忽略了这一因素，我们提出了SpA2V，这是首个明确利用音频中这些空间听觉线索来生成视频的框架。

arXiv:2508.00782v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Audio-driven video generation aims to synthesize realistic videos that align with input audio recordings, akin to the human ability to visualize scenes from auditory input. However, existing approaches predominantly focus on exploring semantic information, such as the classes of sounding sources present in the audio, limiting their ability to generate videos with accurate content and spatial composition. In contrast, we humans can not only naturally identify the semantic categories of sounding sources but also determine their deeply encoded spatial attributes, including locations and movement directions. This useful information can be elucidated by considering specific spatial indicators derived from the inherent physical properties of sound, such as loudness or frequency. As prior methods largely ignore this factor, we present SpA2V, the first framework explicitly exploits these spatial auditory cues from audios to generate vi

item.title: 该论文提出Geo-ORBIT统一框架，将实时车道检测、数字孪生同步与联邦元学习相结合，利用轻量级GeoLane模型从车辆轨迹数据中学习车道几何，解决了传统静态地图和昂贵传感器方案在可扩展性、适应性、隐私与计算效率方面的局限。
item.description:
Geo-ORBIT：一种面向场景自适应车道几何检测的联邦数字孪生框架

Geo-ORBIT: A Federated Digital Twin Framework for Scene-Adaptive Lane Geometry Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.08743

该论文提出Geo-ORBIT统一框架，将实时车道检测、数字孪生同步与联邦元学习相结合，利用轻量级GeoLane模型从车辆轨迹数据中学习车道几何，解决了传统静态地图和昂贵传感器方案在可扩展性、适应性、隐私与计算效率方面的局限。

数字孪生（DT）有潜力通过构建动态的交通系统虚拟表示来变革交通管理与运营，这种虚拟表示能够感知路况、分析运行状态并支持决策。交通系统数字孪生的一个关键组成部分是动态道路几何感知。然而，现有方法通常依赖静态地图或昂贵的传感器，限制了可扩展性和适应性。此外，从多源收集并分析数据的大规模数字孪生在隐私、通信和计算效率方面面临挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Geo-ORBIT（集成孪生的几何运营道路蓝图），这是一个融合了实时车道检测、数字孪生同步和联邦元学习的统一框架。Geo-ORBIT的核心是GeoLane，这是一种轻量级车道检测模型，能够从车辆轨迹数据中学习车道几何形状。

arXiv:2507.08743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Digital Twins (DT) have the potential to transform traffic management and operations by creating dynamic, virtual representations of transportation systems that sense conditions, analyze operations, and support decision-making. A key component for DT of the transportation system is dynamic roadway geometry sensing. However, existing approaches often rely on static maps or costly sensors, limiting scalability and adaptability. Additionally, large-scale DTs that collect and analyze data from multiple sources face challenges in privacy, communication, and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce Geo-ORBIT (Geometrical Operational Roadway Blueprint with Integrated Twin), a unified framework that combines real-time lane detection, DT synchronization, and federated meta-learning. At the core of Geo-ORBIT is GeoLane, a lightweight lane detection model that learns lane geometries from vehicle trajectory data

item.title: 本文聚焦神经符号人工智能中的逻辑接地问题，指出穷举接地虽能完整保留逻辑表达能力但会引发组合爆炸、启发式选择性接地虽高效却缺乏正确性保证，为理解和设计兼顾效率与信息保真性的接地方法提供了系统性分析。
item.description:
神经符号人工智能的接地方法

Grounding Methods for Neural-Symbolic AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.08216

本文聚焦神经符号人工智能中的逻辑接地问题，指出穷举接地虽能完整保留逻辑表达能力但会引发组合爆炸、启发式选择性接地虽高效却缺乏正确性保证，为理解和设计兼顾效率与信息保真性的接地方法提供了系统性分析。

一大类神经符号方法使用机器学习器来处理输入实体，同时依赖基于一阶逻辑的推理器来表示和处理实体之间更复杂的关系。逻辑接地过程在这些方法中起着根本性的作用，它利用实体的（子）集来确定逻辑规则的相关替换。一些NeSy方法对所有可能的替换进行穷举推导，从而保留了逻辑知识的完整表达能力，但这会导致待考虑的基例公式数量出现组合爆炸，进而严重限制了其可扩展性。另一些方法则依赖基于启发式的选择性推导，这类方法通常在计算上更高效，但缺乏理论依据，并且无法保证保留提供给推理器以及由推理器返回的信息。（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2507.08216v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A large class of Neural-Symbolic (NeSy) methods employs a machine learner to process the input entities, while relying on a reasoner based on First-Order Logic to represent and process more complex relationships among the entities. A fundamental role for these methods is played by the process of logic grounding, which determines the relevant substitutions for the logic rules using a (sub)set of entities. Some NeSy methods use an exhaustive derivation of all possible substitutions, preserving the full expressive power of the logic knowledge. This leads to a combinatorial explosion in the number of ground formulas to consider and, therefore, strongly limits their scalability. Other methods rely on heuristic-based selective derivations, which are generally more computationally efficient, but lack a justification and provide no guarantees of preserving the information provided to and returned by the reasoner. item.title: 该论文提出orGAN框架，通过在硅胶模拟器官上训练增强的StyleGAN3生成器、关系位置学习与LaMa修复网络，实现手术出血图像与点级真实标注标签的同步生成，从而克服手术数据稀缺、伦理限制与高标注成本等问题。

orGAN：一种可同时生成手术图像与真实标注标签的合成数据增强流水线

orGAN: A Synthetic Data Augmentation Pipeline for Simultaneous Generation of Surgical Images and Ground Truth Labels

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14303

该论文提出orGAN框架，通过在硅胶模拟器官上训练增强的StyleGAN3生成器、关系位置学习与LaMa修复网络，实现手术出血图像与点级真实标注标签的同步生成，从而克服手术数据稀缺、伦理限制与高标注成本等问题。

深度学习在手术图像分析中的应用受到数据多样性有限、伦理限制、高采集成本以及准确标注的出血数据集稀缺等问题的制约，这使得可靠的出血定位尤为困难。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了orGAN——一个模块化框架，能够生成逼真的、完全标注的合成手术出血图像，并同时提供可恢复的点级监督标签。为了克服真实手术数据带来的伦理与成本障碍，该流水线基于再现组织特性的硅胶模拟器官进行训练，采用增强的StyleGAN3生成器结合关系位置学习来嵌入出血坐标，利用手术标签检测算法恢复坐标与掩膜标签，并通过微调的LaMa图像修复网络还原干净的图像-标签对。为了弥补标注数据的稀缺，出血警报图定位

arXiv:2506.14303v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning for surgical image analysis is constrained by limited data diversity, ethical restrictions, high acquisition costs, and the scarcity of accurately annotated bleeding datasets, making reliable bleeding localization particularly challenging. To address these limitations, we propose orGAN, a modular framework that generates realistic, fully annotated synthetic surgical bleeding images together with recoverable point-level supervision. To overcome the ethical and cost barriers of real surgical data, the pipeline is trained on silicone-based mimicking organs that reproduce tissue properties, using an enhanced StyleGAN3 generator coupled with Relational Positional Learning to embed bleeding coordinates, a Surgical Label Detection Algorithm to recover coordinate and mask labels, and a fine-tuned LaMa inpainting network to restore clean image-label pairs. item.title: 提出KG-TRACES框架，通过对符号关系路径、三元组级推理路径和归因感知推理过程的显式监督，显著提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的可解释性和可信度。
item.description:
KG-TRACES：通过知识图谱约束的轨迹推理与归因监督增强大语言模型

KG-TRACES: Enhancing Large Language Models with Knowledge Graph-constrained Trajectory Reasoning and Attribution Supervision

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00783

提出KG-TRACES框架，通过对符号关系路径、三元组级推理路径和归因感知推理过程的显式监督，显著提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的可解释性和可信度。

大语言模型（LLMs）在各种自然语言处理任务中取得了显著进展，但它们在复杂推理问题上的表现仍然受到可解释性和可信度不足的阻碍。这一问题通常表现为幻觉或无法归因的推理过程，限制了它们在复杂推理场景中的适用性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了知识图谱约束的轨迹推理归因与链式解释监督框架（KG-TRACES），这是一个通过对推理路径和推理过程进行显式监督来增强大语言模型推理能力的新型框架。KG-TRACES联合监督模型完成以下任务：（1）预测符号化关系路径，（2）预测完整的三元组级别推理路径，（3）生成基于推理路径的、具有归因意识的推理过程。在推理阶段，该模型能够自适应地应对有知识图谱和没有知识图谱的两种场景。

arXiv:2506.00783v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable strides in various natural language processing tasks, but their performance on complex reasoning problems remains hindered by a lack of explainability and trustworthiness. This issue, often manifesting as hallucinations or unattributable reasoning processes, limits their applicability in complex reasoning scenarios. To address this, we propose Knowledge Graph-constrained Trajectory Reasoning Attribution and Chain Explanation Supervision (KG-TRACES), a novel framework that enhances the reasoning ability of LLMs through explicit supervision over reasoning paths and processes. KG-TRACES jointly supervises the model to: (1) predict symbolic relation paths, (2) predict full triple-level reasoning paths, and (3) generate attribution-aware reasoning processes grounded in the reasoning paths. item.title: 提出跨模态RAG框架，通过将查询和图像分解为子维度组件，并结合稀疏与稠密混合检索策略识别帕累托最优图像集合，实现子查询感知的检索增强文本到图像生成。
item.description:
跨模态RAG：子维度文本到图像检索增强生成

Cross-modal RAG: Sub-dimensional Text-to-Image Retrieval-Augmented Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21956

提出跨模态RAG框架，通过将查询和图像分解为子维度组件，并结合稀疏与稠密混合检索策略识别帕累托最优图像集合，实现子查询感知的检索增强文本到图像生成。

文本到图像生成日益需要访问特定领域、细粒度且快速演进的知识，而预训练模型无法完全涵盖这些知识，因此需要引入检索方法。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法试图通过检索全局相关的图像来解决这一问题，但当没有单一图像能够包含复杂用户查询中的所有所需元素时，这些方法便会失效。我们提出了跨模态RAG（Cross-modal RAG），这是一种新颖的框架，它将查询和图像均分解为子维度组件，从而实现子查询感知的检索与生成。我们的方法引入了一种混合检索策略，将子维度稀疏检索器与稠密检索器相结合，以识别出帕累托最优的图像集合，其中每张图像都贡献了查询的互补方面。在生成过程中，多模态大语言模型被引导选择性地以与特定子查询对齐的相关视觉特征为条件。

arXiv:2505.21956v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Text-to-image generation increasingly demands access to domain-specific, fine-grained, and rapidly evolving knowledge that pretrained models cannot fully capture, necessitating the integration of retrieval methods. Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods attempt to address this by retrieving globally relevant images, but they fail when no single image contains all desired elements from a complex user query. We propose Cross-modal RAG, a novel framework that decomposes both queries and images into sub-dimensional components, enabling subquery-aware retrieval and generation. Our method introduces a hybrid retrieval strategy, combining a sub-dimensional sparse retriever with a dense retriever, to identify a Pareto-optimal set of images, each contributing complementary aspects of the query.
