item.title: 该论文提出无需训练的 LAD 框架，通过感知、搜索与推理三阶段的测试时计算实现上下文对齐，使多模态大模型能够理解图像隐喻中涌现的隐含意义。
item.description:
让仿生人做梦：通过上下文对齐从视觉元素到涌现的隐含意义

Let Androids Dream: From Visual Elements to Emergent Implications via Contextual Alignment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17019

该论文提出无需训练的 LAD 框架，通过感知、搜索与推理三阶段的测试时计算实现上下文对齐，使多模态大模型能够理解图像隐喻中涌现的隐含意义。

图像隐喻理解与一般视觉问答（VQA）不同：其隐含意义很少直接显现在像素之中，而是从视觉元素的组合交互、社会意图以及文化特定的背景中涌现出来。我们识别出“上下文缺失”——即模型权重中已存在但单次推理未能利用的既有惯例，以及权重中缺失的外部事实——是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的一种失败模式。我们将“上下文对齐”形式化为对潜在上下文的推理：选择与图像构图相关且有助于推断其隐含意义的背景知识。随后，我们提出了 Let Androids Dream（LAD），一个无需训练的框架，通过测试时计算来实现上下文对齐：（1）感知提取组合性视觉结构；（2）搜索自适应地从参数化知识或网络搜索中获取上下文；（3）推理将……

arXiv:2505.17019v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Image metaphor understanding differs from general VQA: the implied meaning is rarely explicit in pixels and instead emerges from the compositional interaction of visual elements together with social intent and culture-specific background. We identify missing context, namely conventions already in a model's weights that single-pass inference leaves unused and external facts absent from the weights, as a failure mode of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We formalize Contextual Alignment as inference over a latent context: selecting background knowledge relevant to the image's composition and useful for inferring its implication. We then propose Let Androids Dream (LAD), a training-free framework that operationalizes contextual alignment through test-time computation: (1) Perception extracts compositional visual structure, (2) Search adaptively acquires context from parametric knowledge or web search, and (3) Reasoning ali

item.title: 该论文建立了多数-少数学习任务的形式化理论框架，证明了在人口和方差不平衡条件下标准梯度下降训练会放大偏差、产生忽视少数群体特征的刻板预测器，并给出了消除这种偏差所需额外训练量的理论下界。
item.description:
当多数主导、少数失败：梯度下降的偏差放大

When majority rules, minority loses: bias amplification of gradient descent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13122

该论文建立了多数-少数学习任务的形式化理论框架，证明了在人口和方差不平衡条件下标准梯度下降训练会放大偏差、产生忽视少数群体特征的刻板预测器，并给出了消除这种偏差所需额外训练量的理论下界。

尽管机器学习中偏差放大的实证证据日益增多，但其理论基础仍鲜为人知。我们为多数-少数学习任务开发了一个形式化框架，展示了标准训练如何偏向多数群体，并产生忽视少数群体特有特征的刻板预测器。在假设人口和方差不平衡的条件下，我们的分析揭示了三个关键发现： “全数据”预测器与刻板预测器之间的紧密接近性； 训练整个模型往往仅学习多数群体特征的区域的支配地位； 所需额外训练量的下界。我们的结果通过深度学习在表格和图像分类任务中的实验得到了说明。

arXiv:2505.13122v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Despite growing empirical evidence of bias amplification in machine learning, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. We develop a formal framework for majority-minority learning tasks, showing how standard training can favor majority groups and produce stereotypical predictors that neglect minority-specific features. Assuming population and variance imbalance, our analysis reveals three key findings: (i) the close proximity between ``full-data'' and stereotypical predictors, (ii) the dominance of a region where training the entire model tends to merely learn the majority traits, and (iii) a lower bound on the additional training required. Our results are illustrated through experiments in deep learning for tabular and image classification tasks.

item.title: HierSum提出了一种分层视频摘要方法，将字幕的细粒度局部线索与视频级指令的全局上下文相整合，并利用“最常重放”统计作为监督信号识别关键片段，在多个基准数据集上持续超越现有方法。
item.description:
HierSum：一种用于视频摘要的全局与局部注意力机制

HierSum: A Global and Local Attention Mechanism for Video Summarization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.18689

HierSum提出了一种分层视频摘要方法，将字幕的细粒度局部线索与视频级指令的全局上下文相整合，并利用“最常重放”统计作为监督信号识别关键片段，在多个基准数据集上持续超越现有方法。

视频摘要旨在创建一个删节版本（即摘要），在保留相关信息的同时提供视频的快速概览。在本工作中，我们专注于教学视频的摘要，提出了一种将视频分解为有意义片段的方法，每个片段对应视频中的关键步骤。我们提出了**HierSum**，一种分层方法，将来自字幕的细粒度局部线索与视频级指令提供的全局上下文信息相整合。我们的方法利用“最常重放”统计作为监督信号来识别关键片段，从而提高摘要的有效性。我们在TVSum、BLiSS、Mr.HiSum和WikiHow测试集等基准数据集上进行评估，结果表明HierSum在F1分数和秩相关性等关键指标上始终优于现有方法。我们还利用WikiHow和EHow策划了一个新的多模态数据集。

arXiv:2504.18689v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Video summarization creates an abridged version (i.e., a summary) that provides a quick overview of the video while retaining pertinent information. In this work, we focus on summarizing instructional videos and propose a method for breaking down a video into meaningful segments, each corresponding to essential steps in the video. We propose **HierSum**, a hierarchical approach that integrates fine-grained local cues from subtitles with global contextual information provided by video-level instructions. Our approach utilizes the "most replayed" statistic as a supervisory signal to identify critical segments, thereby improving the effectiveness of the summary. We evaluate on benchmark datasets such as TVSum, BLiSS, Mr.HiSum, and the WikiHow test set, and show that HierSum consistently outperforms existing methods in key metrics such as F1-score and rank correlation. We also curate a new multi-modal dataset using WikiHow and EHow

item.title: 提出E-ViM³——一种保留视频3D结构的Vision Mamba网络，结合包围全局标记和时空链式掩码策略进行自监督预训练，实现了医学超声视频的精确且数据高效的分析。
item.description:
Mamba-3D作为掩码自编码器用于医学超声视频的精确且数据高效的分析

Mamba-3D as Masked Autoencoders for Accurate and Data-Efficient Analysis of Medical Ultrasound Videos

https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20258

提出E-ViM³——一种保留视频3D结构的Vision Mamba网络，结合包围全局标记和时空链式掩码策略进行自监督预训练，实现了医学超声视频的精确且数据高效的分析。

超声视频是临床医学影像数据的重要形式，基于深度学习的自动化分析可以提高诊断准确性和临床效率。然而，标注数据的稀缺性以及视频分析固有的挑战阻碍了相关方法的发展。在这项工作中，我们提出了E-ViM³，这是一种数据高效的Vision Mamba网络，它保留了视频数据的3D结构，增强了长程依赖和归纳偏置，以更好地建模时空相关性。通过我们设计的包围全局标记（EGT），该模型比竞争方法更有效地捕获和聚合全局特征。为了进一步提高数据效率，我们采用掩码视频建模进行自监督预训练，并提出了时空链式（STC）掩码策略，旨在适应各种视频场景。实验表明，E-ViM³达到了最先进的性能……

arXiv:2503.20258v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ultrasound videos are an important form of clinical imaging data, and deep learning-based automated analysis can improve diagnostic accuracy and clinical efficiency. However, the scarcity of labeled data and the inherent challenges of video analysis have impeded the advancement of related methods. In this work, we introduce E-ViM$^3$, a data-efficient Vision Mamba network that preserves the 3D structure of video data, enhancing long-range dependencies and inductive biases to better model space-time correlations. With our design of Enclosure Global Tokens (EGT), the model captures and aggregates global features more effectively than competing methods. To further improve data efficiency, we employ masked video modeling for self-supervised pre-training, with the proposed Spatial-Temporal Chained (STC) masking strategy designed to adapt to various video scenarios. item.title: 该论文首次将基于Transformer的DETR框架与Co-DETR协作混合分配训练方案相结合应用于复杂多变驾驶环境的自动车辆检测，通过多样化标签分配策略和并行辅助头提升了检测精度与训练效率。
item.description:
基于DETR的自动车辆检测：一种用于应对复杂危险道路的Transformer方法

Automatic Vehicle Detection using DETR: A Transformer-Based Approach for Navigating Treacherous Roads

https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17843

该论文首次将基于Transformer的DETR框架与Co-DETR协作混合分配训练方案相结合应用于复杂多变驾驶环境的自动车辆检测，通过多样化标签分配策略和并行辅助头提升了检测精度与训练效率。

在多样化驾驶环境中的自动车辆检测（AVD）由于光照条件、道路类型和车辆类型的差异而面临独特的挑战。传统方法（如YOLO和Faster R-CNN）往往难以应对这些复杂性。随着计算机视觉的发展，将卷积神经网络（CNN）与基于Transformer的方法相结合，为提升检测精度和效率提供了有前景的机遇。本研究首次将检测Transformer（DETR）应用于复杂多变环境下的自动车辆检测。我们采用协作混合分配训练方案Co-DETR，以增强DETR中的特征学习和注意力机制。通过利用多样化的标签分配策略并引入多个并行辅助头，我们在训练过程中提供了更有效的监督，并提取正样本坐标以提高训练效率。

arXiv:2502.17843v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automatic Vehicle Detection (AVD) in diverse driving environments presents unique challenges due to varying lighting conditions, road types, and vehicle types. Traditional methods, such as YOLO and Faster R-CNN, often struggle to cope with these complexities. As computer vision evolves, combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Transformer-based approaches offers promising opportunities for improving detection accuracy and efficiency. This study is the first to experiment with Detection Transformer (DETR) for automatic vehicle detection in complex and varied settings. We employ a Collaborative Hybrid Assignments Training scheme, Co-DETR, to enhance feature learning and attention mechanisms in DETR. By leveraging versatile label assignment strategies and introducing multiple parallel auxiliary heads, we provide more effective supervision during training and extract positive coordinates to boost training efficiency. item.title: 该论文提出了一种无需验证最终感知结果、直接在特征层面检测恶意代理的新范式，并发布了首个协同感知恶意代理检测基准数据集CP-GuardBench及鲁棒防御方法CP-Guard+，在大幅降低计算开销的同时有效防御协同感知中的恶意攻击。
item.description:
CP-Guard+：协同感知中恶意代理检测与防御的新范式

CP-Guard+: A New Paradigm for Malicious Agent Detection and Defense in Collaborative Perception

https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07807

该论文提出了一种无需验证最终感知结果、直接在特征层面检测恶意代理的新范式，并发布了首个协同感知恶意代理检测基准数据集CP-GuardBench及鲁棒防御方法CP-Guard+，在大幅降低计算开销的同时有效防御协同感知中的恶意攻击。

协同感知（CP）是实现安全网联自动驾驶的一种有前景的方法，它使多辆车辆能够共享感知信息以提升感知性能。然而，与单车感知相比，协同感知系统的开放性使其更容易受到恶意攻击，攻击者可以注入恶意信息来误导自车的感知，从而给安全驾驶带来严重风险。为了缓解这种脆弱性，我们首先提出了一种新的恶意代理检测范式，该范式能够在特征层面有效识别恶意代理，而无需验证最终感知结果，从而显著降低计算开销。基于这一范式，我们推出了CP-GuardBench，这是首个用于训练和评估协同感知系统中各类恶意代理检测方法的综合性数据集。此外，我们还开发了一种名为CP-Guard+的鲁棒防御方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2502.07807v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Collaborative perception (CP) is a promising method for safe connected and autonomous driving, which enables multiple vehicles to share sensing information to enhance perception performance. However, compared with single-vehicle perception, the openness of a CP system makes it more vulnerable to malicious attacks that can inject malicious information to mislead the perception of an ego vehicle, resulting in severe risks for safe driving. To mitigate such vulnerability, we first propose a new paradigm for malicious agent detection that effectively identifies malicious agents at the feature level without requiring verification of final perception results, significantly reducing computational overhead. Building on this paradigm, we introduce CP-GuardBench, the first comprehensive dataset provided to train and evaluate various malicious agent detection methods for CP systems. Furthermore, we develop a robust defense method called C

item.title: 本文提出一种结合检索增强生成与大语言模型的系统，用于自动验证研究论文的代码实现是否与论文所述算法方法一致，从而提升代码验证的准确性和AI研究的可信度。
item.description:
使用大语言模型与检索增强生成提升人工智能研究中的代码一致性

Enhancing Code Consistency in AI Research with Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.00611

本文提出一种结合检索增强生成与大语言模型的系统，用于自动验证研究论文的代码实现是否与论文所述算法方法一致，从而提升代码验证的准确性和AI研究的可信度。

确保代码准确反映研究论文中描述的算法和方法，对于维持人工智能研究的可信度并培养信任至关重要。本文提出了一种新颖的系统，旨在根据相应研究论文中概述的算法和方法来验证代码实现。我们的系统采用检索增强生成技术从研究论文和代码库中提取相关细节，然后使用大语言模型进行结构化比较。这种方法提高了代码实现验证的准确性和全面性，同时有助于提升人工智能研究的透明度、可解释性和可复现性。通过自动化验证过程，我们的系统减少了人工工作量，增强了研究的可信度，并最终推动了代码验证技术的发展。

arXiv:2502.00611v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ensuring that code accurately reflects the algorithms and methods described in research papers is critical for maintaining credibility and fostering trust in AI research. This paper presents a novel system designed to verify code implementations against the algorithms and methodologies outlined in corresponding research papers. Our system employs Retrieval-Augmented Generation to extract relevant details from both the research papers and code bases, followed by a structured comparison using Large Language Models. This approach improves the accuracy and comprehensiveness of code implementation verification while contributing to the transparency, explainability, and reproducibility of AI research. By automating the verification process, our system reduces manual effort, enhances research credibility, and ultimately advances the state of the art in code verification.

item.title: JustLogic是一个合成生成的命题逻辑演绎推理基准，兼具任务复杂性、先验知识无关性和深入错误分析能力，克服了现有基准的三大局限。
item.description:
JustLogic：一个用于评估大型语言模型演绎推理能力的综合基准

JustLogic: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Deductive Reasoning in Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.14851

JustLogic是一个合成生成的命题逻辑演绎推理基准，兼具任务复杂性、先验知识无关性和深入错误分析能力，克服了现有基准的三大局限。

逻辑推理是大型语言模型（LLM）的关键组成部分，近年来大量研究工作致力于提升其演绎推理能力。然而，现有的演绎推理基准存在显著局限，限制了其实用价值，即缺乏任务复杂性、存在先验知识作为混淆因素，以及错误分析流于表面。为了解决这些缺陷，我们提出了JustLogic，一个用于评估命题逻辑演绎能力的合成生成基准。在这一逻辑片段范围内，JustLogic具有以下特点：(i) 复杂性，能够生成多样化的语言模式、词汇和论证结构；(ii) 与先验知识无关，大幅降低了具备先验知识的模型所拥有的优势，使所有问题仅凭给定前提即可作答；(iii) 能够对异构的推理错误进行深入的错误分析。

arXiv:2501.14851v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Logical reasoning is a critical component of Large Language Models (LLMs), and substantial research efforts in recent years have aimed to enhance their deductive reasoning abilities. However, existing deductive reasoning benchmarks suffer from significant constraints that restrict their utility, i.e., the lack of task complexity, the presence of prior knowledge as a confounder, and superficial error analysis. To address these deficiencies, we introduce JustLogic, a synthetically generated benchmark for evaluating deduction in propositional logic. Within this fragment, JustLogic is (i) complex, capable of generating a diverse range of linguistic patterns, vocabulary, and argument structures, (ii) prior knowledge independent, substantially reducing the advantage of models possessing prior knowledge so that questions are answerable from the given premises alone, and (iii) capable of in-depth error analysis on the heterogeneous eff

item.title: 本文提出集合逻辑（EL）这一族模态逻辑，在度量幺半群上统一了离散、稠密和多维设置下的时间与空间推理，并证明了自然数上可满足性的尖锐不可判定性边界。
item.description:
集合逻辑

Ensemble Logic

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14443

本文提出集合逻辑（EL）这一族模态逻辑，在度量幺半群上统一了离散、稠密和多维设置下的时间与空间推理，并证明了自然数上可满足性的尖锐不可判定性边界。

集合逻辑是一族模态逻辑，其模态参数是含量化变量的项。我们在度量幺半群（即配备平移不变度量的交换幺半群）上解释公式。位移算子在平移后的点上对公式求值，而有界存在和有界全称算子在指定长度的窗口内的某个点或每个点上对公式求值。对点和长度的量化允许同一变量出现在多个算子的参数中。这为离散、稠密和多维设置中的时间推理和空间推理提供了一个统一的框架。我们的主要结果建立了自然数上可满足性的尖锐不可判定性边界：对于形如 $\exists N\,\exists n\,\Psi$ 的公式，其中 $\Psi$ 由固定字母表中的字母通过合取、析取、位移和有界全称量词构造而成，其可满足性已经是不可判定的。

arXiv:2408.14443v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ensemble Logic (EL) is a family of modal logics whose modal parameters are terms with quantified variables. We interpret formulas over metric monoids, that is, commutative monoids equipped with translation-invariant metrics. Displacement evaluates a formula at a translated point, while bounded existence and bounded universality evaluate it at some or every point of a window of prescribed length. Quantification over points and lengths allows the same variable to occur in the parameters of several operators. This provides a common framework for temporal and spatial reasoning in discrete, dense and multi-dimensional settings. Our main result establishes a sharp undecidability boundary for satisfiability over the natural numbers: satisfiability is undecidable already for formulas $\exists N\,\exists n\,\Psi$ in which $\Psi$ is built from the letters of a fixed alphabet by conjunction, disjunction, displacement and bounded universal

item.title: 本文提出DeepVoting方法，利用标准社会选择数据结构作为特征学习投票规则，在参数减少一个数量级的同时获得更高的准确率，并通过新颖的公理损失函数和迁移学习微调，为现有投票规则注入所需的公理性质。
item.description:
DeepVoting：通过微调学习和改进投票规则

DeepVoting: Learning and Improving Voting Rules with Fine-Tuning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.13630

本文提出DeepVoting方法，利用标准社会选择数据结构作为特征学习投票规则，在参数减少一个数量级的同时获得更高的准确率，并通过新颖的公理损失函数和迁移学习微调，为现有投票规则注入所需的公理性质。

近年来，社会选择理论被发现对人工智能对齐和评估具有广泛的应用价值，这通常基于社会选择函数所提供的用于组合偏好的公理性质。然而，对于许多公理集合而言，已知不存在永不违反这些公理的函数，例如阿罗不可能定理。最近关于学习新规则以最小化公理违反的研究表明了机器学习的有效性，但仅探索了有限类别的公理。在这项工作中，我们展示了将标准社会选择数据结构作为特征来学习现有投票规则的有效性，所产生的网络比以往方法具有更高的准确率，同时使用的参数数量少了一个数量级。随后，我们开发了一种为现有投票规则添加公理性质的方法。通过构建新颖的公理损失函数，我们能够利用迁移学习对现有的投票规则进行微调。

arXiv:2408.13630v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recently, social choice theory has been found broadly useful for AI alignment and evaluation, often based on the axiomatic properties for combining preferences provided by social choice functions. However, for many sets of axioms, functions which never violate the axioms are known to not exist, e.g., Arrow's Impossibility Theorem. Recent work on learning novel rules to minimize axiom violations shows the effectiveness of machine learning but explores a limited class of axioms. In this work we show the effectiveness of standard social choice data structures as features for learning existing voting rules, resulting in networks that have better accuracy than past approaches while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Subsequently, we develop a process for adding axiomatic properties to existing voting rules. By building novel axiomatic loss functions we are able to use transfer learning to fine-tune existing voting rules i

item.title: 本文提出在检索增强生成（RAG）框架中微调大语言模型以进行关系抽取，有效解决了通用大语言模型作为生成器时面临的领域适应挑战。
item.description:
在检索增强生成框架中微调大语言模型进行关系抽取

Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Relation Extraction within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework

https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14745

本文提出在检索增强生成（RAG）框架中微调大语言模型以进行关系抽取，有效解决了通用大语言模型作为生成器时面临的领域适应挑战。

信息抽取（IE）在将非结构化数据转换为知识图谱等结构化格式方面发挥着关键作用。信息抽取中的主要任务之一是关系抽取（RE），它识别文本数据中实体之间的关系。这一过程丰富了文档的语义理解，使得更精确的信息检索和查询回答成为可能。近期利用预训练语言模型的研究在关系抽取方面展现出了显著的性能提升。在大语言模型（LLM）时代，对这些大语言模型进行微调可以缓解零样本关系抽取方法的局限性，特别是在克服关系抽取中固有的领域适应挑战方面。本工作不仅探索了微调大语言模型的有效性，还探讨了将其集成到基于检索增强生成（RAG）的关系抽取方法中，以解决通用大语言模型作为生成器时所面临的领域适应挑战。

arXiv:2406.14745v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Information Extraction (IE) plays a pivotal role in transforming unstructured data into structured formats, such as Knowledge Graphs. One of the main tasks within IE is Relation Extraction (RE), which identifies relations between entities in text data. This process enriches the semantic understanding of documents, enabling more precise information retrieval and query answering. Recent works leveraging pre-trained language models have demonstrated significant performance improvements in RE. In the current era of Large Language Models (LLMs), fine-tuning these LLMs can mitigate the limitations of zero-shot RE methods, particularly in overcoming the domain adaptation challenges inherent in RE. This work explores not only the effectiveness of fine-tuned LLMs but also their integration into a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based RE approach to address domain adaptation challenges when general-purpose LLMs serve as generators w

item.title: 使用Shapley值方法解释LLM行为，揭示了所谓的“令牌噪音”效应，揭示了LLMs的决策在很大程度上受到提示组件的影响
item.description:
等等，这都是令牌噪音？一直就是吗：利用 Shapley 值解释 LLM 行为

Wait, It's All Token Noise? Always Has Been: Interpreting LLM Behavior Using Shapley Value

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01332

使用Shapley值方法解释LLM行为，揭示了所谓的“令牌噪音”效应，揭示了LLMs的决策在很大程度上受到提示组件的影响

大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现为模拟人类行为和认知过程开辟了新的可能性，潜在应用包括市场研究和消费者行为分析等各个领域。然而，由于LLMs的显著差异暗示了不同的基础过程在起作用，以及LLMs对提示变化的敏感性，利用LLMs作为人类主体的替代仍然存在不确定性。本文提出了一种基于合作博弈理论中Shapley值的新方法来解释LLM行为，并量化每个提示组件对模型输出的相对贡献。通过两个应用--一个离散选择实验和一个认知偏见调查，我们展示了Shapley值方法如何揭示我们所谓的“令牌噪音”效应，即LLM决策受到的影响严重偏向于

arXiv:2404.01332v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has opened up exciting possibilities for simulating human behavior and cognitive processes, with potential applications in various domains, including marketing research and consumer behavior analysis. However, the validity of utilizing LLMs as stand-ins for human subjects remains uncertain due to glaring divergences that suggest fundamentally different underlying processes at play and the sensitivity of LLM responses to prompt variations. This paper presents a novel approach based on Shapley values from cooperative game theory to interpret LLM behavior and quantify the relative contribution of each prompt component to the model's output.
